title: At Your Service Center Associate, Eastwood Mall - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Director, Supply Chain Program Management, Contract Manufacturing
description:
Position Summary

Coherent is seeking a Director of Supply Chain Program Management, Contract Manufacturing to lead the strategic growth and operational scaling of our Southeast Asia contract manufacturing network. This role will also have direct oversight to several key strategic suppliers in the Western U.S. This role will serve as the critical link between business demand, supply chain strategy, manufacturing operations, engineering, procurement, quality, and external manufacturing partners to ensure successful execution of Coherent's aggressive growth objectives.

The Director will establish and lead integrated planning, capacity expansion, manufacturing transfer, and operational readiness programs that enable scalable growth across the contract manufacturing ecosystem. Success in this role requires strong leadership in SIOP/IBP, supply chain transformation, factory ramp-up, capacity planning, executive communication, and cross-functional decision-making within complex global manufacturing environments.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Manufacturing Growth & Strategy

  • Develop and execute the operational roadmap supporting rapid expansion of Southeast Asia contract manufacturing partners.
  • Lead strategic planning efforts to ensure contract manufacturers can meet future demand, capacity, quality, and delivery requirements.
  • Partner with global operations and business leaders to translate growth forecasts into executable manufacturing strategies.
  • Build scalable governance models supporting contract manufacturer performance and operational maturity.

Integrated Business Planning (IBP/SIOP)

  • Own the integrated planning process connecting customer demand, supply availability, manufacturing capacity, inventory, financial objectives, and delivery commitments.
  • Lead executive SIOP reviews and facilitate cross-functional decision-making related to capacity constraints, supply risks, inventory strategies, and production priorities.
  • Drive scenario planning to support business growth, risk mitigation, and capital investment decisions.
  • Develop capacity and resource planning models supporting long-range growth forecasts.

Factory Expansion, Transfers & Production Ramps

  • Lead manufacturing transfer and factory ramp-up programs supporting capacity expansion and business continuity.
  • Coordinate operational readiness activities across supply chain, manufacturing, engineering, quality, procurement, and finance.
  • Develop and execute strategies to support new product introductions and technology transfers into contract manufacturing environments.
  • Ensure successful transition of production while maintaining customer commitments and operational performance.

Supply Chain & Operational Excellence

  • Establish KPI-driven management systems focused on delivery performance, inventory health, schedule adherence, capacity utilization, and operational readiness.
  • Drive improvements in planning processes, MRP health, master scheduling, and supply-demand balancing.
  • Implement dashboarding and reporting tools that improve visibility and decision-making across the manufacturing network.
  • Lead initiatives that improve supply chain resiliency, responsiveness, and scalability.

Contract Manufacturer Engagement

  • Serve as executive liaison for strategic contract manufacturing partners throughout Southeast Asia.
  • Conduct regular business reviews focused on operational performance, growth readiness, continuous improvement, and risk management.
  • Drive accountability for commitments across both internal teams and external partners.
  • Facilitate rapid resolution of operational constraints impacting customer delivery or factory performance.

Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Build and develop a high-performing program management and planning organization.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, data-driven decision making, and operational excellence.
  • Influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization, including executive leadership and global operations teams.
  • Lead organizational change initiatives necessary to support continued growth and transformation.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or related field.
  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in supply chain, integrated planning, manufacturing operations, or program management.
  • Deep experience leading SIOP, IBP, demand planning, supply planning, capacity planning, and inventory strategy processes.
  • Proven success supporting manufacturing transfers, factory expansions, production ramp-ups, or site transitions.
  • Experience working with global contract manufacturers and outsourced manufacturing operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large cross-functional programs across Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, and Quality.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Experience leading global teams across multiple regions and cultures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced technical degree.
  • Experience within photonics, semiconductors, aerospace & defense, electronics manufacturing, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
  • Experience with SAP, Kinaxis RapidResponse, Power BI, or similar planning and analytics platforms.
  • Experience in AS9100, ISO, or highly controlled manufacturing environments.

Key Competencies

  • SIOP / IBP Leadership
  • Global Supply Chain Strategy
  • Contract Manufacturing Management
  • Capacity & Resource Planning
  • Factory Ramp & Transition Management
  • Demand & Supply Planning
  • Executive Communication
  • Operational Excellence
  • Manufacturing Readiness
  • Change Leadership
  • Scenario Planning & Risk Management
  • Cross-Functional Team Leadership

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience leading integrated planning and supply chain transformation within complex manufacturing environments. They will have demonstrated success scaling operations, managing factory transitions, balancing supply and demand in constrained environments, and leading global teams through significant growth and change. Experience supporting contract manufacturers, production ramp-ups, and executive SIOP processes will be critical to enabling Coherent's next phase of growth across Southeast Asia.

Depending on location, this position may be responsible for the execution and maintenance of the ISO 9000, 9001, 14001 and/or other applicable standards that may apply to the relevant roles and responsibilities within the Quality Management System and Environmental Management System.

title: Senior Data Science Engineer (Canada, EST, Remote)
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Data Science Engineer to provide applied data science expertise within our Success Engineering team, helping customers maximize the value of MindBridge’s control points and ensembles. You will configure and tune existing models, assess their application to customer data, investigate model behaviour and results, and translate complex findings into practical solutions. Working primarily post-launch, you will partner closely with Success Engineering, Product, Engineering, and AI/ML teams to solve complex customer needs within MindBridge’s existing capabilities.

What You Will Do

Applied model & ensemble expertise

Maintain deep working knowledge of MindBridge's core detection methodologies: scoring logic, risk indicators, and how ensembles combine individual control points into a single output. Serve as the go-to technical resource within Success Engineering for questions about how a model or ensemble actually works.

Engineering & AI/ML liaison

Maintain an active, ongoing working relationship with Product, Engineering, and AI/ML teams to stay current on model changes, known limitations, and upcoming capability shifts. Use that relationship to bring well-informed, technically grounded context back to Product/Engineering when a configurability gap is identified, a clear technical brief on what was requested, why it isn't currently supported, and what the customer's underlying value requirement needs, not just an administrative escalation.

Configurability boundaries & value mapping

Develop and maintain authoritative understanding of how, why, and to what extent MindBridge's core models and ensembles can be configured, which parameters are flexible, which are structurally fixed, and the statistical or product reasoning behind each boundary. Map a customer's stated business value requirement onto the specific configuration options actually available, and explain in plain terms what is, and is not, achievable within the current product.

Post-launch feasibility & configuration advisory

Evaluate customer requests to add, modify, or reconfigure a control point or ensemble, and determine whether it is feasible with existing product capability and the customer's available data. Define the specific data requirements: fields, quality, volume, structure — needed to support a proposed configuration. Recommend the configuration approach that best fits the customer's control objective within supported product capability.

Explainability & customer communication

Translate model and ensemble behavior into language finance, audit, and compliance stakeholders can act on: what it measures, how it scores, and why a specific result occurred. Support customers who need to justify or defend MindBridge's outputs to their own internal or external stakeholders, a recurring requirement in audit-facing use cases.

Root-cause diagnostics

When a control point or ensemble underperforms post-launch, determine whether the cause is data quality, configuration, or a genuine product limitation, and recommend the correct fix.

Escalation & product boundary stewardship

Distinguish clearly between a configuration question and a request that requires new product capability, and route the latter through Product/Engineering governance. Do not build bespoke workarounds to cover product gaps; document and escalate them instead.

Enablement & knowledge capture

Convert recurring model and configuration questions into FAQs, decision guides, and training material for Success Engineers, Success Engineering Architects, and Delivery Services.

Bounded support to Delivery Services

Act as an internal subject-matter-expert resource for Solutions Architects and Data Engineers specifically when an implementation calls for a control point or ensemble configuration that has not been built or validated before; not for routine, previously-validated feasibility questions, which remain owned by Delivery Services. This is consultative, time-boxed input at the point a novel configuration is being designed, not ownership of the Technical Requirements Blueprint or any implementation deliverable, which remains with Delivery Services throughout the technical blueprint phase.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of applied experience in data science, analytics engineering, or a closely related technical discipline, ideally supporting enterprise software customers after implementation. Working knowledge of the statistical and machine learning techniques used in anomaly and risk detection — scoring models, ensemble/combination methods, outlier detection — sufficient to reason about why a model behaves as it does, not only what it outputs; building such models from scratch is not required. Strong SQL, Python and data literacy; able to independently investigate whether a data set can support a proposed control point or ensemble configuration. Demonstrated ability to translate technical model behavior into terms a non-technical, often finance, audit, or compliance stakeholder can act on. Direct experience working with enterprise customers on technical questions, in a support, technical account management, implementation, or applied customer-facing data science capacity. Credible enough with model internals and engineering constraints to partner directly with Engineering and AI/ML teams as a peer. This role sits between the customer-facing and product-technical sides, not solely on the customer-facing side. Comfortable operating inside a defined product boundary: recommending within existing capability and escalating clearly rather than building around gaps.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in audit, internal controls, financial risk, or fraud analytics. Familiarity with explainability and interpretability expectations in regulated or audit-facing environments. Experience producing enablement content i.e. FAQs, playbooks, training materials, for internal technical teams. Prior experience in a dedicated post-implementation optimization function, as distinct from initial delivery. Background in ML engineering, applied statistics, or a related technical field with direct exposure to production model constraints; not solely academic or research modeling experience.

Requirements contingent on employment

Fulfill requirements necessary to obtain full background check.

Pay Range The expected base salary range for this position is to $130,000 to $155,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills, experience and competencies, and unique qualifications.

title: FPGA Design Engineer
description:
Who You’ll Work With

You will work closely with cross-functional hardware, software, and manufacturing engineering teams to innovate new system architectures and drive FPGA development from initial concept to final delivery.

What You’ll Do

Our Hardware Design Engineering team is at the forefront of developing high-speed networking and Ethernet products used in enterprise campuses, hyperscaler data centers, and bleeding-edge AI clusters. The team is responsible for the end-to-end design and development of advanced hardware solutions that meet the demands of modern networking environments.

As a core member of the FPGA Design and Verification team, you will drive the development of high-performance control path FPGAs powering Arista’s flagship data center platforms. You will own the full design lifecycle—from gathering architectural requirements and reviewing board schematics to executing rigorous verification, leading system bring-up, and supporting production deployment.

Responsibilities:

  • RTL Development & Verification: Develop, integrate, simulate, and verify Verilog and SystemVerilog RTL code, including custom testbench creation.
  • FPGA Flow Implementation: Execute the full FPGA development flow, including synthesis, place and route, timing closure, and in-system hardware debugging.
  • System-Level Integration: Collaborate directly with hardware and software engineering teams to drive rapid bring-up and debugging of next-generation network switch platforms.
  • Design & Architecture Reviews: Actively participate in peer RTL code reviews, as well as PCB schematic and board design reviews.
  • Toolchain Automation: Develop AI-skills, Python, Tcl, or shell scripts to streamline data processing and automate FPGA design workflows.

Concepts & Skills You Will Gain

  • Switching Architectures: Master data and control path architectures in modern Ethernet switches, alongside critical I/O interfaces (e.g., PCIe, Interlaken, Ethernet PHY/MAC, SMBus, SPI, MDIO, JTAG).
  • Networking Protocols: Gain hands-on experience with Ethernet-based protocols, including PTP, sFlow, and PoE.
  • Practical FPGA Engineering: Learn to navigate real-world design challenges, including tight timing closure, resource optimization, clock domain crossing, and complex state machine design.
  • Multi-Vendor Ecosystems: Develop expertise across major vendor FPGA architectures, toolchains, and IDEs.
  • Cross-Functional System Design: Build skills in interpreting complex PCB schematics, running advanced simulation frameworks, and solving multidisciplinary hardware/software challenges.
  • 5 years or more of hands-on experience in Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL design.
  • Proven background in Control Path design.
  • Direct experience with On-Chip Bus interfaces (e.g., I2C, SPI, MDIO, PCIe, AXI).
  • Local to the Bay area

Preferred:

  • Experience with Ethernet Data Path architecture and design.
  • Hands-on experience with Streaming Bus interfaces (e.g., AXI-Stream).
  • Background in FPGA resource management and timing closure.
  • Proficiency in Python, Tcl, or general scripting for EDA tool automation.
  • Lab Debugging & Validation: Utilize logic analyzers (LA), oscilloscopes, and vendor-specific debug tools for lab bring up, debug, and validation.

Compensation Information:

The new hire base pay for this role has a pay range of $110,000 to $170,000. Arista offers different pay ranges based on work location, so that we can offer consistent and competitive pay appropriate to the market. The actual base pay offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and work location. The salary range provided reflects base pay only. As described above, this position may also be eligible for discretionary Arista bonuses and equity. US- based employees are also entitled to benefits including medical, dental, vision, wellbeing, tax savings and income protection. The recruiting team can share more details during the hiring process specific to the role and location.

Arista Networks is an equal opportunity employer. Arista makes all hiring and employment-related decisions in a non-discriminatory manner without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or any other factor determined to be unlawful under applicable federal, state, or law law. title: Entrepriseleder til anlæg hos Tscherning – også for nyuddannede med håndværksmæssig baggrund
description:
Vil du arbejde med anlægsprojekter– og har du lyst til at udvikle dig til fremtidens entrepriseleder?

Hos Tscherning udfører vi ikke bare veje, forsyning, byrum og infrastrukturløsninger. Vi arbejder hver dag for at flytte bygge- og anlægsbranchen i en mere ansvarlig retning.

Vi tror på, at de bedste projekter skabes, når høj faglighed kombineres med fokus på genanvendelse, CO₂-reduktion, effektiv ressourceudnyttelse og ordentlige løsninger for både kunder, medarbejdere og omgivelser.

Vi søger en kommende entrepriseleder til vores anlægsafdeling på Sjælland. Gerne nyuddannede bygningskonstruktører og ingeniører med lyst til at lære entreprenørfaget og udvikle sig i en virksomhed med høje ambitioner.

Du bliver en del af en mentorordning med erfarne projektledere, tilbudsberegnere og formænd, som hjælper dig godt ind i rollen.

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

  • Deltage i styringen af anlægsprojekter fra tilbudsfase til projektaflevering til kunden.
  • Bidrage til fremdrift, kvalitet, økonomi og sikkerhed på projekterne.
  • Arbejde tæt sammen med projektledere, formænd, landmålere og vores dygtige håndværkere / maskinførere.
  • Udarbejde og opfølgning på sagsøkonomi og tidsplaner.
  • Få rutine i tilbudsarbejde, mængdeberegninger og prissætning af projekter og ændringsarbejder.
  • Bidrage til stærke kunderelationer og høj kundetilfredshed.
  • Arbejde med ressourceoptimering og bæredygtige løsninger i projekterne.

Om dig

  • Du er nyuddannet eller har få års erfaring som bygningskonstruktør, ingeniør og evt. kloakmester uddannelse.
  • Du har lyst til at lære entreprenørfaget og udvikle dig til en stærk entrepriseleder.
  • Du interesserer dig for anlægsprojekter og entreprenørarbejder.
  • Du har forståelse for planlægning og projektgennemførelse eller lyst til at lære det.
  • Du har forståelse for økonomi og budgetter.
  • Du arbejder struktureret og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.
  • Du trives i samarbejdet med kolleger, kunder og samarbejdspartnere.
  • Du motiveres af at finde løsninger frem for begrænsninger.
  • Håndværksmæssig baggrund eller praktisk byggepladserfaring vil være en fordel.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et struktureret oplæringsforløb med mentorordning.
  • Tæt sparring med erfarne projektledere og formænd.
  • Oplæring som entreprise- / projektlederleder med ansvar for egne projekter.
  • Relevante kurser og faglig udvikling.
  • En virksomhed med korte beslutningsveje, høj faglighed og stor moderne maskinpark.
  • Dygtige kolleger og stærkt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor bæredygtighed ikke er en strategi på papir, men noget vi arbejder med i praksis hver dag.
  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på sikkerhed, trivsel og ordentlighed.

Praktisk information

Arbejdsstedet vil være på vores anlægsprojekter primært på Sjælland med udgangspunkt fra vores hovedkontor i Hedehusene.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi er åbne for både nyuddannede og profiler med erfaring. Det vigtigste for os er din motivation, din tilgang til opgaverne og lysten til at udvikle dig. Derfor ser vi gerne, at din ansøgning giver os et indblik i, hvem du er som person.

Tscherning er det ansvarlige valg

Med over 500 ansatte er Tscherning en af Danmarks største nedrivnings- og anlægsentreprenører. Vi bygger på høj faglighed og ordentlighed og arbejder målrettet for en mere cirkulær fremtid, hvor materialer får nyt liv, og vi reducerer spild i byggeriet.

Vi omsætter bæredygtighed til handling i hver eneste opgave inden for anlæg, nedrivning og miljøsanering. For os handler ansvarlighed også om mennesker – trivsel, udvikling og mangfoldighed er en naturlig del af vores kultur.

Hos Tscherning er der kort fra tanke til handling og plads til at vokse – både fagligt og personligt.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend), Search
description:
Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About the Team

Discovery Applications is the face of Scribd’s Machine Learning and Discovery Engineering Division. It is dedicated to building the customer-facing web experiences that power our cutting-edge search, recommendations, and generative AI features. This full stack team builds and owns the end-to-end discovery experience across Scribd and Everand, turning machine learning capabilities into intuitive, customer-facing features.

Joining this team means you will play a key role in delivering the user value of the pioneering machine learning work, creating tangible impacts through exceptional user experiences.

About the Role

Our cross-functional squads often involve deep collaboration with other engineering teams, designers, and product managers. Your excellent communication, both in meetings and asynchronously via slack will be a key tool in driving success.

This role predominantly focuses on the frontend but comfort and knowledge of the full tech stack is a must as this role works closely with backend and ML engineers to build our complete product. You will build the user-facing experiences that are powered by Machine Learning and Generative AI.

Full-cycle software development will be your primary function, but we'll expect you to contribute in a number of ways, including advising on others' technical design, reviewing code, participating in interviews, and mentoring less experienced engineers.

When you are building software, you'll be doing more than just coding a ticket that is handed to you. You'll contribute to the code strategy, architecture, implementation, delivery, and operation of systems, end-to-end. You'll consider testability, upgradeability, scalability, and observability throughout the development process.

What You’ll Bring

Key Attributes

  • Strong ownership mindset, taking responsibility for frontend systems from design through long-term evolution

  • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to reason about frontend architecture at scale

  • Pragmatic approach to modernization, balancing ideal solutions with incremental, low-risk progress

  • Strong collaboration skills and comfort working closely with both product and platform teams.

  • Long-term perspective on maintainability, extensibility, and developer experience

Experience We Value

  • 6+ years of professional frontend software engineering experience

  • Deep experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React

  • Hands-on experience with Next.js or similar modern web frameworks

  • Familiarity with Microfrontend architectures, monorepos, or shared frontend platforms

  • Strong understanding of web performance, bundling, and optimization techniques

  • Experience collaborating with backend and platform teams to define clean integration patterns

  • Comfort operating in environments with high traffic, high visibility, and real user impact

  • Comfortable working in a codebase with shared patterns (monorepos, shared UI libraries, or platform constraints) and collaborating across teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; thrives in a remote, documentation-driven culture

  • Highly collaborative: partners closely with product, design, and backend to deliver end-to-end features

Nice to have

  • Experience working with or migrating large, complex, or legacy frontend codebases

  • You’ve helped modernize frontend systems in production, not just greenfield projects

  • You think about frontend architecture as a product for other engineers, not just a delivery mechanism

  • You consider performance, accessibility, SEO, quality, and observability as first-class concerns

  • You invest in testing and quality practices that make large-scale migrations safe and repeatable

  • You enjoy untangling complexity and leaving systems better than you found them

  • You care deeply about how technical decisions affect both developers and end users

title: Senior Solder / Electrical Assembly Technician
description:
Senior Solder / Electrical Assembly Technician

Location: Burbank, California
Company: WET (Design)

WET creates experiences that transform the way people encounter nature’s elements. We bring together water, light, fire, fog, ice, motion, sound, and advanced engineering to create places that move people—emotionally and physically. From the Fountains of Bellagio to the Dubai Fountain, WET has redefined what is possible when artistry, technology, and precision craftsmanship work as one. WET describes its work as “unleash[ing] the magic of the elements,” bringing together artists, physicists, architects, and choreographers to push the boundaries of the physical world.

We are looking for an experienced, detail-obsessed Senior Solder / Electrical Assembly Technician to help build the lighting systems behind extraordinary WET experiences. This is a critical, hands-on production role for someone who brings advanced soldering skill, strong electrical and mechanical instincts, exceptional workmanship, and a genuine sense of urgency.

The components you build will travel from our production floor to some of the world’s most ambitious destinations—where they become part of the light, movement, and magic that millions of people experience.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Solder / Electrical Assembly Technician, you will assemble, solder, test, inspect, and prepare LED lighting assemblies, light heads, cables, connectors, and power supplies for deployment in WET’s custom water-feature and experiential projects.

You will work with delicate, high-value components and precision tools to create reliable, production-ready assemblies that meet exacting quality, electrical, mechanical, and aesthetic standards. This is not generic bench work: every connection, solder joint, cable route, torque setting, and test result matters.

You will partner with Production Engineering and Manufacturing teams to improve processes, document best practices, solve problems quickly, and help the team meet demanding project schedules without compromising safety or craftsmanship.

What You’ll Do

  • Assemble, wire, solder, test, inspect, and prepare LED light heads, lighting assemblies, power supplies, cables, connectors, and related electrical hardware

  • Clean, prepare, tin, position, and solder components onto printed circuit boards using through-hole soldering techniques

  • Build and repair cable assemblies, connectors, harnesses, and associated electrical components to drawing, schematic, and work-instruction requirements

  • Perform cable dressing, cable routing, cable-tray work, conduit-related installation tasks, and mechanical integration of electrical assemblies as required

  • Stage materials, verify kit completeness, set up workstations, and prepare assemblies for efficient production execution

  • Use calibrated precision tools and test equipment, including torque wrenches, ohmmeters, programming equipment, and other electrical diagnostic tools

  • Complete electrical and functional testing; identify defects, troubleshoot failures, document results, and ensure assemblies meet acceptance criteria before release

  • Handle fragile, sensitive, and precision-built assemblies with care to prevent damage, contamination, electrostatic discharge, or cosmetic defects

  • Read, interpret, and work from technical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, bills of materials, procedures, specifications, and test instructions

  • Maintain accurate build, inspection, test, rework, and traceability documentation

  • Work closely with Production Engineers to develop, refine, document, and improve assembly processes, tooling, test methods, and work instructions

  • Identify recurring defects, quality concerns, material issues, and process gaps; recommend practical solutions that improve quality, efficiency, and reliability

  • Maintain a clean, organized, safe, and production-ready work area

  • Follow all WET safety, quality, ESD, workmanship, and conduct requirements

  • Support cross-functional production needs and perform other related duties necessary to meet project commitments

What You Bring

  • High school diploma or GED required

  • 5+ years of hands-on electrical assembly experience with significant, verifiable soldering responsibility

  • Advanced through-hole soldering capability and a strong record of producing clean, durable, high-quality solder joints

  • Formal electronics training or equivalent practical experience in electrical assembly, installation, wiring, soldering, cable fabrication, connector repair, and electronic troubleshooting

  • Demonstrated experience cleaning, preparing, soldering, inspecting, and reworking PCB-mounted electronic components

  • Strong working knowledge of electrical assemblies, LED lighting systems, power supplies, cables, connectors, and related low-voltage hardware

  • Experience using manual, power, pneumatic, and precision hand tools safely and effectively

  • Ability to use torque wrenches, ohmmeters, multimeters, continuity testers, and basic programming or configuration equipment

  • Ability to read, understand, and accurately follow drawings, wiring diagrams, technical schematics, assembly procedures, and test instructions

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and the ability to integrate electrical and mechanical components into a finished assembly

  • Excellent hand-eye coordination, fine motor control, and finger dexterity for detailed and repetitive precision work

  • A disciplined approach to quality, documentation, workmanship standards, and repeatable process execution

  • A resourceful, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to troubleshoot under schedule pressure

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work productively with engineers, technicians, production leads, and cross-functional manufacturing teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a high-volume, fast-paced electronics, lighting, aerospace, medical-device, industrial-equipment, or precision-manufacturing environment

  • Formal training or certification in electronics assembly, soldering, IPC standards, or related workmanship specifications

  • Experience with LED lighting assemblies, waterproof or outdoor-rated electrical systems, custom cable assemblies, or field-installable electrical equipment

  • Experience working with engineering change orders, bills of materials, routings, production travelers, inspection records, or quality-control systems

  • Familiarity with electrostatic-discharge controls and ESD-safe assembly practices

  • Demonstrated ability to shift quickly between projects, priorities, products, and responsibilities while maintaining quality and attention to detail

Physical And Schedule Requirements

  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull materials and equipment weighing at least 30 pounds

  • Ability to perform detailed, repetitive hand, wrist, and finger movements throughout the workday

  • Ability to work with small, fragile, and intricate electrical components while maintaining close visual focus

  • Ability to sit, stand, bend, reach, and work at a production bench or assembly station for extended periods

  • Willingness and availability to work overtime and weekends as required to meet critical project and delivery schedules

Why WET

At WET, precision is visible. The quality of the lighting assemblies built in our shop directly affects the reliability, beauty, and emotional impact of experiences seen around the world.

This role is ideal for a highly skilled soldering and electrical-assembly professional who takes personal pride in getting every detail right, thrives in a demanding build environment, and wants their work to become part of something far beyond an ordinary product.

Equal Employment Opportunity

WET is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on merit, competence, qualifications, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Nuclear Energy Data Analysis Intern - Fall 2026

We are looking for an undergraduate intern to help build and test the software tools and data resources used to assess uprate opportunities across the U.S. nuclear fleet. title: ASM Maintenance Controller
description:
About Tenax

Tenax delivers mission-critical airborne intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, aerial firefighting, and data collection capabilities supporting U.S. Government customers. Our aviation professionals operate in dynamic environments where safety, aircraft availability, regulatory compliance, responsiveness, and customer focus are essential to mission success.

We are seeking an experienced ASM Maintenance Controller to supervise and support aircraft maintenance for the ASM, ATGS, and NIROPS programs supporting the U.S. Forest Service. This remote position coordinates aircraft status, maintenance progress, return-to-service documentation, vendor support, and Aircraft on Ground (AOG) response for Tenax-owned and operated aircraft.

The ideal candidate is an experienced aircraft maintenance professional and King Air subject matter expert who can coordinate effectively with pilots, maintenance providers, vendors, customers, and Tenax leadership while maintaining accurate records and supporting safe, compliant, and timely return-to-service decisions.

What You'll Do

As an ASM Maintenance Controller, you will coordinate maintenance activity, monitor aircraft status, and support operational availability across assigned programs.

  • Work with the Program Manager, Director of Maintenance, ASM Maintenance Manager, U.S. Forest Service representatives, and onsite maintenance personnel to track repairs and minimize impacts to aircraft availability.

  • Coordinate with maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) providers regarding scheduling, troubleshooting, parts procurement, and timely return to service.

  • Review post-maintenance and return-to-service documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with Federal Aviation Administration requirements.

  • Provide guidance regarding proper completion of aircraft maintenance documentation, as needed.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for King Air aircraft, engines, and related components operating under assigned programs.

  • Provide accurate aircraft and maintenance status reports for turnover to Maintenance Management and Program Management.

  • Maintain current and complete maintenance status information in applicable company systems and Microsoft Office applications.

  • Support the ASM fleet AOG call center on a rotating basis and serve as Tenax’s primary point of contact with pilots, vendors, management, and maintenance providers while on duty.

  • Review and respond to delays and AOG events, identify recurring issues, and recommend corrective or preventive improvements.

  • Maintain assigned standard operating procedures related to maintenance and parts support.

  • Support inventory accountability for Tenax-owned equipment, tooling, and spare parts stored at MRO facilities, including annual inventory activities.

  • Support aircraft tracking, emergency logistics, and other program requirements during assigned work periods.

  • Contribute to fleet safety, quality, reliability, and continuous-improvement initiatives.

  • Support the Tenax Safety Management System (SMS).

  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of operational and program requirements.

Basic Qualifications

To be successful in this role, candidates should possess:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Current FAA Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) mechanic certificate.

  • At least five years of relevant aircraft maintenance experience.

  • Working knowledge of FAA regulations applicable to aircraft operations and maintenance, including 14 CFR Parts 23, 39, 43, 91, 135, and 145.

  • Familiarity with FAA Forms 337 and 8110-3 and Designated Engineering Representative supporting substantiation documentation.

  • Working knowledge of CAMP, Flightdocs, Microsoft Project, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Excel, OneNote, and other standard Microsoft Office applications.

  • Ability to review maintenance and return-to-service documentation for accuracy and regulatory compliance.

  • Ability to communicate aircraft status and maintenance progress clearly to operational, technical, customer, and leadership stakeholders.

  • Valid driver’s license.

  • Ability to work additional or nonstandard hours when required by aircraft operations or AOG events.

  • Ability to travel to CONUS locations as needed, including MRO and field locations.

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.

  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Desired Skills

The following qualifications are preferred:

  • Avionics maintenance or troubleshooting experience.

  • Current FAA Inspection Authorization (IA).

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in aviation maintenance, aerospace, engineering, or a related field.

  • Current maintenance experience on King Air 250 and/or King Air 350 airframes.

  • Experience supporting Part 135 operations, government aviation programs, aerial firefighting, or special-mission aircraft.

  • Experience coordinating AOG response, vendor maintenance, parts procurement, and MRO activity.

  • Experience with aviation Safety Management Systems and continuous-improvement initiatives.

Leadership and Customer Expectations

  • Demonstrate sound judgment, professionalism, and accountability in support of safe aircraft operations.

  • Maintain timely and effective communications with customers, pilots, maintenance providers, vendors, and internal leadership.

  • Coordinate across functional teams to support aircraft availability and timely return to service.

  • Promote a culture of safety, quality, compliance, and continuous improvement.

  • Handle time-sensitive maintenance and AOG matters with urgency and appropriate escalation.

Supervisory Responsibility

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibility. The role provides functional oversight, coordination, and technical guidance to maintenance providers and program personnel as required.

Work Environment and Schedule

This is a remote position that requires a dedicated home-office workspace and routine use of standard office and communications equipment. Work hours will be aligned with assigned aircraft operating schedules and may include rotating AOG coverage, evenings, weekends, holidays, or additional hours based on operational needs.

  • Approximately 0% - 20% CONUS travel.

  • Occasional travel to field locations, MRO facilities, and the Tenax corporate office.

  • Onsite MRO oversight when required.

  • Work in office, aircraft hangar, flight-line, and maintenance environments.

  • Potential exposure to aircraft operations, machinery, elevated noise levels, weather conditions, and other aviation-maintenance hazards.

Compensation and Benefits

Tenax offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to attract, retain, and reward experienced aviation professionals. Individual compensation is determined based on relevant experience, education, certifications, internal equity, contract requirements, geographic considerations, and business needs.

Reasonable Accommodation

Tenax provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.

Applicants who require an accommodation to access the application system, complete an application, or participate in the hiring process may submit a request through our Applicant Accommodation Process:

Reasonable Accommodation Request - Fill Out Form

Equal Employment Opportunity

Tenax is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

Why Join Tenax?

At Tenax, you will support meaningful aviation missions, work with experienced maintenance and operations professionals, and contribute directly to aircraft safety, availability, and mission success. This role offers the opportunity to apply your technical expertise across special-mission King Air programs while helping strengthen fleet reliability and customer support.

E-VERIFY

Tenax participates in E-Verify for employees covered by applicable legal or federal-contract requirements.

Tenax is an Equal Opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees.

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description:
OUR COMPANY

As an early mover in the in-space transportation and infrastructure services, Momentus is at the forefront of the commercialization of space. With an experienced team of aerospace, propulsion, and robotics engineers, Momentus has developed a cost-effective and energy-efficient in-space transport system.

OUR PEOPLE

Daring problems require daring solutions. We boldly charge into uncharted territory knowing that no matter the outcome we will benefit from the journey and move closer to our goals no matter what. Our teams know that working at Momentus means more than building innovative technology, it means creating entirely new markets in the space economy. We are level-headed, business-minded strategic thinkers intent on providing immediate value to our customers today while simultaneously preparing for the vast possibilities of the future. If this sounds like you, we should talk.

JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to operate the cloud infrastructure our engineering teams depend on today and to build its successor from the ground up. The current environment spans AWS, Kubernetes, and CI. The next one is a new AWS GovCloud organization defined entirely as code, with the networking, identity, and software supply chain that a regulated engineering organization needs.

You will keep the existing environment healthy while the new one takes shape, then move workloads into it. You will also run the tooling that gives our engineers governed access to AI models and coding agents. This is a building role on a small team, and the scope is broad by design. You will not maintain a compliance binder; you will turn security requirements into code that produces its own evidence.

Preference for this role to be onsite but will consider hybrid and remote candidates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate and improve our existing AWS environments, Kubernetes clusters, and CI platform, and migrate workloads into the new organization as it comes online
  • Build a new multi-account AWS GovCloud organization as code
  • Build and operate segmented network planes: Transit Gateway, Firewalls, IPAM, PrivateLink, and VPNs to our facilities
  • Deliver secure environment ingress / egress
  • Own the software supply chain from commit to cluster: CI/CD runner fleets, FIPS-validated images, signed artifacts, replicated registries, private PKI
  • Partner with security and compliance to translate NIST SP 800-171 and CMMC controls into automated guardrails and evidence, and to triage and burn down security findings
  • Write clear design notes, merge request reviews, and runbooks, and help improve the shared AI-assisted workflows the team uses every day
  • Roll out and support AI developer tooling (Claude Code and similar) with managed settings, and review, harden, and operate the MCP servers and agent runtimes our teams depend on

Required Skills and Experience

  • Production Terraform or OpenTofu: reusable modules, state management, imports and refactors, and careful plan review
  • Proficiency in Python and/or Go, plus shell scripting
  • Clear, concise technical writing
  • Deep hands-on AWS experience in a multi-account organization: IAM policy evaluation, Organizations and service control policies, and Identity Center or equivalent federation with an external IDP
  • Cloud networking you can debug under pressure: VPC design, Transit Gateway routing and segmentation, firewalls and inspection, DNS, PrivateLink, and site-to-site VPN with BGP; you can answer “why can’t X talk to Y” across accounts
  • CI/CD and container supply chain experience, including image builds, signing and verification, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning
  • Hands-on experience running access to a hosted model service (Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or similar) or an LLM gateway
  • Experience with AI coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent), with a working understanding of its risks: prompt injection, excessive agency, token and secret exposure, and untrusted tool servers

Desired Skills and Experience

  • AWS GovCloud experience, or work inside FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, or ITAR-controlled environments
  • Greenfield landing-zone or account-vending work, including AWS Network Firewall and IPAM
  • Private PKI (for example AWS Private CA), HSM-backed key management, and mTLS
  • Service mesh (Istio or similar) and GitOps tooling (Argo CD, Flux, or similar)
  • LLM gateway operations (LiteLLM or equivalent), per-user cost attribution, and model invocation logging
  • Building or securing MCP servers and agent workflows
  • Shared AI workflows you built that other engineers adopted: hooks, commands, rules files, skills, or agent pipelines
  • Operating Kubernetes in production, preferably EKS
  • FIPS 140-3 validated cryptography and hardened container images
  • Experience in aerospace, defense, or other export-controlled programs
  • Previous experience working on DoD and other USG development and deployment programs
  • Ability to hold and maintain a USG Security Clearance

Education & Work Experience

  • BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 7+ years in infrastructure, platform, security, or site reliability engineering, including 3+ years building on AWS with infrastructure as code

Annual Base Salary Range: $190,000.00 - $225,000.00/per year

Your actual base salary will be determined on job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Our benefit plans include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k retirement plan, short and long term disability and life insurance. We also offer flexible PTO, along with 11 paid holidays, sick time and paid parental leave.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer - ExamDeveloper

About Pearson

About ExamDeveloper

ExamDeveloper is a web-based exam development platform that allows our customers to write, review, and manage questions for their exams (https://www.pearsonvue.com/us/en/test-owners/develop.html). ExamDeveloper is a leading web-based tool for creating tests that certify test-takers in the professional skills they need. Customers rely on ExamDeveloper to support their full workflow around question writing, collaborative review, scoring, and test management.

Summary

As a Senior Software Engineer, you are a highly skilled individual contributor and a technical authority within your area. You lead the design, implementation, optimization, and support of complex software components, services, and platforms that enable key business capabilities and customer experiences.

Working with significant independence, you evaluate technical options, guide design decisions, identify risks, and build scalable, maintainable, resilient solutions. You are frequently consulted on architecture reviews, performance optimization, operational stability, and complex problem resolution. You lead through expertise rather than formal authority — mentoring engineers, improving practices, and helping teams make sound technical and release decisions. You partner closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Product Architects, Quality Engineering, and DevOps to deliver secure, reliable, and highly scalable solutions.

Key responsibilities

Technical leadership (through expertise)

  • Lead design and implementation for complex software components, services, and platforms.
  • Drive technical decision-making for major features and engineering initiatives.
  • Influence software architecture, design patterns, and engineering standards within your domain.
  • Lead technical design sessions and contribute to architectural discussions with Product Architects.
  • Mentor and coach engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.
  • Participate in interviews to help assess and hire engineering talent.
  • Communicate technical direction, tradeoffs, and risks clearly to stakeholders outside your immediate team.


Software development

  • Design and deliver enterprise-scale, secure, maintainable, and scalable software solutions.
  • Evaluate design alternatives and recommend approaches balancing value, risk, performance, and maintainability.
  • Lead complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for critical production issues.
  • Identify and mitigate technical debt, performance bottlenecks, reliability concerns, and operational risk.


Quality, delivery, and collaboration

  • Champion engineering best practices across testing, automation, deployment, observability, and security.
  • Partner with Quality Engineering to advance quality-by-design and automation.
  • Support release planning, deployment, and operational readiness.
  • Contribute to roadmap planning, technical estimation, and platform modernization.


Required education and experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading the design and delivery of complex, distributed systems.
  • Experience providing technical leadership and mentorship within Agile engineering teams.
  • Experience designing and operating within cloud-native environments.


Technology stack

This is the current stack for the team you would join. Direct experience is preferred, and strong experience with comparable languages, frameworks, and toolsets will also be considered.

  • .NET / C#
  • Angular, including an in-house Angular-based UI framework
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Containerized services orchestrated by Kubernetes
  • Microsoft SQL Server and relational databases
  • AI-assisted development tools, as provided by Pearson


Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities

  • Strong software design and system architecture skills.
  • Experience building highly available and scalable enterprise applications.
  • Cloud-based DevOps workflows, CI/CD, application security, observability, and performance engineering.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering capability.
  • Familiarity with LLMs / ML concepts and practical use of AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day engineering work, preferred.
  • Experience supporting accessibility compliance and WCAG standards, preferred.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including explaining technical tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.


Success measures

  • Delivers complex technical solutions that support critical business objectives.
  • Builds software with strong reliability, maintainability, scalability, security, and performance.
  • Influences technical direction through sound engineering judgment and well-supported recommendations.
  • Is sought out by other engineers for guidance on difficult technical problems.
  • Improves the capability of the broader engineering team through mentorship.
  • Contributes to hiring quality through active participation in the interview process.
  • Communicates technical concepts and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders outside engineering, building trust and alignment.
  • Identifies and addresses technical risks before they impact delivery, operations, or customers.


Leadership behaviors

Customer Centricity Anticipates customer needs by designing solutions that improve reliability, usability, performance, and scalability.

Raise the Performance Bar Sets a high standard for engineering quality and continuously explores better tools, frameworks, and approaches.

Exceptional Collaboration for Value Builds strong technical partnerships and helps teams make better decisions through knowledge sharing and constructive challenge.

Our Leaders Inspire Leads through credibility, expertise, and mentorship, creating an environment where engineers grow and solve hard problems together.

Location & Working Pattern

India. Bangalore is the preferred location and Chennai is an option. Exact hybrid attendance requirements will be shared during the recruitment process.

Why Join Pearson?

This is an opportunity to develop engineering talent, strengthen delivery and quality practices, and help teams adopt emerging AI-assisted ways of working across technology that supports assessment experiences at scale.

title: Crisis Helpline Clinician - Night Shift
description:
Olympic Health and Recovery Services is seeking a clinician to join our Crisis Helpline team! Do you have an empathetic listening ear and strong clinical skills? This could be the role for you!

The Crisis Helpline Clinician provides clinical support to the Crisis Services Program of Olympic Health and Recovery Services (OHRS), a licensed behavioral health agency. The primary responsibilities of the Crisis Helpline Clinician are to respond to callers in both the Regional Crisis Line (RCL) and the Washington State 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, delivering 24/7/365 crisis intervention services via phone, text, and chat. This position will be conducting suicide and safety risk assessments, developing stabilization plans, dispatching mobile crisis teams, and coordinating referrals to Designated Crisis Responders (DCRs), emergency services, and community resources. The Crisis Helpline Clinician responds to individuals across multiple Washington regions and helps ensure callers receive timely, compassionate, and culturally responsive crisis care.

This position has the ability for hybrid work from home options with satisfactory completion of training and continued demonstration of proficiency.

Salary Range: $27.72 - $36.45 per hour. DOE. This position is eligible for shift differential ($1/HR evenings, $3/HR weekends and nights).

Available Schedules:

  • Saturday-Tuesday 7pm-5am

Join us in our mission to provide access to an effective, reliable safety net of behavioral health crisis and recovery support services throughout our region.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Crisis Line Response - RCL & 988:

  • Promptly answer incoming RCL and 988 calls, texts, or chats to gather relevant information and determine immediate safety needs.
  • Conduct risk assessments and evaluate urgency to determine appropriate level of intervention.
  • Provide crisis intervention, emotional support, de escalation, and trauma informed care to individuals experiencing mental health, substance use, emotional distress, or safety concerns.
  • Manage multiple concurrent crisis contacts in a calm, professional, and empathetic manner.
  • Develop crisis stabilization and safety plans collaboratively with callers and their natural supports.

Triage, Dispatch & Care Coordination:

  • Triage callers to community resources, outpatient providers, DCRs, mobile crisis teams, and 911 when clinically indicated.
  • Dispatch mobile crisis teams when callers present with urgent behavioral health or safety concerns requiring in person assessment or intervention, following Washington’s regional crisis system protocols.
  • Provide warm handoffs and seamless care coordination with crisis outreach teams and regional crisis service partners throughout Washington.
  • Direct individuals to specialized 988 services including Veterans Line, Spanish Line, Youth Line, and the Native & Strong Lifeline when appropriate.
  • Support callers who are unhoused unstably housed, or seeking linkages to medical, behavioral health, or social service resources.

Documentation & Compliance:

  • Complete timely and accurate documentation in the electronic health record in accordance with Washington State law, crisis line best practices, and confidentiality regulations (42 CFR, 45 CFR).
  • Utilize web based 988 and crisis line systems for documentation and reporting.
  • Follow all agency policies, WAC requirements, and national 988 Lifeline standards for crisis contact response and quality assurance.

Follow Up, Monitoring & Ongoing Support:

  • Conduct follow up calls as clinically indicated to support stabilization, ensure safety, and assist callers in engaging with recommended care.
  • Collaborate with families, providers, and crisis teams to reduce barriers to follow up care and support ongoing stabilization activities.

Professional Collaboration:

  • Consult with other agency clinicians and interdisciplinary team members on complex or high risk cases.
  • Communicate clearly and effectively with coworkers in a dynamic, fast paced crisis environment.
  • Support RCL, 988, ITA, and crisis team program deliverables, including encounter tracking, quality improvement, and compliance with state and regional requirements.

BENEFITS:

TMBH-ASO/OHRS provides comprehensive benefits for part time (0.5 FTE or greater) and full-time employees including medical/dental/vision plan options (many with low employee paid monthly premium depending on plan choice, and dependent coverage options), and life insurance and disability insurance options. Eligible employees participate in WA State PERS retirement plans and employees may elect additional pre and post-tax deferred compensation retirement options. Employees receive a PTO package earning a minimum of 140 hours annually for full time employees (part time accrual pro-rated based on FTE) and 12 paid holidays. Other tax deferred options include Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), and Health Savings Accounts (HSA).

OHRS is an approved Public Student Loan Forgiveness employer. We pay the fees for required DOH licenses for the position, and we offer annual professional development funds. Find more information at www.tmbhcareers.org.

An honest audit of the security policies, data model integrity, error handling and edge cases: anything that won't hold up once 50 real women are using it with real health data. I want the truth, not reassurance. Build support from November. Helping finish and extend the product: the admin console, member portrait and protocol screens, the check-in loop, and an assistant grounded in each member's own plan using the Claude API. From 2027, depending on fit: automated extraction of lab PDF values, assisted protocol generation, a native mobile app and payment integration. Why on-site

This is a small, fast-moving build with real health data and a hard launch date. I want to work side by side with you in Doha, at QSTP, so we can test with real members together.

What is essential Based in Doha Strong React and Type Script Real Postgres and Supabase experience, especially row-level security. This is the highest-risk area of the product. You have shipped and maintained a production application, not only prototypes You can work with a non-technical founder: explaining trade-offs plainly and saying clearly when something is a bad idea Strongly preferred Arabic or RTL internationalisation experience Experience with health or other sensitive, regulated data, and an understanding of why privacy cannot be added later Comfort working inside an AI-generated codebase without wanting to rewrite it on sight The disposition that matters most

Someone who improves what exists rather than replacing it. The codebase was built with AI assistance, but it has real conventions, documented decisions and deliberate architecture behind it. Starting over would cost the project its timeline.

Engagement Freelance or contract to start Could grow into a founding technical role for the right person On-site in Doha English required, Arabic useful

Job Overview

As an Asset Protection Detective, you will help protect company assets, reduce shortage, and support a safe, customer-focused shopping environment. Using surveillance, investigative tools, and strong partnerships with store teams and law enforcement, you will identify and respond to theft, recover merchandise, and help protect our customers, colleagues, and business.

Why This Role Matters

Asset Protection Detectives play an important role in reducing loss while maintaining a safe and welcoming store environment. Through training, observation, investigation, and de-escalation, this role helps protect company assets, support colleagues, and ensure customers can shop with confidence.

How Our Asset Protection Colleagues Spend Their Day…

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What To Expect

  • Apply de-escalation tools and sound judgment to help maintain a safe environment for customers and colleagues.

  • Prepare clear documentation, statements, and evidence to support investigations, audits, and legal proceedings.

  • Support team readiness by training colleagues on protocols that help protect company assets.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Help protect customers, colleagues, and company assets by identifying, investigating, and responding to theft and dishonest activity.

  • Use surveillance techniques to support the apprehension of shoplifters and dishonest employees, while following company policies and legal requirements.

  • Recover stolen merchandise and provide statements, evidence, and documentation to support investigations.

  • Prepare timely and accurate reports related to theft incidents, investigations, audits, and assigned activities.

  • Build strong partnerships with store colleagues, Asset Protection leaders, and law enforcement to support investigations and shortage reduction.

  • Maintain compliance with company policies and legal standards related to apprehensions, searches, and evidence preservation.

  • Testify in court for criminal and civil cases, as needed.

  • Respond to alarm calls, support special assignments, and facilitate first aid for customers and colleagues when needed.

  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills That Matter

Must Have

  • Ability to observe, identify, and respond to suspicious activity in a retail environment.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with customers, colleagues, leaders, and law enforcement.

  • Ability to use sound judgment, de-escalation tools, and company procedures to support a safe environment.

  • Ability to handle proprietary, sensitive, and confidential information with discretion and integrity.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, customer service, asset protection, security, investigations, or law enforcement.

  • Ability to prepare accurate reports, statements, and documentation related to incidents and investigations.

  • Experience using surveillance systems, reporting tools, or investigative technology.

  • Ability to train or coach colleagues on asset protection protocols, shortage reduction, or safety practices.

Physical Activities You Will Perform

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

  • Position requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around store or department.

  • May occasionally involve reaching above eye level, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.

  • Must be able to apprehend shoplifters.

  • Ability to sustain long periods of time enclosed in surveillance areas.

  • Frequently lift/move up to 30lbs.

  • Requires close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.
