title: Creative Design & Website Associate
description:
United We Dream (UWD) is the largest immigrant youth-led community in the country. We create welcoming spaces for young people – regardless of immigration status – to make their voices heard and win victories so that all people can live free and thrive. We recruit, support, engage and empower young people and are creating a new generation of social justice leaders to change our world.

Our powerful network is made up of 1 million members, 100+ local groups across 28 states, and we reach over 5 million people online every month. We celebrate our diversity and believe in multi-ethnic, multi-racial, inter-generational intersectional solutions. Over 60% of our members are womxn and 20% identify as LGBTQ.

Whether we’re organizing in the streets, building innovative technology systems, opening doors for LGBTQ immigrant youth, clearing pathways to education, stopping deportations, or creating alliances across social movements, United We Dream puts undocumented immigrant youth in the driver’s seat. United We Dream is a fast-paced, dynamic organization which has become a leading voice in social change and has appeared in every major news outlet in the country.

We are driven by the priorities and needs of our members; have trained thousands of individuals; and have supported countless local organizing groups. Today, United We Dream is arguably the most influential immigrant rights organization in the nation and a leading driver of progressive politics and strategy. Our brand is known around the world and we are proud to be driven by the hopes, dreams, decisions, and brilliance of directly impacted young people.

POSITION SUMMARY

UWD is seeking a savvy Creative Design & Website Associate who will play a key role in shaping the visual identity of UWD’s brand and digital presence. This cross-disciplinary position supports the development of compelling content across social platforms, websites, campaigns, and member materials. You’ll bring stories to life through eye-catching design, functional web experiences, and creative innovation that supports movement building.

You will be a core member of the Narrative Team, collaborating on digital storytelling, design, and development from start to finish — including ideation, user experience design, branding, development, and deployment. You’ll support UWD’s core campaigns through digital content, rapid response visuals, and the creation of branded assets. You’ll also design swag and printed materials for our member base, helping foster a sense of identity, unity, and pride.

You’ll manage UWD’s website ecosystem, including updates, maintenance, and the creation of new websites aligned with campaign and organizational goals. This role requires a unique blend of design intuition, technical skill, and a strong sense of social justice storytelling. You're a detail-oriented designer and a web-savvy builder who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Graphic Design & Content Creation

  • Design engaging static and short-form video content for UWD’s social media platforms, campaigns, and rapid response moments on a daily basis.
  • Create design assets for internal and external use, including but not limited to: social media toolkits, printed materials/flyers, reports for funders, presentations, digital/graphic design trainings for members, etc.
  • Develop branded campaign visuals, merchandise, and materials for UWD’s member base, helping to foster identity and belonging.

Website & Digital Experience

  • Manage and maintain UWD’s website properties, ensuring high performance, accessibility, and alignment with current best practices.
  • Build new campaign-specific or organizing-focused websites and landing pages that support movement goals and user needs.
  • Lead the entire web project lifecycle from ideation to launch—including brainstorming, wireframing, visual/UI design, front-end and back-end development, and deployment.
  • Implement technical SEO and AEO best practices to maximize reach and visibility.

Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration

  • Collaborate with leaders across departments to ensure content is compelling, accessible, and aligned across platforms.
  • Provide design and web development expertise to cross-team projects, including storytelling initiatives, petitions, and digital organizing tools.
  • Collaborate with movement partners on relevant digital and social media needs, especially for campaigns involving multiple partner organizations.

Social Media & Digital Community

  • Contribute to the team’s social media presence and growth by helping ideate, create, schedule, and publish content across key platforms, including writing clear and engaging captions.
  • Support social listening efforts by monitoring online trends, brand mentions, and audience conversations and sharing relevant insights with the team.
  • Assist with managing the social media management platform, including maintaining and updating content calendars and basic performance tracking.
  • Track and complete the organization’s monthly social media metrics and observations to help guide ongoing content and communication efforts.
  • Build and manage relationships with external social media consultants, agencies, and influencers when needed to support campaigns and ongoing initiatives.

Brand Stewardship

  • Maintain visual consistency across all digital and print materials in alignment with UWD’s brand guidelines.
  • Contribute to evolving and expanding UWD’s brand through fresh, movement-centered creative ideas.
  • Ensure timely and accurate organization of our digital and archival assets through UWD’s Google Drive and Dropbox systems

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED

  • Must demonstrate exceptional creativity and adaptability, as responsibilities within this role are subject to evolution and program objectives may shift. This requires a proactive approach to learning new skills and embracing unforeseen challenges to ensure continuous contribution and success.
  • At least 3 years of professional experience in graphic design, website management, and/or front-end development (nonprofit or movement space preferred).
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating proficiency and creativity in visual design, branding, and web development projects.
  • Skilled in Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in front-end development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript); experience with CMS platforms like WordPress or Webflow.
  • Understanding of UX/UI principles and ability to translate wireframes into responsive, accessible designs.
  • Experience with back-end development or WordPress customization is a plus.
  • Familiar with SEO and AEO principles and best practices for web performance.
  • Creative and innovative with a deep understanding of visual storytelling and digital culture to reach UWD/UWDA’s core audience(s).
  • Excellent time management, attention to detail, and ability to meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative and solutions-oriented team player.
  • Commitment to immigrant justice and UWD’s values.
  • Experience with motion graphics or video editing.

BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)

  • Familiarity with digital advocacy tools (e.g., EveryAction, Action Network).
  • Fluency in Spanish.
  • Comfortability and demonstrated strength in recording direct-to-camera videos of yourself for social media.

Compensation

Salary Range: $64,260 - 81,600.00

We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a hands-on Infrastructure Security Engineer to build and secure SpaceXAI’s infrastructure from the bare-metal layer up through the platform and application stack. In this role, you will design, implement, and harden physical and private-cloud foundations—servers, networks, identity, and orchestration—and carry that security posture into containers, automation, and hybrid connectivity with public cloud.

This role focuses on securing critical infrastructure spanning data centers, colo, and hybrid environments, with work that may span platforms such as SpaceXAI, X Social, X Money, and related systems. You’ll operate with an automation-first mindset: building secure foundations at the metal and OS layer, hardening platforms at scale, and partnering closely with engineering so security is embedded in how we build and run systems—not bolted on after the fact.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Bare metal, data center & network security

  • Design and implement secure bare-metal and private-cloud architectures (servers, storage, out-of-band management, BIOS/UEFI/BMC firmware posture)
  • Harden physical and virtual fleets: OS baselines (Linux/Windows), CIS benchmarks, patch and vulnerability management, and secure boot / measured boot where applicable
  • Hands-on firmware, BMC/iDRAC/iLO, PXE/Kickstart provisioning, and hardware lifecycle security
  • Build and secure network foundations: segmentation, load balancers, DNS, PKI, NAC, and IDS/IPS on real hardware
  • Own hybrid connectivity between on-premises and cloud (site-to-site VPN, Direct Connect / Interconnect / ExpressRoute, SD-WAN, zero-trust access)
  • Manage identities and privileged access across Active Directory / LDAP / Kerberos and cloud IAM (federation, SAML/OIDC, PAM)
  • Assist with security assessments and audits of physical, on-premises, and hybrid infrastructure
  • Monitor and remediate infrastructure to comply with regulations and best practices (e.g., PCI, NIST CSF, GDPR, HIPAA)

Platform, containers & developer enablement

  • Design and implement secure container and Kubernetes standards on bare metal and private cloud (not only managed EKS/GKE/AKS), including RBAC, network policy, and secrets
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code and configuration management—especially Puppet—with embedded security controls for physical and virtual fleets
  • Collaborate with development teams so security best practices are integrated into CI/CD pipelines
  • Secure and enhance CI/CD pipelines; integrate and maintain code and image scanning platforms

Detection, operations & tooling

  • Monitor and respond to security events and incidents spanning bare metal, network devices, hosts, and hybrid cloud
  • Maintain SIEM data pipelines that ingest on-premises network, host, and cloud telemetry for reliable alerting
  • Build, deploy, and maintain security operations infrastructure using Python, Terraform, and Puppet
  • Develop dashboards and alerts from security metrics across physical and platform layers
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure security policies, standards, and procedures from metal through platform
  • Own security projects end to end: identify issues and implement solutions
  • Stay current with emerging threats and mitigations for bare-metal, firmware, network, and hybrid-cloud infrastructure

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field
  • 3–5 years of experience in infrastructure security, platform security, or related hands-on roles
  • Proven experience securing bare-metal, data-center, or private-cloud environments (not cloud-only resumes)
  • Hands-on experience with firmware, BMC/iDRAC/iLO, PXE/Kickstart provisioning, and hardware lifecycle security
  • Strong proficiency with Puppet for configuration management and fleet hardening in production
  • Strong understanding of network security concepts and protocols, including hands-on work with firewalls, segmentation, and hybrid connectivity
  • Experience with hybrid identity (AD/LDAP or similar) integrated or federated with cloud IAM
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) applied to physical or VM fleets
  • Familiarity with containerization and Kubernetes security implications, including on-premises or bare-metal clusters
  • Experience with languages (e.g., Python, Bash and Golang) for automation and tool development
  • Familiarity with regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, NIST CSF)
  • Experience in banking, money transmission, P2P payments, or similarly regulated financial platforms
  • Proactive mindset with strong ownership, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills
  • Located in the SF Bay Area, Austin, New York, Palo Alto, or Seattle, or willing to relocate to a US office

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Deep expertise operating and securing physical server fleets, colo, or private cloud (VMware, OpenStack, Proxmox, Nutanix, or similar)
  • Relevant security certifications (e.g., CCSP, CSSK, OSCP, network or cloud security specialty)
  • Strong proficiency with Python and Terraform on production fleets
  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes and container security on bare metal or private cloud
  • Experience with multi-cloud and cloud-to-on-prem security
  • Knowledge of CI/CD best practices and tools; hands-on GitHub Actions or equivalent
  • Experience with observability and security operations tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Karma; SIEM platforms such as Wazuh)
  • Experience building custom security tools or integrations
  • Interest in leveraging AI for infrastructure security monitoring and automation
  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure or security projects
  • Experience securing AI/ML and GPU workloads on bare metal or hybrid infrastructure

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

$100,000 - $258,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

title: Software Developer & AI Automation Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Safeguards and Security Solutions Enablement team is part of the Safeguards and Security Directorate, formed to refine how the organization operates and to keep the Laboratory secure while enabling mission attainment. The team works like an internal digital creative agency, built around a single ethos: are we making it easier to be an employee, a manager, and a professional at INL, with a focus on continuous improvement. Safeguards and Security Solutions Enablement consolidates five disciplines: Systems Strategy, Business Analysis, AI & Automation Engineering, UX Research & Design, and Data Analytics. You're joining a small group that wears multiple hats, closer to a team of trained operatives than a five-department org chart. The Power Platform & AI Automation Engineer role lives inside AI & Automation Engineering, the team's build engine, translating discovery work into delivered application and automation products.

This is not a heads-down coding role, nor is it a throw-it-over-the-fence one. You observe teams closely to discover how work actually happens. The nuanced details of work often remain unknown or misunderstood, yet these details can be what matters most. You'll document customer needs through wireframes, diagrams, or user stories, whatever facilitates rapid understanding. From there, you iterate through tangible drafts and honest feedback, with an eye on the minimum viable product, working agilely rather than by waterfall and without being beholden to a completely nailed-down requirements set. The same requirement elicitor stays present through delivery, checking in throughout the short cycles instead of disappearing and reappearing at the end. Skip these methods, and we risk automating a bad process, which is the same bad process, just faster.

Here's your mission: you're not a one-trick automation pony. You understand the business well enough to know that not every need is an automation. Sometimes the right fix is a workflow. Sometimes it's recognizing that a new system is the real answer, and when that's the case, you're all over it, vetting the options, meeting with internal teams to gather requirements, working directly with vendors, and staying engaged through implementation so the actual underlying problem gets solved.

This role owns full-stack solution delivery, with the Microsoft platform as the default toolset: C#/.NET and ASP.NET MVC. But the platform serves the solution, not the other way around. When the problem calls for a Python web app in Django or Flask, a .NET service, or even the discovery of an appropriate third-party solution, you'll help there too. Layered on top is real AI engineering: Python, generative AI, prompt engineering, and agentic automation through tools like Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude, and other custom platforms as the work demands.

We're hiring for this role because demand for continual optimization is real and only growing. And none of this is order-taking: success means the people you serve end up more efficient, produce higher-quality work, and genuinely enjoy their jobs more, not just that a ticket got closed.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities: (Knowledge, skills, and behaviors required for this position.)

Discovery & Business Analysis

  • Meet face-to-face and observe how work actually happens, not just how it gets described. What people say they do and what they actually do are often different, and the small details left out are frequently the insights that matter most.
  • Elicit and document requirements through interviews and working sessions, translating what a team asks for into what they actually need. "Documented" might mean a wireframe, a diagram, or a user story, whatever is clear enough to execute on without relying on tribal knowledge.
  • Wireframe and prototype early and throughout, using tools like Lucid or Figma for process maps, wireframes, and data modeling when it helps, so stakeholders are reacting to something tangible within days rather than approving a written spec weeks before anything visible exists.
  • Catch a bad process before automating it, since automating a bad process doesn't solve anything.
  • Stay with the customer through delivery, checking in on working builds at short, regular intervals and refining requirements as understanding deepens rather than locking them in at kickoff and signing off.
  • Understand full workstreams, not just isolated requests, and proactively surface opportunities to streamline them, increasing efficiency, quality, and job satisfaction for the people doing the work every day.
  • Vet whether automation or a new system is the right fix, and when it's the latter, meet with internal teams to gather requirements, work directly with vendors, and stay engaged through implementation so the actual underlying problem gets solved.
  • Work with process owners across the organization to plan and sequence solutions against real backlogs, not hypothetical requests.
  • Collaborate closely with the team's other disciplines, Systems Strategy, UX Research & Design, and Data Analytics, so that nothing you build recreates the silos this team exists to remove.

Build & Engineering

  • Build features and services with C#/.NET (currently .NET 10) and ASP.NET MVC.
  • Write integrations with other systems using Python.
  • Craft responsive user interfaces with React, TypeScript, and Bootstrap that are accessible, performant, and maintainable.
  • Sign and optimize schemas, queries, and stored procedures for SQL Server, focusing on reliability, integrity, and performance.
  • Use AI coding assistants responsibly to accelerate development: write effective prompts, review and test AI-suggested code, and follow team guardrails for secure, compliant use.
  • Participate in design reviews, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos, maintaining clear documentation and traceability.
  • Follow Agile practices using the Scrum methodology and participate in all ceremonies, stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives. Track work using Jira.
  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; contribute to CI/CD pipelines; and uphold secure coding practices consistent with laboratory standards.
  • Support operations by triaging issues, performing root-cause analysis, and delivering incremental fixes that minimize risk.

Education, Credentials, and Work Experience:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, engineering, or a related field. Equivalent related experience may be considered in lieu of degree requirement.
  • Level 3: Bachelor of Science degree in technical field including Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or related field and 5 years of relevant experience; or a Master’s in a technical field and 2 years of relevant experience; or in lieu of a degree High School diploma or equivalent and at least 11 years of direct/professional experience.
  • Level 4: Bachelor's Degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology or related field and at least 9 years of direct professional experience; or in lieu of a degree High School diploma or equivalent and at least 15 years of direct/professional experience.
  • Obtain and maintain a Department of Energy "Q" clearance, which requires US Citizenship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows.
  • Experience integrating authentication and authorization (OIDC, Microsoft Entra ID, or similar) in web apps.
  • Experience building or integrating features with enterprise LLM services; familiarity with responsible AI practices in regulated environments.
  • Exposure to Azure and containerization.
  • Professional experience mentoring others and leading technical tasks.
  • Experience using JIRA or similar tool.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and NET WebAPI interfaces.
  • Experience with continuous integration, and deployment using Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with other React JS
  • Experience with Agile, Scrum and Kanban development methodologies.
  • Experience with JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this classification, the employee may be required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, kneel, bend, use hands to handle materials, manipulate tools, keyboard, and type, reach with hands and arms, and operate job-related equipment. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds with assistance. Sufficient visual acuity and hearing capacity to perform the essential functions and interact with the public is required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Information:

  • Our team works a 9x80 schedule out of Idaho Falls facility.
  • The pay range for this position is: Level 3 ($95,256 - $195,288) / Level 4 ($114,360 - $234,336). At Idaho National Laboratory compensation decisions are determined using factors such as education, relevant experience, and other credentials.
  • Multi-Level: These are multi-level positions, and you will be placed at the appropriate level dependent on depth and breadth of proven experience and skills.

Working Conditions:

The work environment is an office environment. The noise level is generally low; however, may be exposed to loud noises on occasion. Position requires working more than 8 hours/day and working alone. Position may be required to work irregular hours.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and levels of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

Security and Privacy Language:
This position includes information security and privacy responsibilities as defined by NIST SP 800 53, OMB Circular A 130, and DOE Order 206.1A. Position must complete initial and annual role-specific training as required. The incumbent must sign and comply with all required access agreements prior to being granted access to organizational systems or data. Comply with all applicable information security and privacy policies and procedures by following established protocols, with an understanding that non-compliance may result in sanctions.

Level Definers

EX3 – Career:

  • Knowledge: Complete understanding and wide application of principles, theories, and concepts in field of specialization. General knowledge of other related disciplines. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This level is fully qualified, career oriented.

  • Problem Solving: Works on problems of diverse scope. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Solutions are imaginative, thorough, practical, and consistent with organizational objectives.

  • Discretion and Latitude: Works under only general direction. Normally receives little instruction day-to-day. Independently determines and develops approach to solutions. Work is reviewed upon completion for adequacy in meeting objectives.

  • Impacts: Contributes to completion of specific programs and projects. Failure to obtain results or erroneous decisions or recommendations would typically result in program delays.

  • Liaison: Frequent internal organizational customer contacts. May have some outside contact or represent organization in providing solutions to difficult issues associated with specific projects or work.

  • Education/Experience: Bachelor’s and 5 years. Master’s and 2 years. PhD and 2 years.

EX4 – Senior:

  • Knowledge: Technical leader with a high degree of knowledge in the overall field and recognized expertise in specific areas. Has wide-ranging experience. Uses professional concepts and company objectives to solve complex issues in creative and effective ways. Interfaces with and mentors junior staff.

  • Problem Solving: Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.

  • Discretion and Latitude: Work is performed without appreciable direction. Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel (Lead). Exercises considerable latitude in determining objectives of assignment.

  • Impacts: Guides the successful completion of major programs and may function in a project leadership role. Erroneous decisions or recommendations would typically result in failure to achieve organizational objectives.

  • Liaison: Represents organization as prime contact on projects or work. Interacts with senior internal personnel on significant matters often requiring coordination between organizations. Networks with key contacts outside own area or expertise.

  • Education/Experience: Bachelor’s and 9 years. Master’s and 6 years. PhD and 4 years.

title: Project Associate – Protection
description:
Introduction

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Applications are welcome from internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, internal and internal-equivalent candidates are considered as first-tier candidates.

Organizational Context and Scope

Under the overall supervision of the Chief of Mission (CoM) in Ireland, and the direct supervision of the National IBG and Protection Officer and, in collaboration with relevant units at Headquarters (HQ), in the Regional Office (RO) and relevant Country Offices (COs), the Project Associate – Protection will be responsible and accountable for providing assistance with the implementation IOM Ireland protection activities.

  1. Assist in the implementation and monitoring of protection activities, including but not limited to child protection and Counter Trafficking (CT) activities.

    activity topics.
  3. Act as focal point for the administrative coordination of activity implementation, liasing
    extensively with relevant organisational units and external parties to initiate and follow up on
    requests.
  4. Assist in organising training sessions; prepare training materials and participate in the delivering
    of capacity building workshops/ training.
  5. Verify the availability of funds, obtain the required clearances, initiate the relevant administrative
    processes, and follow up for completion in a timely manner.
  6. Draft status reports, identifying shortfalls, bring them to the attention of the supervisor and
    suggest remedial actions to address delivery gaps.
  7. Draft correspondence on project issues; prepare and update reports, briefing notes, graphics,
    statistical tables, presentation and other forms of documentation.
  8. Respond to complex information requests and inquiries; set up and maintain files/records, and
    organise meetings, workshops and training sessions.
  9. Participate in meetings, workshops and conferences; assist in coordinating activities with local
    authorities, partners, United Nation (UN) agencies, intergovernmental and non-governmental
    organisations, donors and other relevant stakeholders.

title: Design Desk Engineer (International)
description:
Job Description

The Design Desk Engineer is responsible for translating business and technical requirements into supportable solution designs and implementation-ready project documentation. The role supports solution design, proposal development, technical scoping, workplan creation, request triage, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement.

The Design Desk Engineer maintains broad project-engineering knowledge across server infrastructure, virtualization, networking, security, Microsoft 365, and Microsoft Azure cloud services. The role works with vCIO strategy, client business requirements, technical documentation, vendor documentation, established standards, and approved organizational resources to develop technically accurate and supportable solutions.

Approved AI-assisted engineering and proposal-generation tools are incorporated into the Design Desk workflow to improve the speed, consistency, completeness, and presentation of Statements of Work, solution architecture, executive summaries, proposal documentation, assumptions, and related design deliverables. The Design Desk Engineer remains accountable for validating sources, technical accuracy, feasibility, supportability, scope, and the final quality of every deliverable.

Job Responsibilities

  • Translate client business requirements and vCIO strategy into supportable solution architecture and implementation-ready project documentation.
  • Develop technical solutions, proposals, Statements of Work, workplans, business requirements, desired outcomes, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, prerequisites, milestones, and supporting design documentation.
  • Perform technical scoping and validate proposed solutions for technical accuracy, feasibility, supportability, scope alignment, licensing, dependencies, risks, labor logic, and implementation readiness.
  • Review incoming design requests for completeness and identify missing technical or business information before design work proceeds.
  • Validate relevant environment information, including user, workstation, mailbox, server, location, supporting documentation, and other applicable intake details.
  • Maintain clear ownership and documentation of assigned requests, including status, schedules, decisions, blockers, next steps, and stakeholder communication.
  • Communicate delays, blockers, scheduling changes, and issues that could affect client deliverables or stakeholder expectations.
  • Participate in Design Desk request triage, workload review, KPI awareness, and operational activities.
  • Prepare for and support vCIO discussions by documenting requirements, assumptions, risks, outcomes, and next steps.
  • Use approved templates, prior examples, technical references, vendor documentation, and organizational knowledge sources when developing solutions and project documentation.
  • Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate design and proposal development while independently reviewing and validating generated material.
  • Identify and correct unsupported content, technical inaccuracies, scope issues, and documentation quality concerns before deliverables are released.
  • Contribute to the ongoing improvement of Design Desk templates, documentation, intake forms, Design Library references, validation processes, prompts, automation workflows, and engineering standards.
  • Maintain documentation sufficiently detailed to allow another Design Desk Engineer to understand the status, previous actions, blockers, and next steps associated with a request.

Job Qualifications

Required Technical Skills

The Design Desk Engineer is expected to maintain well-rounded project-engineering capability across the following areas:

  • Microsoft 365
  • Microsoft Azure cloud services
  • Server infrastructure
  • Virtualization
  • Networking
  • Security technologies
  • Solution architecture and technical design
  • Technical scoping and implementation planning

The position requires sufficient technical depth to evaluate proposed designs, challenge or improve technical recommendations, identify risks and gaps, and validate AI-assisted design recommendations before they are incorporated into client-facing or project-facing deliverables.

Systems and Tools

The Design Desk Engineer regularly works with organizational platforms supporting technical design, documentation, request management, communication, and operational review, including:

  • ConnectWise PSA
  • Microsoft Teams
  • SharePoint Design Desk document libraries
  • IT Glue
  • MSPBots
  • Strety
  • Approved AI-assisted Design Desk engineering tools

Job KPI’s

Success in the Design Desk Engineer role is demonstrated through the following measures:

  • Request Ownership and Documentation: Consistent ownership and documentation of assigned design requests.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Clear, timely communication with stakeholders and team members.
  • Documentation Quality: Accurate, consistent, and supportable proposals, workplans, assumptions, exclusions, and deliverables.
  • Operational KPI Awareness: Awareness of workload, ticket aging, throughput, and applicable operational KPIs.
  • Team Participation: Active participation in team operating processes and continuous improvement activities.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering Validation: Responsible use of approved AI-assisted design workflows while maintaining independent engineering validation and ownership of final technical quality.
  • Continuous Improvement: Contributions that improve templates, documentation, processes, intake quality, automation, and Design Desk standards.

Job Requirements

  • A home office set up that meets the following:
    • Computer: A working computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM and one of the following:
      • Windows 11 with an Intel i5 or i7 (8th generation or newer), or
      • AMD Ryzen 5 or 7 (2000 series or newer), or
      • macOS 12 or newer.
    • Internet: Stable internet connection with at least 25 Mbps download and upload speeds.
    • Audio Equipment: A quality headset with a noise-cancellation feature for meetings.
    • Mobile Device: A smartphone capable of installing the Microsoft Authenticator app.
    • Webcam: An HD webcam for video calls.
    • 2nd Monitor
    • UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) if using a desktop (Not needed if using a laptop)
    • A very strong cultural fit the ITS way (Our core values will be discussed during the interview)
  • Excellent command of the English language both spoken and written
  • Able to work full time for 40 hrs. a week: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST (Monday to Friday)
  • Able to pass our online behavior and cognitive assessments.
  • Preferably, at least two of the following certifications: CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, 3cx Basic Certified Engineer.
  • Able to provide NBI Clearance (for PH applicants).

Compensation

Pay rates start at $8.16/hour and vary by experience and location.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Health Plans / HMO (Employee & Dependent/s)

title: Industrial Mechanical Technicians
description:
Company: GCP PAPER USA, Inc.

Location: Houston/New Caney, TX

Job Type: Full-Time, Salaried

FLSA Status: Exempt

Job Summary

Reporting to the Plant Engineering / Maintenance Manager, the Mechanical Engineer applies specialized engineering principles, mechanical theory, and technical analysis to optimize plant equipment reliability, continuous machinery performance, and industrial paper manufacturing processes. While maintaining a direct engineering presence on the active manufacturing floor to analyze machinery behavior and direct complex technical troubleshooting, this position’s primary function relies on advanced technical expertise, design evaluation, root cause investigation, and continuous engineering improvement projects.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Learned Engineering Analysis & Design: Apply advanced mechanical engineering concepts, fluid dynamics, heat transfer, and stress analysis to design, evaluate, and optimize continuous paper converting machinery and high-speed production systems.
  • Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA): Lead complex technical investigations and engineering failure analyses on critical equipment breakdowns; evaluate stress points, analyze failure modes, and design technical modifications to prevent recurrence.
  • Predictive & Reliability Engineering: Develop, refine, and scientifically assess Predictive and Preventive Maintenance (PdM/PM) methodologies using vibration analysis, thermography, and tribology data to maximize asset reliability and machinery lifecycle.
  • Capital Projects & Equipment Upgrades: Plan, spec, and oversee mechanical capital engineering projects, equipment modifications, machinery installations, and precision alignment standards, exercising independent judgment to select materials, vendors, and engineering specifications.
  • Applied Floor Engineering & Technical Support: Spend dedicated time on the manufacturing floor performing high-level engineering diagnostic testing, validating mechanical tolerances, and providing technical engineering direction to maintenance technicians and operations teams during complex mechanical overhauls.
  • Maintenance Systems & Asset Management: Utilize Oracle / CMMS platforms to track engineering KPIs, evaluate mechanical performance trends, optimize asset reliability models, and maintain standard operating procedures for mechanical interventions.
  • Safety & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all mechanical designs and engineering modifications adhere strictly to OSHA standards, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) protocols, machine safety guarding criteria, and corporate safety mandates.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering (BSME), Mechanical Engineering Technology, or a closely related ABET-accredited engineering discipline required.
  • Experience: 3+ years of progressive mechanical engineering experience within a continuous process manufacturing environment (paper, tissue, converting, or continuous packaging preferred).
  • Technical Command: Deep theoretical and practical knowledge of rotating equipment, continuous drive systems, hydraulics, pneumatics, heat transfer, power transmission, and reliability tools (vibration analysis, precision laser alignment).
  • Systems & Tools: Proficiency with CMMS/Oracle platforms, CAD software, and technical data analysis toolsets.
  • Languages: Professional verbal and written English proficiency required; conversational or professional Spanish communication skills preferred.
  • Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

  • Plant Floor Technical Presence: Active presence on the continuous manufacturing floor to conduct engineering inspections, technical diagnostic testing, and equipment performance evaluations in proximity to continuous production lines.
  • Physical Stamina & Mobility: Capability to navigate manufacturing facility layouts, walk plant floors, inspect elevated components, climb platform access ladders, and occasionally maneuver engineering diagnostic equipment up to 50 lbs.
  • Safety & PPE Requirements: Strict compliance with required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), including steel-toe footwear, safety glasses, hard hats, cut-resistant gloves, and hearing protection on the plant floor.

Company Benefits

  • 100% Employer-Paid Healthcare: Fully covered individual Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.
  • 100% Employer-Paid Disability: Fully covered Short-Term Disability (STD) and Long-Term Disability (LTD).
  • Retirement & PTO: 401(k) retirement savings plan, Paid Time Off (PTO), and paid company holidays.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Job Title - Senior Quality Assurance Engineer – ExamDeveloper

Summary

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you are a highly skilled individual contributor recognized as a technical authority for quality within your area. You lead quality engineering strategy and execution for one or more product squads, combining hands-on testing and automation with release-quality accountability and technical guidance for other quality engineers.

You design advanced test strategies that anticipate complex system interactions, integration risks, and failure modes, and you establish an automation-first approach with complete, visible coverage. You are frequently consulted on the most challenging defects, complex integrations, performance and reliability concerns, and critical release decisions. You lead through expertise rather than formal authority — mentoring quality engineers, improving practices, and helping teams make sound quality and release decisions. You partner closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Product Architects, Dev Leads, DevOps, security, accessibility, and vendor teams to protect candidate experience, delivery reliability, and product quality.

The Product

ExamDeveloper is a web-based exam development platform that allows customers to write, review, and manage questions on their exams. Customers rely on ExamDeveloper to support the full workflow around item writing, collaborative review, scoring, and test management for certification and professional assessment programs.

ExamDeveloper is a leading web-based tool for creating tests that certify test-takers in the professional skills they require. The Senior Quality Assurance Engineer plays a critical role in protecting workflow accuracy, automation reliability, delivery confidence, and product quality as the platform continues to support complex exam-development workflows.

Key responsibilities

Quality strategy and test design

  • Lead test strategy and coverage planning for assigned squad initiatives, releases, and platform changes.

  • Design advanced test approaches spanning functional, regression, integration, negative, accessibility, and API coverage.

  • Define quality gates and test readiness criteria for stories, defects, releases, and production-impacting changes.

  • Ensure stories and defects include clear testing evidence, including test cases executed, edge cases considered, environment details, data notes, and traceability where appropriate.

  • Use metrics, defect trends, and production signals to continuously improve the test strategy.

Hands-on testing and automation

  • Contribute directly to hands-on testing for high-risk, complex, cross-team, or automation-critical work.

  • Create, improve, and review automated tests across UI, API, integration, and regression coverage.

  • Review regression results, identify failure patterns, and drive resolution of flaky, missing, or outdated tests.

  • Use manual, exploratory, accessibility, usability, or complex workflow testing when automation is not practical or sufficient.

  • Promote automation-first practices and ensure tests are reliably incorporated into regression suites.

Quality ownership and collaboration

  • Lead defect triage, retesting, and resolution follow-through, and escalate major quality concerns early.

  • Raise defects with clear reproduction steps, environment details, test data, supporting evidence, and business or user impact where possible.

  • Serve as the technical authority on quality within your domain and inform critical release decisions.

  • Mentor and coach quality engineers in automation, test design, accessibility, and release validation.

  • Provide quality perspective during backlog refinement, design reviews, technical planning, and release readiness.

  • Surface QE capacity, coverage, or dependency risks early when testing scope may affect sprint or release timelines.

Required education and experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of professional quality engineering, software testing, or test automation experience.

  • Demonstrated experience leading quality for complex, distributed, cloud-based, or customer-facing platforms.

  • Strong experience with test strategy, test design, defect management, regression planning, and release validation.

  • Experience providing technical guidance and mentorship within Agile engineering squads.

Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities

  • Experience with Gauge-style BDD automation, Selenium/WebDriver, C# step implementations, and sustainable web application test automation.

  • Experience maintaining automated test suites that run on virtual machines, with awareness of potential cloud-based testing infrastructure.

  • Experience with relational databases, test data validation, defect investigation, and evidence-based quality review.

  • Experience with SQL, log analysis, telemetry, dashboards, and production issue investigation.

  • Demonstrated technical leadership in Agile quality engineering, including test planning, automation review, and continuous improvement.

  • Willingness and ability to incorporate artificial intelligence technologies into QA responsibly, including validation of AI-assisted outputs.

  • Experience working with offshore teams, vendors, and globally distributed delivery models.

Success measures

  • Quality strategy and test design are visible, current, and used by the squad.

  • Stories and defects close with clear, reviewable evidence of testing and coverage.

  • Regression coverage and automation reliability improve; missed scenarios trend down.

  • Achieves near-zero critical defect leakage post-release for owned areas.

  • Quality risks are surfaced early and resolved through clear ownership and follow-through.

  • Improves the capability of the broader quality team through mentorship.

Leadership behaviors

Customer Centricity Ensures advanced and edge-case scenarios are considered so user-impacting failures are prevented before release.

Raise the Performance Bar Pilots new methodologies, strengthens test architecture and automation, and sets a high standard for quality rigor.

Exceptional Collaboration for Value Mentors peers, contributes strong input during reviews, and aligns quality priorities across product and engineering.

Our Leaders Inspire Provides informal leadership during complex releases, steps up during peak workloads, and models expert problem-solving.

You’ll own complex features across backend services and frontend experiences—from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.   • Experience building and operating applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including automated delivery and production support.
  • Practical experience using AI‑assisted coding tools for implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, documentation, or codebase analysis.
  • Strong engineering judgment: the ability to explain trade‑offs, diagnose problems, and deliver maintainable solutions.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex features and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and product teams.

Experience That Would Be Valuable

  • Relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or Oracle.

title: Probation/Parole Officer (Juvenile Probation Department)
description:
• New Hires Hourly Starting Rate -$29.65
  • 35 Hours Per Week

POSITION SUMMARY:

This position enforces the orders of the Berks County Juvenile Court, performing a variety of tasks in order to supervise juvenile offenders and reduce their risk of reoffending. Under Balanced and Restorative Justice principles, juvenile probation officers serve three clients equally: the victim, the offender, and the community. This position ensures that offenders are held accountable for their behavior and that supervision is sufficient to protect the community. In addition, juvenile probation officers are expected to assist in the development of competencies and skills within the offender so that they may become productive, law-abiding members of the community. Probation officers are expected to supervise offenders appropriate to their level of risk to re-offend and work to address areas of need as identified in the risk and needs assessment.

Probation officers hired after July 1, 2005 are required to obtain certification to carry a firearm through the County Probation and Parole Officers’ Firearm and Training Commission within eighteen months from the date of hire or face disciplinary action, up to and including termination. Candidates for the position shall undergo a psychological evaluation to determine fitness to carry a firearm.

Juvenile probation officer compensation is based upon years of service and job performance. PO I is typically the entry level pay grade. PO II may be achieved after three years of service, PO III after eight years and PO IV after twelve years, all promotions requiring satisfactory performance ratings as outlined in the Probation Officer Performance Evaluation.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

Essential Functions

  1. Supervise offenders through a combination of office and community-based contacts, with a focus on the latter. Make collateral contacts with parents/guardians, schools, employers, community agencies and residential facilities. Contacts to be made during regular office and non-traditional hours.
  2. Provide guidance, mentoring, support and counseling to offenders under supervision.
  3. Build professional alliances with offenders and their families.
  4. Accurately assess offender risk and needs through use of the Youth Level of Service (YLS) assessment device.
  5. Make recommendations to the Juvenile Court that are cognizant of risk, address criminogenic needs and remain consistent with the principles of Balanced and Restorative Justice.
  6. Develop SMART (specific, measurable, attainable, realistic and time-limited) case plans utilizing the results of the YLS and prioritizing needs appropriately.
  7. Utilize Motivational Interviewing techniques to engage clients and create the climate for change.
  8. Develop familiarity with agencies and resources available to offenders and their families, making appropriate referrals utilizing risk and need data and the department’s service matrix.
  9. Engage in risk reduction activities with offenders.
  10. Respond appropriately, consistently and swiftly to violations of probation and Court orders.
  11. Document all case-related contacts and generate reports when necessary in a timely fashion. Complete all other necessary paperwork as required.
  12. Enforce the collection and initiate the dispersing of restitution for victims and other monetary obligations to the Court.
  13. Represent the department in Juvenile Court by presenting both written and verbal information and formally testifying when necessary.
  14. Participate in the apprehension and transportation of offenders not complying with the terms of their probation supervision, if trained to do so.
  15. Meet Juvenile Court Judges’ Commission standards of 40 hours of training yearly and assist in the development of new officers through mentoring.
  16. Hold offenders accountable by drug testing as per department policy, referring them to community service work sites and facilitating their enrollment on the electronic monitoring when appropriate (including the installation of equipment when necessary).
  17. Performs other duties as assigned.

NON-ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Represent the juvenile probation office and Juvenile Court in the community through public speaking engagements and other community events.

MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  1. Bachelor’s degree with at least 18 credits in a behavioral or social science.
  2. Valid and active Driver’s License, proof of auto insurance and access to a vehicle for employment purposes.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  1. Working knowledge of the principles, methods, and practices of investigations, supervision, and reporting in community corrections.
  2. Working knowledge of the Risk-Need-Responsivity principle and evidence-based probation practices is preferred.
  3. Understanding of adolescent development and family dynamics.
  4. The ability to communicate effectively through oral and written expressions in a clear and concise manner. Prior training in Motivational Interviewing is preferred but will train as necessary.
  5. The ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships.
  6. The ability to analyze facts and exercise sound judgment when acting in the best interest of the offender, victim, and community.
  7. Basic skill in the operation of computer software applications is required.
  8. Ability to converse in Spanish is not essential for all probation officers but preferred for those designated as having a Spanish speaking caseload.
  9. The ability and willingness to work outside of normal business hours.
  10. Ability to handle stress.
  11. Physical presence in the office may be required.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  1. Ability to complete Control Tactics training and assist, when necessary, in the physical control of subjects that may be cooperative, resistive and/or assaultive.
  2. Ability to complete firearms training and achieve and maintain certification to carry a firearm.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT:

  1. Normal office environment as well as meeting with offender’s weekly in their homes, schools, communities and institutional placements during both traditional and non-traditional work hours.
  2. At times stressful given the hectic workload and nature of the clientele.
  3. Some work may be performed in targeted high crime areas and as a result, the environment could present an increased safety risk.
  4. Travel on a regular basis throughout Berks County and occasionally outside the County for training and placement visitation.

This position description serves as a guideline for communicating the essential functions and other information about the position to the applicant/employee. It is not intended to create a binding employment contract nor cover every detail of the position and may be changed where appropriate.

title: Remote Junior Project Manager
description:
Junior Project Manager

Remote | Hybrid option: Melbourne, FL or Ellicott City, MD

Salary Range: $100,000 - $115,000

The Role

Above Group is looking for a Junior Project Manager to support our Senior Project Managers in delivering AE and cross-discipline Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Protection (MEP/FP) projects. You will help keep assigned projects on scope, on schedule, and on budget, and be a dependable point of contact between clients, contractors, sub-consultants, and our internal design teams. Your work will directly reflect the quality and vision of our company standards.

This is a growth role with real responsibility: you will manage approximately $0.5M–$1.5M in annual billings, contribute to proposals and business development, and help shape the standards and processes our project teams work by. We rely on junior project managers who work well independently and collaboratively, communicate clearly, and are committed to excellence in every aspect of their work.

What You’ll Do

  • Assist in managing scope, schedule, and budget for assigned projects, including coordination with external design sub-consultants and internal design teams; manage approximately $0.5M–$1.5M in annual billings
  • Interpret and contribute to Basis of Design documents, design criteria documents, reports, and other technical written documents
  • Maintain clear communication between clients, contractors, and senior project managers on all active projects
  • Conduct quality control reviews of drawings, specifications, and narratives under the guidance of senior staff, and identify and escalate any oversights for review and correction
  • Support business development, including project interviews, technical writing for proposals, and fee proposals, under the direction of senior staff
  • Assist with contract coordination for sub-consultants and support the approval and distribution process
  • Maintain project schedules and calendars with key design deadlines, and keep project records, job site visit logs, and timelines current
  • Ensure RFI and submittal response times meet or exceed company standards, and keep records of all communications and work items discussed with contractors
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation and records of applicable standards and codes, and support the development of and adherence to company-wide standards and processes
  • Submit your own timesheets on time and help monitor team compliance
  • Represent the company in marketing and networking activities, including industry events and conferences, as requested

What you Bring to the Role

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, architecture, or a related field preferred
  • Minimum of 5-10 years of post-degree experience working for an MEP engineering firm or an AE firm
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or Registered Architect (AIA)
  • Proficient in managing workflow for MEP/FP designers and engineers in the AEC industry
  • Knowledge of Revit and AutoCAD, and of applying WBS and EVM frameworks
  • Familiarity with applying PMI methodologies
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) and Microsoft Project
  • Exceptional written, oral, interpersonal, and presentation skills; able to edit design specifications and respond to RFIs using information from project documents
  • Strong work ethic; able to work independently/self-motivated, as well as in a collaborative team setting, highly organized, and detail oriented
  • Strong project management, strategic planning, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to multi-task
  • Strong time management with flexibility to adapt to changing schedules and duties
  • High levels of confidentiality, integrity, and dependability
  • U.S. citizenship or U.S. permanent residency
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% for site visits and client meetings

Nice to have: PMI PMP certification, or actively pursuing it.



Why Above Group

We are a faith-based AEC firm built around a simple idea: continuously improving the built environment for the glory of God. Our mission is to demonstrate the love of Jesus Christ by empowering excellent AEC professionals to provide superior service. Four values guide how we work: Christian Values, Uncompromising Quality, Buffalo (running toward challenges rather than away from them), and Extreme Team. If that resonates with you, you will fit here.


Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability coverage, employer-funded HSA contributions, and an annual profit-sharing bonus tied to the company’s collective results.



Remote Work Requirements

This role is fully remote or a hybrid option for candidates residing near Melbourne, FL or Ellicott City, MD. Any type of remote work requires reliable high-speed internet capable of supporting video conferencing, VPN, and cloud applications; a secure home network appropriate for confidential company and client information; and a dedicated, quiet workspace suitable for sustained focus and professional video meetings.

title: Director, Brand Strategy & Partnerships
description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.


ROLE OVERVIEW


The Director, Brand Strategy & Partnerships leads the development, governance, and activation of the LifeStance Health brand across enterprise audiences, markets, partnerships, and growth priorities. This role is responsible for strengthening how LifeStance shows up with patients, clinicians, teammates, referral partners, recruits, business partners, and external stakeholders by building a clear, differentiated, and scalable brand platform.


This leader will serve as a senior strategic partner across the organization, translating enterprise priorities into brand strategies, creative systems, partnership opportunities, and activation plans that build awareness, trust, preference, and long-term affinity. The role oversees brand governance, creative services, branded partnerships, sponsorship strategy, and cross-functional brand activation, ensuring LifeStance presents a consistent, credible, and compelling brand experience across every touchpoint.

Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.


KEY RESPONSIBILITES

Enterprise Brand Strategy

  • Lead the development and evolution of LifeStance’s enterprise brand strategy, positioning, narrative, and messaging architecture.
  • Translate business priorities into brand strategies that support consumer growth, clinician relevance, referral confidence, recruiting, business development, reputation, and stakeholder trust.
  • Ensure the LifeStance brand reflects the company’s long-term vision, growth strategy, care model, and role in the outpatient mental health category.
  • Partner with marketing, clinical, operations, people, business development, M&A, and executive stakeholders to ensure brand strategy is embedded across enterprise initiatives.
  • Develop audience-specific brand strategies for patients, clinicians, teammates, referral partners, recruits, payors, community partners, and external stakeholders.

Brand Governance and Architecture

  • Own enterprise brand governance, standards, and usage across internal and external channels.
  • Develop and maintain brand guidelines, messaging frameworks, visual and verbal identity standards, and brand decision-making processes.
  • Lead brand architecture strategy for specialty services, partnerships, de novos, M&A activity, service-line expansion, and future growth initiatives.
  • Ensure consistency across digital, physical, internal, patient-facing, clinician-facing, and partner-facing touchpoints.
  • Establish processes and tools to help teams activate the brand consistently and efficiently at scale.

Creative Services Leadership

  • Oversee creative services strategy, prioritization, and execution across enterprise marketing needs.
  • Lead the development of scalable creative systems, campaign assets, templates, toolkits, and branded materials.
  • Partner with internal teams and external agencies to ensure creative work is strategically grounded, brand-aligned, and built for reuse across audiences and markets.
  • Manage creative workflows, intake, prioritization, and quality standards to improve efficiency and brand consistency.
  • Help evolve the creative services model, including the right mix of internal resources, agencies, contractors, and production partners.

Brand Partnerships and Sponsorships

  • Develop and lead branded partnership strategy across healthcare, mental health, employer, community, consumer, and out-of-category opportunities.
  • Identify and cultivate partnerships that increase brand awareness, credibility, trust, and cultural relevance.
  • Evaluate sponsorships, collaborations, thought leadership opportunities, and strategic relationships through the lens of brand fit, audience reach, reputation impact, and business value.
  • Partner with business development, clinical, people, PR, and market leaders to activate partnerships that support enterprise goals.
  • Build frameworks to assess partnership ROI, brand lift, stakeholder engagement, and long-term strategic value.

Campaign and Activation Strategy

  • Partner with marketing leadership to translate brand strategy into campaign platforms, activation plans, and market-level storytelling.
  • Support development of top-of-funnel campaign strategy, creative briefs, audience segmentation, and activation plans.
  • Ensure campaigns are grounded in consumer insight and flexible enough to support multiple audiences, service lines, geographies, and business priorities.
  • Partner with performance marketing, content, PR, social, reputation, and field teams to connect brand-building efforts with demand generation and stakeholder engagement.
  • Define how brand activation supports awareness, trust, preference, discoverability, referral confidence, clinician pride, and long-term loyalty.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as a strategic brand advisor to senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Support enterprise initiatives requiring brand strategy, storytelling, positioning, or change management.
  • Partner with M&A and de novo teams to ensure new practices and markets are integrated into the LifeStance brand in a consistent and thoughtful way.
  • Collaborate with People / Talent teams on employer brand, EVP activation, recruiting materials, and clinician engagement.
  • Collaborate with PR, communications, and clinical leadership to strengthen thought leadership, reputation, and external storytelling.

Measurement and Optimization

  • Establish brand health measurement frameworks, including awareness, familiarity, trust, preference, reputation, share of search, stakeholder engagement, and campaign contribution.
  • Partner with analytics and performance teams to connect brand-building activity to business outcomes over time.
  • Develop executive-facing reporting that communicates brand progress, opportunities, and impact.
  • Use insights, research, and performance data to continuously improve brand strategy, creative execution, and partnership activation.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 10+ years of experience in brand strategy, brand management, integrated marketing, creative strategy, or brand experience.
  • Experience leading enterprise brand strategy in a complex, multi-site, multi-market, or matrixed organization.
  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States
  • LifeStance is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.
  • Demonstrates awareness, inclusivity, sensitivity, humility, and experience in working with individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, sexual orientations, gender identities, and other various aspects of culture.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE

  • Healthcare, behavioral health, consumer health, retail health, or similarly regulated category experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and govern brand systems across multiple audiences, channels, markets, and stakeholders.
  • Experience managing creative teams, agencies, production partners, or cross-functional creative workflows.
  • Experience developing or activating strategic partnerships, sponsorships, or branded collaborations.
  • Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate strategy into clear recommendations.
  • Proven ability to balance strategic vision with operational execution.
  • Strong understanding of consumer behavior, brand health, reputation, content strategy, digital experience, and integrated campaign development.
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment with evolving priorities.

Leadership Attributes

  • Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and enterprise orientation.
  • Deeply collaborative, with the ability to influence across functions without direct authority.
  • Strong storyteller who can simplify complex ideas and create alignment.
  • High judgment and strong brand instincts.
  • Comfortable building new capabilities, processes, and systems.
  • Able to balance creativity, consistency, governance, and speed.
  • Passionate about building a brand that is human, trusted, differentiated, and useful in people’s lives.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, bend, talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

title: Asset & Wealth Management, Investment Strategy Group, SQAA Research Associate, New York
description:
YOUR IMPACT

We are seeking a quantitative strategist to join the Strategic and Quantitative Asset Allocation (SQAA) team within the Investment Strategy Group (ISG). The candidate will join a team of researchers and technologists to design cutting-edge investment solutions and strategies across global asset classes. This is a dynamic role that requires creativity, innovative thinking, and the ability to conduct rigorous investment research. Fluent programming skills, impeccable attention to detail and good communication skills are also a must.

OUR IMPACT

The Strategic and Quantitative Asset Allocation team within the Goldman Sachs Investment Strategy Group (ISG) is seeking an Associate to contribute to the research, design and implementation of systematic investment strategies across global asset classes. ISG is situated within the firm’s Private Wealth Management business and has responsibility for strategic and tactical asset allocation views and advice for the firm’s ultra-high net worth clients and certain institutions. This is a dynamic role that requires creativity, quantitative rigor and ability to conduct independent investment research. Impeccable attention to detail, as well as strong inter-personal, team-work and communication skills, is also a must.

HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL

  • Contribute to the research, design and implementation of systematic investment solutions and strategies
  • Conduct quantitative research utilizing market and macroeconomic data
  • Implement strategy backtests and simulations
  • Demonstrate strong analytical and technical skills
  • Deliver timely, thoughtful, and flawless execution of projects
  • Interact with the firm’s current and prospective clients
  • Demonstrate a keen interest in understanding financial markets
  • Desire a long-term career in Investment Management

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Bachelor’s degree (Advanced degree preferred) in a quantitative field, such as Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Physics, or Computer Science.
  • 0-3 years of related work experience
  • Fluent programming in Python, Matlab, R or a related language
  • Familiarity with AI development tools and agents
  • Empirical research of large and heterogeneous datasets and familiarity with cutting-edge machine learning techniques
  • Ability to implement quantitative financial models and techniques (asset pricing, optimization, simulations)
  • Knowledge of global asset classes and investment instruments
  • Excellent communication skills; especially the ability to explain complex technical concepts and quantitative investment management topics in simple terms
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a passion to engage with clients
  • Attention to detail and ability to multi-task under pressure
  • Collaborative and team-work oriented
  • Independent, logical, and critical thinking, with the desire to think outside of the box
  • SIE, FINRA Series 7 and 63 licenses (must obtain within the first 3 months)

ABOUT GOLDMAN SACHS

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs.
