title: Senior Data Researcher
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM's Insights team publishes the original research that shapes how journalists, policymakers and investigators understand illicit finance and the crime behind it. As Senior Data Researcher, you will take a topic from question to published piece: gather and pressure-test the evidence, find the story and write it. Few roles anywhere combine intelligence across crime types with full ownership of the public narrative.

The impact you will have:

  • Publish original investigative research on the threats that matter most: fraud and scams, sanctions evasion, ransomware and cybercrime, terrorist financing, drug and human trafficking, and the financial networks behind them. Your work holds up under scrutiny from top-tier press and policymakers.

  • Use AI heavily in everything you do. TRM is an AI-native investigative company, so expect to use Claude, ChatGPT and agent-based tools to research, analyze data, stress-test methodology, draft and package each finding for every channel.

  • Lead original research that answers the biggest open questions about crime and the financial networks that power it. Combine TRM's blockchain intelligence with non-crypto sources (sanctions lists, court filings, corporate records, open-source and threat intelligence) to find patterns no one else has connected, then turn them into evidence that holds up.

  • Extend the research beyond the blog. Turn findings into training content for investigators and compliance teams, and pass emerging threat intelligence back to TRM's product and intelligence teams.

What we're looking for:

  • 5 to 8 years combining research or data analysis with published writing, including at least one high-impact investigation you led from evidence-gathering to final piece.

  • Strong analytical skills across varied sources (financial, open-source, court and regulatory records, structured datasets), using AI to speed up and check the work.

  • A public portfolio of investigative or research-led work with measurable reach (major media pickup, citations, audience growth). Investigative journalists, financial crime and threat intelligence researchers, and research-focused writers who do their own analysis have all done well in roles like this.

  • Deep AI fluency: you already rely heavily on AI across research, analysis, drafting and packaging, and you're comfortable running and quality-checking an agent-based production workflow. Experience in financial crime, sanctions, cybercrime, national security or crypto is a strong plus.

About the Team:

  • Insights is the public voice of TRM's research. It connects TRM's intelligence on illicit finance and crime with the press, policymakers and the wider industry.

  • The work is research-led, focused on the story, fast-moving and AI-native.

  • You'll work closely with Marketing, Communications, TRM's intelligence and investigations teams, product teams, and TRM Academy.

  • The team is small and opinionated, and it owns some of the most visible work TRM produces. Distributed, not distant.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Weekly Insights research review to set priorities and look at work in progress.

  • A weekly working session with Marketing to plan distribution and timing.

  • Async by default for drafts and methodology review. Meetings are for editorial decisions and launch planning.

  • The research and content workflow runs continuously, and you manage it day to day and week to week.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Measurable example #1: Within 30 days, you publish your first piece of original data-backed research on TRM's blog, with a Marketing push behind it.

  • Measurable example #2: Within 60 days, you take a topic you picked through the full cycle (research, narrative, distribution) and show measurable gains in media coverage.

  • Measurable example #3: Within 90 days, you run the research and content workflow end to end, and your research feeds weekly training sessions for TRM Academy instructors.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $180,000

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Work Week Travel: This role requires participation in in-person R&D work weeks, typically 1–2 times per quarter, at a TRM hub or other designated location. Work weeks may be scheduled with as little as 14 days’ notice, and some roles may require additional travel based on team and cross-functional needs. TRM coordinates and covers approved travel, lodging, and workspace. Accommodations are available for legitimate caregiving, health, immigration, and similar constraints.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

title: Wastewater Operator
description:
Founded in 2018, SoulShine Farms has quickly grown to be a local further-processing poultry industry leader. Our work revolves around our values, our people, and our dedication to quality.

SoulShine Farms is seeking reliable, safety-minded individuals to join our maintenance team as Wastewater Operator at our plant in Gainesville, Georgia. This is an hourly position, and you will be paid weekly for hours worked.

In this role, you will use a knife or similar sharp cutting tool to cut raw chicken into precise shapes and sizes according to customer and production specifications. This is a fast-paced, repetitive assembly-line position that requires attention to detail, strong hand-eye coordination, and a commitment to quality, safety, and production standards.

Position Summary
The Wastewater Operator operates, monitors, and maintains wastewater treatment and pretreatment systems supporting Soulshine Farms’ poultry further processing facility located in Gainesville, GA. This hands-on role manages wastewater generated by production and sanitation, maintains reliable treatment performance, and supports compliance with applicable discharge limits and environmental requirements. The operator partners with Maintenance, Production, Sanitation, and EHS to prevent disruptions, resolve treatment issues, and protect employee safety and the environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  • Operate and monitor installed wastewater systems, including screening, equalization, dissolved air flotation (DAF), chemical feed, pumps, and sludge handling equipment, as applicable to the facility.
  • Monitor flows, tank levels, pH, chemical usage, alarms, and other process indicators; adjust operating settings within approved procedures to maintain treatment performance and discharge compliance.
  • Manage treatment of fats, oils, grease, suspended solids, and organic loading from poultry processing and sanitation; identify changes in wastewater characteristics and respond promptly.
  • Collect representative samples at required locations and frequencies; perform authorized process tests and coordinate laboratory testing for permit parameters such as BOD, COD, TSS, and fats, oils, and grease.
  • Maintain accurate operating logs, sample records, instrument checks, chemical inventory, maintenance records, and sludge disposal documentation; provide data for required environmental reports.
  • Inspect equipment, clean screens and treatment areas, calibrate instruments, and perform routine preventive maintenance within training and authorization; coordinate repairs with Maintenance.
  • Handle, store, and dose treatment chemicals safely using required protective equipment, safety data sheets, approved procedures, and spill prevention practices.
  • Coordinate with Production and Sanitation on schedules, cleaning activities, and unusual discharges that could affect treatment capacity or performance; recommend source reduction and water conservation improvements.
  • Identify and promptly escalate equipment failures, spills, abnormal readings, and potential discharge exceedances; initiate approved response procedures and support required notifications through designated management.
  • Coordinate sludge removal and approved waste hauling; monitor storage capacity and maintain orderly, safe wastewater operating areas.
  • Support inspections, audits, root cause investigations, and corrective actions with EHS, management, laboratories, and service providers.
  • Maintain required operator certification and complete continuing education; perform other related duties as assigned.
Required Qualifications
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • At least three years of wastewater treatment or industrial pretreatment operating experience.
  • Working knowledge of wastewater process controls, sampling methods, basic laboratory testing, chemical dosing, and environmental operating records.
  • Ability to troubleshoot pumps, valves, instrumentation, and treatment equipment; recognize process changes and take timely corrective action.
  • Ability to read operating procedures, safety data sheets, equipment instructions, and applicable permit requirements; perform basic calculations and accurately record data.
  • Basic computer skills for logs, spreadsheets, email, and maintenance work orders.
  • Ability to work independently, communicate clearly across shifts and departments, and follow safety and food safety requirements.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in poultry further processing, food manufacturing, or another operation with high organic loads and fats, oils, and grease.
  • Experience operating DAF systems, conducting jar tests, adjusting polymer and coagulant feed, and managing sludge dewatering.
  • Technical coursework in wastewater treatment, environmental technology, industrial maintenance, or a related field.
  • Possess, or willing to obtain within one year, a pre-treatment wastewater operator’s license.
Schedule and Availability
Work schedules align with production and sanitation needs and may include early mornings, evenings, weekends, overtime, and on-call response to wastewater equipment or process emergencies.

Join Our Team!

  • Six (6) Paid Holidays

title: Junior SDET (Quality Engineer 1)
description:
Why TrueML?
TrueML is a mission-driven financial software company that aims to create better customer experiences for distressed borrowers. Consumers today want personal, digital-first experiences that align with their lifestyles, especially when it comes to managing finances. TrueML’s approach uses machine learning to engage each customer digitally and adjust strategies in real time in response to their interactions.
The TrueML team includes inspired data scientists, financial services industry experts and customer experience fanatics building technology to serve people in a way that recognizes their unique needs and preferences as human beings and endeavoring toward ensuring nobody gets locked out of the financial system.

TrueML Products is seeking an early-career Quality Engineer I to join our Quality Engineering team and help ensure the delivery of high-quality software products. This is a hands-on role focused on executing tests, finding and documenting issues, and learning best practices in software quality.

You’ll work closely with more senior Quality Engineers, developers, and product managers to validate new features, support regression efforts, and continuously improve how we test. This is an ideal role if you’re early in your QA/QE career, eager to learn, and curious about using GenAI tools to assist with testing.

Work-Life Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Medical benefit contributions in congruence with local laws and type of employment agreement

What You’ll Do:

Quality Engineering & Test Execution

  • Execute test plans and test cases as directed by senior QE team members.

  • Perform basic functional, regression, and integration testing across Web, API, and/or Data components as applicable.

  • Identify, document, and track defects accurately in our bug tracking system (e.g., Jira), including clear reproduction steps and impact.

  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of test data needed for test execution.

  • Assist in troubleshooting and investigating issues by reproducing defects, gathering logs, and validating fixes.

  • Contribute to basic test scripts (manual and automated) under guidance, following established patterns and standards.

Collaboration, Communication & Ownership

  • Participate in team meetings, providing clear status updates on assigned tasks.

  • Communicate testing progress, risks, and issues to your team in a clear and concise way, including to non-technical stakeholders when needed.

  • Ask questions and seek clarification proactively to fully understand requirements, scope, and expected behavior.

  • Follow through on commitments, take responsibility for your work, and deliver assigned tasks on time with close supervision.

  • Collaborate with your team to unblock issues within the scope of your work, escalating when needed.

Quality Practices, Processes & AI Tools

  • Learn and adhere to established QE standards, processes, and best practices (including test case structure, defect reporting, and regression workflows).

  • Build a basic understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and how quality is embedded throughout.

  • Begin working within Agile/Scrum practices (e.g., participating in sprint ceremonies, using user stories, understanding acceptance criteria).

  • Assisted Scripting: Use AI-powered code completion tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to help write simple test automation scripts or snippets under supervision.

  • AI-Suggested Test Cases: Leverage AI tools to generate basic test case ideas and scenarios from requirements or user stories, then refine them with guidance.

  • Intelligent Search: Use AI-enhanced search within bug tracking and documentation systems to quickly find duplicate issues, related tickets, or supporting documentation.

  • Build awareness of how to find information and who to ask across the company (e.g., “Who can answer X?” or “Where is Y documented?”).

Who You Are:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • 1–2 years of relevant experience in software testing, quality assurance, or a related technical role (including internships, co-ops, or academic projects).

  • Basic understanding of software development lifecycles and testing methodologies (e.g., functional, regression, integration testing).

  • Familiarity with basic testing concepts and terminology (e.g., test cases, test data, defects, severity/priority).

  • Basic proficiency with operating systems and common software applications.

  • Exposure to bug tracking systems (e.g., Jira).

  • Academic or practical exposure to scripting/programming languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java) for basic test scripting or automation.

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum or Kanban) and working with user stories.

  • Experience with any test management tools (e.g., Xray, TestRail) is a plus.

  • Experience using AI-powered tools in an academic, personal, or professional context (e.g., for code completion, documentation search, or generating test ideas).

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly describe issues and test results.

  • Demonstrated ability to follow instructions, learn new tools and processes, and complete assigned tasks with supervision.

  • Interest in and willingness to use GenAI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Gemini, AI test generators) to assist with scripting, test design, and information discovery.

We are a dynamic group of people who are subject matter experts with a passion for change. Our teams are crafting solutions to big problems every day. If you’re looking for an opportunity to do impactful work, join TrueML and make a difference.

Our Dedication to Diversity & Inclusion

title: Myyjä – Envaire Oy (tuntipalkka + provisio)
description:
Haluatko myyntityön, jossa jokainen kauppa tuo sinulle rahaa yhä uudelleen, eikä vain kerran?

Envaire Oy on nopeasti kasvava markkinointitoimisto, joka nostaa yrityksiä Googlen etusivulle. Myymme palvelua, jota jokainen yritys tarvitsee, ja asiakkaamme maksavat vasta, kun tulokset näkyvät. Se tekee myymisestä helppoa: et myy lupauksia, vaan tuloksia.

Näin ansaitset

  • 9 €/h tuntipalkka, joten sinulla on aina turvattu pohja

  • 8 % provisio asiakkaan laskutuksesta niin kauan kuin asiakkuus jatkuu, ilman ansiokattoa

  • Provisiosi kertyy kuukausi kuukaudelta. Jokainen uusi asiakas kasvattaa kuukausituloasi pysyvästi.

Esimerkki: Jos hankit vuoden aikana 15 asiakasta, joiden laskutus on keskimäärin 800 €/kk, saat pelkästään provisiota lähes 1 000 € joka kuukausi tuntipalkan päälle. Ja luku kasvaa jokaisen uuden kaupan myötä. Isoimmista asiakkaistamme tulee laskutusta 23 000€/kk.

Miksi meillä on helppo myydä

  • Asiakas maksaa vain Googlen etusivulle nousseista hakusanoista, joten riski on meillä, ei asiakkaalla

  • Palvelu sopii lähes mihin tahansa yritykseen, joten potentiaalisia asiakkaita riittää

  • Saat perehdytyksen, valmiit myyntimateriaalit ja tuen tiimiltä

Keitä etsimme? Sinulla on vähintään 6 kuukauden kokemus myyntityöstä. Ei väliä, oletko myynyt puhelimessa, kentällä vai kaupan kassalla. Tärkeintä on, että osaat myydä, et pelkää tarttua puhelimeen ja haluat, että kova työ näkyy tilipussissa.

Lisäksi tarjoamme

  • Etätyön, voit työskennellä kotisi mukavuudesta.

  • Mahdollisuuden kasvaa kasvavan yrityksen mukana, esimerkiksi tiiminvetäjäksi

  • Rennon ja tavoitteellisen työyhteisön, jossa tuloksia juhlitaan

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä lyhyt hakemus ja kerro myyntikokemuksestasi sekä parhaista tuloksistasi osoitteeseen ilia@envaire.com. Haastattelemme hakijoita jatkuvasti ja valitsemme parhaat nopeasti, joten älä jää odottamaan!

title: Director, Inclusive Cities
description:
ABOUT US | HR&A, an employee-owned company, guides decision makers in cities, including mayors and agency heads, real estate owners and developers, and nonprofit leaders, to create impact when the stakes are high and the path forward isn't clear.

We bring rigorous analysis and creative problem-solving to questions that don't have easy answers, combining data-driven and equity insights with a deep understanding of how cities function.

Our work drives lasting impact by unlocking investment and expanding opportunities in communities.

THE PRACTICE | HR&A’s Inclusive Cities studio leverages our deep understanding of government, knowledge of local and private economic forces, and analytical rigor to promote social and economic justice.

Cities are where class, race, and geography converge — often to the exclusion of many of the communities that make them vibrant. We help translate the ideas of communities and their advocates into meaningful systems change to create more inclusive and thriving cities. Leveraging analytic rigor and robust civic engagement, we work with partners inside and outside government to disrupt the traditional processes of economic development, build greater civic influence for marginalized communities, increase accountability of local governments, and institutionalize mechanisms for more just and equitable cities.

Examples of recent work in our studio include:

  • Detroit Mayoral Transition — Led the most inclusive and rigorous mayoral transition in Detroit's history, supporting the city's first Black woman mayor with deep community engagement, equity-centered staff recruitment, and first-term governing plans to prepare the new administration to lead from day one.

  • NYC Municipal Grocery Stores — Partnered with the Economic Security Project to develop an operational roadmap for New York City to launch the nation's first network of municipal grocery stores, a tangible, scalable win for the City's affordability agenda.

  • Oakland People's Budget Coalition — Translated a community coalition's advocacy agenda into specific, actionable budget asks, helping secure City Council wins including restored funding for violence prevention and the arts, expanded affordable housing investment, and a first step toward police restructuring.

To learn more about the Inclusive Cities studio and recent/current projects, visit .

THE ROLE | Reporting directly to the Head of the Inclusive Cities studio, the Director will manage Inclusive Cities projects in impactful ways that embody our values; develop new practice areas, projects, methodologies, and relationships; and serve as internal and external go-to for the practice.

At HR&A, Directors manage multiple projects and business development efforts concurrently. Project timelines and scopes are highly variable and often span several weeks to several months, with Directors managing between three and six projects at a given time. They will be responsible for:

  • Creating project work plans

  • Managing project budgets

  • Directing the analytical work of project teams

  • Ensuring the quality and timeliness of deliverables

  • Interfacing with clients

Responsibilities of the Inclusive Cities Director will also include:

  • Close partnership with the Partner on the growth, strategy, and concurrent priorities of the Inclusive Cities studio.

  • Playing a critical role in incubating new lines of work, memorializing methodologies, training staff, and establishing the systems and structures that support HR&A's practices to scale.

  • Support the growth of HR&A's Transition practice, helping newly elected city and county leaders design governing agendas across the practice's three pillars — community, policy, and talent.

  • Support the growth of HR&A's Talent practice, running equitable, rigorous executive searches that recruit values-aligned, diverse leaders into local government, and designing onboarding processes that help them deliver on administration priorities.

  • Serving as a leader in the Inclusive Cities practice by building key external and internal relationships and identifying new project types and services that support those on the front lines of making cities equitable and just.

  • Representing HR&A and the Inclusive Cities practice externally at events, professional associations, and in networks.

  • Training and mentoring staff across the firm, including in multiple offices.

  • Engaging in internal firmwide activities that advance HR&A's commitment to anti-racism.

EXPERIENCE REQUIRED | We are looking for candidates with management and leadership experience in the public, private, or non-profit sector, who bring deep curiosity about the challenges facing cities today, with a passion for equity and systems change, and who are committed to leveraging the unique opportunities we are given to work closely with clients to help them accomplish their goals and who have a demonstrated ability to forge authentic relationships.

Successful candidates:

  • 8–12 years of experience in government, urban planning, economic development, real estate, housing, public policy, or related consulting fields.

  • Possess exceptional critical thinking skills, a deep curiosity about the challenges and opportunities of economic opportunity, quality of life, and the built environment, and a commitment to proactively address and advance racial justice, equity, and anti-racism.

  • Bring a strong background and/or foundation in public policy, economic development, city government, political campaigns, or nonprofit management as an important reference point for our work.

  • Bring experience in consulting or comparable client-facing functions in a relevant field and/or a leadership setting within a social justice-focused organization or local government agency such that they can demonstrate the ability to manage multiple projects at one time in ways that are impactful, adaptive, persuasive.

  • Experience managing fast-paced, collaborative project teams.

  • Possess substantial writing and presentation skills, sufficient poise for direct client interaction, and mentorship capabilities.

  • Are ambitious and creative about new ways in which our firm’s knowledge and expertise can be deployed.

COMPENSATION | The base salary range for this position is $131,600–$153,779, plus the opportunity for a discretionary year-end bonus. Where an offer falls inside this pay range is dependent on experience. We offer competitive compensation packages, based on qualifications and experience. We are an employee-owned company, meaning you will have the opportunity to benefit from the firm’s growth over time through participation in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan. Each year, the firm will contribute funds to this long-term wealth-building account and may make contributions to other retirement accounts. We also provide a comprehensive benefits package that goes well beyond coverage of 90-95% of healthcare premiums, including dental and vision coverage.

HOW TO APPLY | HR&A is committed to attracting and retaining a talented, diverse, competitive team of professionals dedicated to solving the challenges of urban life. Women, people of color, members of the LGBTQ community, individuals with disabilities, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Property Book Officer / Logistics Specialist - DEVCOM
description:
Nemean Solutions, headquartered in Sierra Vista, AZ, is a certified SBA 8(a) Native Hawaiian Organization (NHO) and veteran-operated company providing advanced Military Intelligence, Enterprise and Cloud IT services, Cybersecurity, Special Operations Forces (SOF) Exercise and Training, and niche Program Support and Professional Services to Federal and State Agencies supporting the US Government Defense, Intelligence and Aerospace sectors.


Job Overview:

Nemean Solutions is seeking a Property Book Officer / Logistics Specialist to support DEVCOM Headquarters at Aberdeen Proving Ground. This position maintains accountability for Government property and equipment while supporting warehouse receiving, storage, shipping, delivery, inventory, excess property turn-in, and vehicle fleet records. The role works with the Accountable Property Officer (APO), Government customers, and the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR) to keep records accurate and property movements documented.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Receive, inspect, offload, stage, ship, and deliver supplies, materials, furniture, equipment, and industrial chemicals; verify packing slips against nomenclature, part and serial numbers, models, manufacturers, and quantities.
  • Maintain daily digital records and chain-of-custody documentation for receipts, shipments, deliveries, warehouse assets, and excess property turn-ins; respond to customer questions and resolve discrepancies.
  • Coordinate customer deliveries and local pickups of Government-purchased items within a 30-mile radius of the APG Aberdeen Area using Government vehicles; document pickup and delivery transactions.
  • Track equipment in the G4 warehouse, classify expendable and non-expendable property, and prepare weekly warehouse activity and monthly equipment inventory reports for the COR and APO.
  • Manage excess equipment from customer turn-in through disposition, including scheduling appointments, verifying item details, preparing and maintaining DA Form 3161, DD Form 1348, DD Form 200, DA Form 4949, and related records, and coordinating transfer to the LRC or DLA.
  • Maintain property book records, a document number register, and the approved Accountable Property System of Record (APSR); assist the APO with annual or directed inventories and report discrepancies in writing.
  • Research equipment data and track catalog correction requests in AESIP; update GCSS-Army records to reflect approved catalog information.
  • Maintain an orderly, secure warehouse and daily visitor and activity security logs; handle, block, brace, palletize, and transport equipment in accordance with applicable safety and cargo securement requirements.
  • Coordinate inspections of material handling equipment, track findings, and maintain a digital database for the GSA nontactical vehicle fleet, including dispatch, inspections, mileage, fuel use, registrations, and accident reports.
  • Follow applicable Army property accountability and supply policies, contract procedures, installation access requirements, and required security and cyber training.

Competencies:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
  • Ability to function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment.

title: Software Engineer II - Remote Assistance
description:
About the role and team

Uber’s Autonomous Mobility & Delivery (AM&D) team builds technology that brings autonomous vehicles onto Uber’s platform. Our Remote Assistance (RA) systems give human operators the information and tools to understand vehicle behavior and support autonomous operations in real time.

As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will build web applications and backend services that support remote assistance workflows. You will own the development and delivery of features across the stack, working with engineering, product, design, and operations to translate requirements into reliable, intuitive software. This is a hands-on role spanning feature design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain full-stack features for remote assistance operators, including interactive web interfaces, backend services, and APIs that bring together vehicle information and operator workflows.
  • Contribute to technical designs, document implementation decisions, and evaluate tradeoffs between performance, reliability, and maintainability. Reuse and extend existing systems where appropriate.
  • Work with product managers, designers, and operations stakeholders to understand user needs, clarify feature requirements, and improve the operator experience.
  • Deliver features spanning frontend and backend components, coordinating dependencies with other engineers and integrating with platform services and vehicle data.
  • Write high-quality, well-tested code. Establish monitoring and alerting for the software you build, participate in on-call rotations, and independently troubleshoot production issues.
  • Improve the performance and maintainability of your software by addressing bottlenecks, reducing code duplication, and closing gaps in test coverage.
  • Participate in code and design reviews, contribute technical documentation and operational runbooks, and help onboard new team members.

Basic Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production web applications and backend services.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and a modern frontend framework such as React.
  • Experience developing backend services and APIs, with proficiency in at least one backend programming language.
  • Strong foundations in data structures, algorithms, and software design, with the ability to implement, test, and debug features across the application stack.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building real-time web applications, operational dashboards, map-based interfaces, or data visualizations.
  • Familiarity with streaming data, distributed systems, or synchronizing application state between frontend and backend.
  • Experience investigating and improving browser performance, API latency, or backend service reliability.
  • Experience collaborating with product and design to improve usability based on user feedback.
  • Familiarity with autonomous vehicles, robotics, telemetry, or remote assistance systems. Prior domain experience is helpful but not required.
  • AV specific industry knowledge
  • Remote assistance specific knowledge

For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year - USD $190,000 per year.

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

title: Assistant Maintenance - 3101 Place - Rosenberg, TX
description:

title: Salgsassistent til Vallensbæk (30 timer)
description:
Her skaber vi resultater, sammen

Brænder du for salg og motiveres du af at skabe kundeoplevelser, der gør en forskel?

Hos Maxi Zoo i Vallensbæk bliver du en del af et engageret team, hvor stærk rådgivning, salg og samarbejde går hånd i hånd. Du får en alsidig hverdag med kundekontakt, vareopfyldning og ansvar, samtidig med at du udvikler dine kompetencer og bidrager til butikkens salgsresultater.

Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes i fællesskab. Derfor hjælper vi hinanden, deler viden og arbejder hver dag for at give kunderne en oplevelse, der får dem til at komme igen.

Som en del af hverdagen i Vallensbæk-butikken kommer du bl.a. til at:

Du behøver ikke at være ekspert i kæledyr, men vi forestiller dig, at du har erfaring fra butik.

Det får du hos Maxi Zoo

  • 30 timer/uge
  • Lokation: Vallensbæk stationstorv 10, 2635 Vallensbæk Strand

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: HR Systems & Talent Acquistion Specialist
description:

Inlighten Technologies is seeking a proactive, detail-oriented HR Systems & Talent Acquisition Specialist to help build a robust, integrated, and scalable HR systems infrastructure to support the company's growth. Reporting to the Head of HR, this role will focus on HR systems implementation and optimization, process automation, HR data and analytics, and talent acquisition. The Specialist will collaborate with HR leadership, hiring managers, IT, employees, and external partners to establish efficient workflows, strengthen data integrity, and deliver an effective employee and candidate experience.

The ideal candidate combines HR technology expertise with hands-on recruiting experience and a passion for building scalable HR processes in a growing technology organization.

Key Responsibilities

HR Systems & Process Optimization

  • Partner with the Head of HR to build, implement, and optimize a robust and integrated HR systems infrastructure.
  • Administer and enhance HR platforms, including ADP RUN/ADP Workforce Now/TriNet, BambooHR, and related systems, as applicable.
  • Support system configuration, implementation, integrations, data migration, troubleshooting, workflow automation, and user training.
  • Develop standardized workflows for onboarding, employee changes, performance management, benefits, timekeeping, and offboarding.

Talent Acquisition & Recruiting

Employee Lifecycle & HR Programs

Ideal Candidate

They combine strong HR technology capabilities with recruiting execution, analytical skills, and a continuous improvement mindset. They are proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable translating HR needs into practical, scalable technology solutions and efficient people processes.

Work Environment

title: Senior Full Stack Software Developer
description:
The Opportunity

Manufacturing powers the global economy at $50T a year and it relies heavily on human dexterity and skill to produce the goods we rely on every day. Yet manufacturers have little visibility when issues arise at manual assembly stations, impacting productivity and quality.

Assembler AI is changing that.

We use computer vision and artificial intelligence to help manufacturers improve quality, reduce waste, increase throughput, and enable frontline employees to perform at their best.

Backed by Diagram Ventures, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of AI, manufacturing, and operational excellence.

The role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Developer, you'll design, build and ship the interfaces operators and engineers use to act on what
Operator Vision sees — from the dashboards that surface flagged events and video clips to the tools continuous improvement
engineers use every day. You'll work primarily in React/Next.js and contribute to the backend services that power those interfaces,
working closely with our Head of Engineering and the AI R&D team. You take pride in building and delivering high quality, highly
usable software with high velocity? This is for you!

What you'll do

  • Design and build the frontend of Operator Vision in React/Next.js — from real-time dashboards showing flagged events and video
    clips to the tools operators and continuous improvement engineers use every shift.
  • Turn design and product requirements into polished, accessible, production-ready UI, and help shape our design system and
    frontend conventions as the team grows.
  • Participate in defining the product's frontend architecture, working closely with the Head of Engineering and Head of Product on
    the tradeoffs that keep the interface fast and responsive as data volume grows.
  • Contribute to the backend, designing and evolving the backend services that support the features you build on the frontend,
    working closely with the core backend developers.
  • Contribute to defining and putting in place development conventions — code standards, testing practices, and how the team uses
    agentic coding tools to move faster without cutting corners.
  • Contribute to building the CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices that let the team ship fast, safely

What we're looking for

  • Seasoned full stack engineer with deep, demonstrated expertise in React and Next.js, and a strong command of modern
    TypeScript/JavaScript as well as backend stack.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with a track record of owning full stack features end-to-end in
    production.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing and shipping highly usable, performant and reliable web applications in production — not just in
    theory.
  • Demonstrated expertise in contributing to backend code — APIs and database queries — in Python or a similarly high-level
    language; you don't need to own infrastructure, but you're effective working below the UI layer.
    - Experience with the stack we leverage in our platform, or equivalent:
    - React, Next.js, TypeScript
    - FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Postgres
  • Demonstrated experience working as part of a startup, owning outcomes end-to-end, moving fast with limited resources, and
    building scale before scale is guaranteed.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to meaningfully accelerate
    development velocity.
  • Strong instincts for state management, data fetching, and building interfaces that stay reliable and fast under real-world
    production load.
  • Experience with design systems and component libraries (nice to have).
  • Experience with Test Driven Development methodology (nice to have).— code standards, testing practices, and how the team uses
    agentic coding tools to move faster without cutting corners.

Why join

  • The chance to build the interfaces operators rely on, every shift, on live production lines at a real manufacturing scale.
  • Direct collaboration with our Head of Engineering and founders.
  • Real influence over the product, engineering standards, tooling, and how we use AI in our own development process

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Competitive Health benefits
  • Health and wellness spending account, from $500 to $1,000 annually
  • Latest MacBook
  • Opportunity to grow as the company scales

L'occasion

Le secteur manufacturier fait rouler l'économie mondiale, avec 50 000 milliards de dollars par année, et il repose largement sur la dextérité et le savoir-faire des gens pour produire les biens dont nous dépendons tous les jours. Pourtant, les manufacturiers ont peu de visibilité quand un problème survient aux postes d'assemblage manuel, ce qui nuit à la productivité et à la qualité.

Assembler AI change la donne.

Nous utilisons la vision par ordinateur et l'intelligence artificielle pour aider les manufacturiers à améliorer la qualité, à réduire le gaspillage, à augmenter la cadence de production et à permettre aux employés de plancher de donner leur pleine mesure.

Appuyés par Diagram Ventures, nous bâtissons une entreprise qui définit sa catégorie, à la croisée de l'IA, de la fabrication et de l'excellence opérationnelle.

Le poste

À titre de développeur logiciel Full Stack senior, vous concevrez, développerez et livrerez les interfaces que les opérateurs et les ingénieurs utilisent pour agir sur ce qu'Operator Vision détecte — des tableaux de bord qui présentent les événements signalés et les extraits vidéo aux outils utilisés chaque jour par les ingénieurs en amélioration continue. Vous travaillerez principalement avec React/Next.js et contribuerez aux services backend qui alimentent ces interfaces, en étroite collaboration avec notre chef de l'ingénierie et l'équipe de R-D en IA. Vous êtes fier de créer et de livrer des logiciels de grande qualité, très faciles à utiliser, à un rythme soutenu ? Ce poste est pour vous!

Ce que vous ferez

  • Concevoir et développer le frontend d'Operator Vision avec React/Next.js — des tableaux de bord en temps réel affichant les événements signalés et les extraits vidéo aux outils utilisés à chaque quart de travail par les opérateurs et les ingénieurs en amélioration continue.
  • Transformer les exigences de conception et de produit en interfaces soignées, accessibles et prêtes pour la production, et contribuer à façonner notre système de design et nos conventions frontend à mesure que l'équipe grandit.
  • Participer à la définition de l'architecture frontend du produit, en étroite collaboration avec le chef de l'ingénierie et le chef de produit sur les compromis qui gardent l'interface rapide et réactive à mesure que le volume de données augmente.
  • Contribuer au backend en concevant et en faisant évoluer les services backend qui soutiennent les fonctionnalités que vous développez côté frontend, en étroite collaboration avec les développeurs backend principaux.
  • Contribuer à définir et à mettre en place des conventions de développement — normes de code, pratiques de test et utilisation des outils de codage agentiques par l'équipe pour gagner en vitesse sans négliger la qualité.
  • Contribuer à la mise en place des pipelines CI/CD et des pratiques de déploiement qui permettent à l'équipe de livrer rapidement et en toute sécurité.

Ce que nous recherchons

  • Développeur full stack chevronné possédant une expertise approfondie et démontrée en React et Next.js, ainsi qu'une solide maîtrise du TypeScript/JavaScript moderne et d'un stack backend.
  • 7 ans et plus d'expérience professionnelle en développement logiciel, avec un historique démontré de prise en charge de fonctionnalités full stack de bout en bout en production.
  • Expertise démontrée dans la conception et la livraison d'applications Web très faciles à utiliser, performantes et fiables en production — pas seulement en théorie.
  • Expertise démontrée dans la contribution au code backend — API et requêtes de base de données — en Python ou dans un langage de haut niveau similaire ; vous êtes efficace sous la couche d'interface utilisateur.
  • Expérience avec la stack que nous utilisons dans notre plateforme, ou l'équivalent :
    • React, Next.js, TypeScript
    • FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Postgres
  • Expérience démontrée au sein d'une startup, avec prise en charge des résultats de bout en bout, capacité à avancer rapidement avec des ressources limitées et à construire pour l'échelle avant que l'échelle ne soit garantie.
  • Expérience démontrée dans l'utilisation d'outils de codage agentiques comme Claude Code, Cursor ou GitHub Copilot pour accélérer de façon significative la vélocité de développement.
  • Solides instincts en gestion d'état, récupération de données et conception d'interfaces qui demeurent fiables et rapides sous une charge réelle de production.
  • Expérience avec les systèmes de design et les bibliothèques de composants (un atout).
  • Expérience avec la méthodologie de développement piloté par les tests (TDD) (un atout).

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous

  • La chance de bâtir les interfaces sur lesquelles les opérateurs comptent, à chaque quart de travail, sur des lignes de production actives à l'échelle manufacturière réelle.
  • Une collaboration directe avec notre chef de l'ingénierie et les fondateurs.
  • Une influence réelle sur le produit, les normes d'ingénierie, l'outillage et la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans notre propre processus de développement.

Rémunération et avantages sociaux

  • Salaire concurrentiel et options d'achat d'actions
  • Assurance collective concurrentielle
  • Compte de dépenses santé et mieux-être, de 500 $ à 1 000 $ par année
  • MacBook récent et outils de travail modernes
  • Occasion de grandir avec l'entreprise

title: Senior Soldering Technician
description:
Senior Soldering Technician — Through-Hole & LED Assembly

Build the technology behind the wonder.

At WET, we bring water, movement, light, and imagination together to create experiences that connect people with the world—and with one another. Our work transforms public spaces into places of wonder, where engineering and artistry make the extraordinary possible.

From The Fountains of Bellagio to The Dubai Fountain, the experience begins long before the water moves or the lights come on. It starts with talented people who take pride in building every component with precision.

We are looking for a Senior Soldering Technician with strong through-hole soldering skills, hands-on electrical assembly experience, and a commitment to exceptional workmanship. Your work will help bring the LED lighting systems behind WET’s water features to life.

Your impact

You will assemble, solder, and test LED light heads, cables, and power supplies used across a variety of lighting configurations. This role combines detailed electronics work with mechanical assembly: building delicate components into complete, tested assemblies ready for their final destination.

Working alongside production and engineering teams, you will turn drawings, schematics, and work instructions into reliable hardware. Every connection, assembly, and test contributes to the quality of the final experience.

What you’ll do

  • Perform precision through-hole soldering on printed circuit boards (PCBs), including component preparation, placement, soldering, and cleaning.
  • Inspect your workmanship for consistent solder joints, correct component placement, and assembly quality; identify and address defects according to approved procedures.
  • Assemble LED light heads, cable assemblies, connectors, and power supplies using electrical and mechanical assembly techniques.
  • Prepare, dress, route, terminate, and repair cables and connectors as required by assembly drawings and work instructions.
  • Stage components, set up your workstation, and build lighting hardware from individual parts through completed assemblies.
  • Read and interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, specifications, and test instructions.
  • Use small manual, powered, and pneumatic tools, along with calibrated torque wrenches, ohmmeters, and programming equipment.
  • Perform required electrical and functional checks, document results, and communicate assembly or test issues.
  • Handle fragile components and small assemblies with care throughout the build and test process.
  • Collaborate with production engineers to clarify build requirements, resolve assembly challenges, and document processes.
  • Complete work safely, accurately, and on schedule while maintaining an organized workstation.
  • Support related production activities as priorities evolve.

What you bring

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • At least five years of hands-on electrical or electronics assembly experience, with a strong emphasis on soldering.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in through-hole soldering and detailed PCB assembly.
  • Ability to read and follow drawings, schematics, assembly procedures, and test instructions.
  • Practical understanding of electrical connections and mechanical integration.
  • Experience using small assembly tools and electrical test equipment.
  • Careful workmanship, strong attention to detail, and the ability to handle delicate components.
  • A collaborative approach to problem-solving and a sense of urgency that never compromises safety or quality.

Experience that stands out

  • Formal training in electronics assembly or soldering.
  • Advanced through-hole soldering and component rework experience.
  • Experience assembling LED lighting hardware, power supplies, or cable assemblies.
  • Familiarity with cable dressing, cable trays, conduit, and connector installation or repair.
  • Experience in a fast-paced production environment with changing build priorities.
  • A track record of helping engineering and production teams improve assembly methods and documentation.

Additional requirements

  • Ability to lift and move items weighing 30 pounds or more, with reasonable accommodation as applicable.
  • Availability to work overtime and weekends as production needs require.

Why WET?

This is hands-on work with a visible purpose. The hardware you build becomes part of experiences that people gather to watch, feel, and remember.

At WET, we value people who are curious, resourceful, collaborative, and driven to solve difficult problems. If you take pride in precise work, enjoy understanding how things come together, and want your craftsmanship to contribute to something extraordinary, you belong on our team.

title: Conceptual Reasoning Fellow
location: Remote-Friendly, United States; San Francisco, CA
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Program Overview

Many of the questions that will shape our future have no single checkable answer. Reasoning well about them, whether in law, policy, philosophy, economics, cognitive science, or AI safety itself, takes the kind of judgment experts spend years building. We believe frontier AI, developed safely, can become a real partner on these questions, but getting there means working closely with the people who know these fields best.

This fellowship brings researchers and experts from philosophy, cognitive science, economics, policy, and law into Anthropic for four months to work alongside our research teams. Fellows pair deep domain expertise with our frontier models and internal tooling to evaluate, improve, and apply Claude's capabilities in their field.

What to Expect:

  • A concrete, scoped project matched to your background, with mentorship from Anthropic researchers.
  • Access to frontier Claude models and internal evaluation tooling.
  • A cohort of incoming Fellows to collaborate with and a connection to Anthropic's broader research community.

Compensation:

$100,000–$167,000 USD for the four-month fellowship (equivalent to $300,000–$500,000 USD annualized), and other benefits.

Key responsibilities

  • Identifying key open problems in your field, assessing approaches to solving them, and using Claude to make progress on them.
  • Identifying grand societal challenges which the expertise of your field is crucial for addressing, and assessing Claude’s strengths and weaknesses in tackling them.
  • Designing evaluations and RL environments that test models in your field systematically, turning your expertise into working tests of how well Claude reasons in your field.
  • Team up with other Fellows in your field to build environments that push Claude on the hardest, most judgment-heavy problems your discipline has to offer.

Minimum qualifications

  • Are excited about the potential for AI to reason well about hard questions in their field where expert judgment matters.
  • Hands-on experience using Claude and Claude Code in your day-to-day workflow.
  • Hold (or are completing) a PhD in philosophy, cognitive science, economics, policy or law, or have equivalent research experience.
  • Are comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-agency atmosphere for a few months and delivering concrete results.
  • Existing authorization to work in the United States for the duration of the program.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience designing evaluations, benchmarks, datasets, or expert rubrics.
  • Demonstrated expertise in your field, shown through research, scholarship, or expert-level analytical writing.

Representative projects

  • A philosopher building hard cases that require normative judgment in ethics or formal epistemology.
  • A cognitive scientist designing experimental-design and model-comparison tasks.
  • An economist writing modelling and identification problems with ground truth.
  • A policy scholar drafting regulatory and cost-benefit analysis tasks with expert rubrics.
  • A legal scholar building AI-policy-relevant law datasets.

Logistics - Fellows

  • The program runs from January 12th to May 8th 2027, and is full-time for the duration; some fellowships may be considered for an extension.
  • Applications are open until October 28, 2026, and we plan to make offers by November 20th. Later stages will typically include a take-home exercise and conversations with our research team and potential mentors about your research interests and possible project directions.
  • We ask that all Fellows attend a one-week in-person orientation in San Francisco.
  • The default location is in San Francisco. We will consider remote engagements within the United States in certain circumstances.
  • We are not currently able to sponsor visas for fellows. To participate in the Fellows program, you need to have or independently obtain full-time work authorization in the United States.
  • This is a fixed-term contract position. Fellows are engaged through an employer of record, rather than employed directly by Anthropic.

The below are Anthropic's policies for full time roles. These do NOT apply to the Fellows Program.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Senior Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE)
description:
Vista Government Solutions (VGS) is seeking a Senior Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE) to support the Uniformed Services University Health Sciences (USUHS) Network Operations Center Cyber Support Services Task Order. The Senior Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE) provides technical cybersecurity and Risk Management Framework (RMF) support for the rewrite and modernization of the Agency's Office 365 (O365) Authorization to Operate (ATO) package. The ISSE evaluates existing authorization documentation, technical configurations, system architecture, security-control implementation, and supporting evidence to develop accurate, complete, and eMASS-ready RMF artifacts. NOC Cyber_PD SR ISSE The ISSE works in coordination with the Government ISSM and technical stakeholders to ensure that security documentation accurately reflects the implemented O365 environment and applicable DoD and NIST cybersecurity requirements. The Government ISSM retains responsibility for cybersecurity governance, formal risk management oversight, and coordination with the authorization chain. NOC Cyber_PD SR ISSE

What You’ll Do:

  • Provide oversight and technical guidance to MS InTune and SCCM Endpoint Engineers.
  • Support the comprehensive rewrite and modernization of the Agency's O365 ATO package and associated eMASS documentation.
  • Review existing RMF and Information Assurance documentation to identify outdated, incomplete, duplicative, or technically inaccurate information.
  • Develop and update System Security Plan (SSP) content, security-control implementation statements, POA&M documentation, inheritance mappings, system diagrams, and other required authorization artifacts.
  • Analyze applicable NIST SP 800-53 controls, DoD security requirements, DISA guidance, and inherited enterprise controls to determine documentation and evidence requirements.
  • Review Microsoft 365/O365 configurations and supporting technical artifacts to determine how security controls are implemented within the operational environment.
  • Coordinate with Microsoft 365 engineers, system administrators, endpoint engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and other technical SMEs to collect and validate information required for the ATO package.
  • Review technical evidence and supporting artifacts for completeness, consistency, traceability, and alignment with documented security-control implementation.
  • Document applicable Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM), endpoint security, encryption, continuous monitoring, and Zero Trust capabilities as they relate to the O365 authorization boundary.
  • Identify documentation and evidence gaps and coordinate with appropriate technical stakeholders to support resolution.
  • Support development and maintenance of POA&Ms and associated remediation documentation for identified deficiencies. NOC Cyber_PD SR ISSE
  • Utilize eMASS to develop, update, organize, and maintain authorization artifacts and supporting evidence.
  • Support the Government ISSM in preparing the O365 authorization package for review by applicable cybersecurity and authorization stakeholders.
  • Address technical documentation deficiencies, questions, and comments identified during Government review of the authorization package.
  • Support development of a technically accurate, complete, traceable, and submission-ready O365 ATO package.
  • Maintain configuration, documentation, and evidence traceability throughout the ATO rewrite effort.
  • Support knowledge transfer and development of repeatable processes for maintaining authorization documentation following completion of the rewrite. NOC Cyber_PD SR ISSE

What You Bring:

Required:

  • Active Secret clearance.
  • Security+ or higher certification.
  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

What We Offer:

title: Legal Senior Onsite Service Specialist
description:
$18.22 - $25.00 per hour

Legal Senior Onsite Service Specialist
