title: Technical Standards Specialist
description:
Digital First for Annuities Initiative:

IRI is moving to a digital-first strategy that means adopting fast, modern, streamlined processes consistent across the Annuities industry for each step in the financial professional and consumer journey. Essentially, IRI is creating standardized rules of engagement for how the industry delivers essential data.

Position Summary

The Technical Standards Specialist will be responsible for creating, documenting, maintaining, and governing technical standards, including standards expressed in YAML, webhooks, and event-based formats. This role will translate complex technical requirements into clear, consistent, and usable documentation and standards for both technical and non-technical audiences, following established Digital First standards, formats, and style guidelines.

Working closely with internal teams, industry experts, members, and other stakeholders, the Technical Standards Specialist will help establish and maintain standards that are clear, scalable, well-documented, and aligned with industry needs. The ideal candidate combines strong technical aptitude with strong written and verbal communication, organization, and stakeholder-management skills.

Key Responsibilities

Standards Creation & Maintenance

  • Create, document, and maintain YAML-based standards, event-based and webhook standards, schemas, configurations, and related technical specifications.
  • Apply and maintain consistent technical structures, naming conventions, validation requirements, and documentation practices across Digital First standards.
  • Review existing standards and identify opportunities to improve consistency, usability, clarity, and scalability.
  • Manage version control and document changes throughout the standards lifecycle.
  • Support the technical processes for reviewing, updating, and retiring standards.

Technical Documentation

  • Create clear, accurate, and accessible technical documentation for standards, schemas, specifications, and related processes.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into language that can be understood by both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Develop documentation, implementation guides, reference materials, FAQs, and other resources to support adoption of standards.

Industry & Stakeholder Engagement

title: Early Childhood Educators - Express Entry Hiring
description:
Express Entry Hiring - For Document-Ready Candidates

This Express Entry opportunity is intended for candidates who already have their required documentation available and are ready to move through the recruitment and onboarding process promptly.

About Sentient HR:

Sentient HR provides staffing solutions to licensed childcare centres across Ontario. We are committed to helping educators grow, develop professionally, and thrive in their roles.

We are currently seeking Registered Early Childhood Educators (RECEs) and Early Childhood Assistants (ECAs) to support licensed childcare centres in Toronto (North York).

Our Express Entry Hiring opportunity is designed for candidates who already have the required employment and onboarding documentation ready and are available to move through an accelerated recruitment process. Eligible candidates will complete a brief 15-minute screening interview and, if selected, proceed directly to the offer and onboarding process.

Please apply through this Express Entry posting only if you have all applicable required documentation listed below ready and available for submission.

In this role, you will support the care, learning, development, and safety of children from infant to school age. Depending on your qualifications and the needs of the centre, you may support or lead age-appropriate programming while working collaboratively with centre staff to provide a safe, inclusive, and high-quality childcare environment.

Why Choose Us?

We want you to become a part of our growth!

  • On-the-job training and professional development opportunities.
  • Three months of a public transit or gas card when you work 10+ shifts per month.
  • Participation in Sentient HR's reward and recognition program, PERKS.

Working Conditions

  • Occasional light to medium physical effort, including lifting, bending, and stooping.
  • Ability to work outdoors in all seasons.
  • Work assignments may vary based on childcare centre staffing needs.

Responsibilities

  • Support the implementation of developmentally appropriate programs and daily activities.
  • RECEs may be required to fulfill lead educator responsibilities and implement programming in accordance with centre requirements.
  • Promote the physical, social, emotional, and intellectual well-being of children.
  • Supervise children and prioritize their health, safety, and well-being.
  • Understand and comply with the Child Care and Early Years Act (CCEYA), public health requirements, centre policies, and Sentient HR policies.
  • Facilitate and participate with children in planned activities and learning experiences.
  • Observe children's development and support required documentation in accordance with the responsibilities of the assigned role.
  • Report issues, incidents, or concerns in accordance with centre procedures.
  • Build positive and professional relationships with children, families, centre staff, and colleagues.
  • Work cooperatively as part of the childcare centre team and maintain a positive and professional attitude.
  • Perform other duties appropriate to the assigned role.

Requirements

For RECE Applicants

  • ECE Diploma from a recognized Ontario college or equivalent recognized qualification.
  • Registered and in Good Standing with the College of Early Childhood Educators.

For ECA Applicants

  • Previous childcare experience of at least 1 year and/or relevant education is preferred.
  • Ability to effectively support RECEs and other childcare centre staff in providing high-quality care and programming.

Requirements for All Applicants

  • Clear Vulnerable Sector Check completed within the required timeframe.
  • Valid Standard First Aid and CPR-C certification.
  • Knowledge of or willingness to become familiar with How Does Learning Happen? (HDLH), AQI, and CCEYA.
  • Reliable transportation and ability to travel to assignments within Toronto.
  • Ability to work effectively with children from infant to school age.
  • Strong communication, reliability, and teamwork skills.

Express Entry Documentation Requirements

Before applying, please ensure you have all applicable documentation below ready for submission:

  • Vulnerable Sector Check (VSC): A clear Vulnerable Sector Check for employment purposes that is not more than 6 months old, or a VSC payment/application receipt if your completed VSC is still being processed.
  • First Aid & CPR: Valid Standard or Intermediate First Aid with CPR-C certification.
  • Immunization Records: Complete immunization documentation covering the applicable immunization requirements, with records signed/stamped or otherwise formally verified by the clinic/healthcare provider.
  • TB Documentation: Valid TB screening documentation completed within the last 6 months, including:
    • a 2-step TB test; or
    • a 1-step TB test where a previous 2-step TB test has already been completed; or
    • applicable chest X-ray documentation.
  • Where an applicable chest X-ray was completed more than 3 months ago, physician confirmation that the candidate is free of TB disease will be required in accordance with Sentient HR's medical documentation requirements.
  • RECE Registration, if applicable: Current registration with the College of Early Childhood Educators showing the candidate's name, registration number, and Good Standing.
  • ECE Diploma, if applicable/available: A copy of the candidate's ECE Diploma or equivalent recognized qualification.
  • Updated Resume: A current copy of the candidate's resume.

Applicants applying through Express Entry should have the above applicable documents ready at the time of application.

Additional employment and onboarding documentation will be requested from successful candidates as part of Sentient HR's onboarding process.

Application Details

Qualified and interested RECE and ECA candidates who meet the Express Entry documentation requirements are encouraged to apply directly.

Sentient HR is dedicated to fostering equal opportunities for all applicants and employees, irrespective of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic or national origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, record of offences for which a pardon has been granted, disability, marital or family status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We appreciate all applications; however, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Protection Associate - Casework (G5) - Monrovia, Liberia
description:
Under the overall supervision of the Chief of Mission (CoM) and the direct supervisor of the Protection Officer and in close cooperation with relevant departments at Headquarters (HQs) and Regional Office (RO), the Protection Associate-Casework will contribute to the provision of protection assistance through case identification, assessment, case management, referrals, follow-up, information provision, and coordination with relevant service providers to ensure that vulnerable individuals receive timely and appropriate support.

  1. Carry out screening interviews with migrants to collect relevant information and support the identification of migrants who may require assistance, in line with established procedures.

  2. Refer eligible beneficiaries, including unaccompanied migrant children, victims of trafficking, medical cases, and other vulnerable migrants, for available services (medical, psychosocial, assisted voluntary return and reintegration, legal assistance) as per guidance received and within the limits of resources available.

  3. Assist IOM GAVR beneficiaries through the provision of information on the services available for migrants in Liberia, including services such as individual counseling sessions provided by specialised service providers, and distribute information sheets, leaflets and brochures regarding social or medical services in Liberia.

  4. Provide individualised and group orientation and support migrants through referrals to services available, including social services, medical assistance and legal services.

  5. Follow-up with IOM partners responsible for provision of assistance provided through referral.

  6. Support the process of case management.

  7. Support administrative and financial processes related to direct assistance to vulnerable migrants, in accordance with established procedures.

  8. Assist in the implementation of outreach activities, including the identification and assistance to beneficiaries in IOM supported shelters and other, in case of urgency also outside office hours.

  9. Compile case reports and maintain case files for each beneficiary assisted and prepare statistical reports as requested, while adhering to IOM data protection standards; and using the existing IOM data base platform.

  10. Maintain a professional and neutral behaviour, as well as empathy with migrants.

  11. Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.

EDUCATION

  • Master’s degree in Social Sciences, Social Work, Psychology, Political Science, Law, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with two years of relevant professional experience; or

  • Bachelor’s degree in the above fields with four years of relevant professional experience.

EXPERIENCE

  • Experience in protection case management (including for survivors GBV and human trafficking, children at risk) in humanitarian or migration contexts.

  • Experience working with vulnerable persons, ideally including returnees or deported migrants, who have complex needs.

  • Experience with referrals and coordination with local protection actors, NGOs, or government services.

  • Experience working in programs that include a movement operations component is an advantage.

  • Experience with IOM or other UN agencies, particularly working on assisted voluntary return and reintegration programs, is preferred.

SKILLS

  • Knowledge of IOM and Inter-agency protection standards and operational guidelines, including IOM Case Management Guidelines. Knowledge of human rights and international migration law is an asset.

  • Knowledge of MiMOSA is a strong asset.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, ability to interact respectfully with migrants with trauma or complex needs, and proven ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with people of diverse cultural and national backgrounds.

  • Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.

  • Ability to deliver assistance in challenging conditions; adaptability and good judgment.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills; ability to prepare case notes and reports.

  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel), tools used for case management.

SECTION 5

Languages
IOM’s official languages are English, French, and Spanish.

REQUIRED

For this position, fluency in English is required (oral and written).

DESIRABLE

Knowledge of Spanish, Tigrinya, and Arabic is an advantage.

title: Flexibele assistent begeleider Kind en Jeugd
description:
Als assistent begeleider voeg jij graag iets toe aan de ontwikkeling van kinderen met een ontwikkelingsachterstand. Jij sluit makkelijk aan bij de belevingswereld van kinderen en kunt moeiteloos schakelen tussen verschillende begeleidingsstijlen? Dan ben JIJ de juiste persoon die wij zoeken. Solliciteer dan direct!

Wat ga je doen?

Als flexibele assistent begeleider bied je naast een ervaren collega de dagelijkse zorg en begeleiding voor meerdere kinderen op een groep. Op elke groep wordt een vast dagprogramma gevolgd dat gericht is het stimuleren van de verschillende ontwikkelingsgebieden. Het dagprogramma is afgestemd op de hulpvraag en begeleidingsbehoefte van de kinderen en bevat zowel individuele als groepsactiviteiten. Het activiteiten aanbod is gevarieerd. Er wordt gekeken naar wat aansluit bij het kind. Tijdens je dienst rapporteer je ook op de voortgang van de ontwikkeldoelen per kind.

Je bent een assistent begeleider die het leuk vindt op één of meerdere groepen ingezet te worden als collega in de flexibele schil van de locatie. Je hebt tevens ook een actieve rol binnen de Lotusbloem als geheel.

Waar kom je te werken?

KDC de Lotusbloem is een kinderdienstencentrum voor ca. 40 kinderen met een (ernstig) verstandelijke beperking en/of een ontwikkelingsachterstand in de leeftijd van 3 t/m 18 jaar, verdeeld over 6 groepen. KDC de Lotusbloem heeft als doel om een omgeving en de voorwaarden te creëren die de mogelijkheden van elk kind op motorisch, cognitief en sociaal emotioneel gebied zo goed mogelijk stimuleert voor een optimale ontwikkeling.

Als flexibele assistent begeleider ben je onderdeel van het hele begeleidings- en behandelteam van het kinderdienstencentrum. Binnen de Lotusbloem werken we volgens de basismethodiek Triple C. We zijn als heel team nog bezig om het implementatieproces af te ronden. Daarnaast staat op alle groepen Totale Ondersteunende Communicatie en Themagericht werken centraal. Op de groepen heerst een pedagogisch- therapeutisch behandelklimaat en de kinderen hebben extra ondersteuning nodig vanuit een interdisciplinair team om zich optimaal te kunnen ontwikkelen. Het interdisciplinair team bestaat uit: groepsbegeleiders, begeleider coach, gedragsdeskundige, ergotherapeut, fysiotherapeut en logopedist.

We zijn op zoek naar meerdere nieuwe collega’s. De vacature is voor de verschillende groepen, de verlengde dagbesteding en de zaterdagopvang. We bespreken samen waar je kwaliteiten en wensen liggen, hoe veel uren je per week zou willen werken en maken daar afspraken over.

Dit krijg je

Als assistent begeleider werk je 7 tot 24 uur, afhankelijk van de openstaande vacatures op de locatie en jouw wensen. En je mag rekenen op:

  • een goed salaris: Als assistent begeleider betekent dit tussen €2.649,- en € 3.708,- (schaal 35 van de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg).

  • extra’s die tellen: 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%.

  • tijdelijke bonus: Op deze locatie is een maandelijkse toelage van 7,5% bovenop je salaris als je op bepaalde woningen werkt.

  • eigen regie op extra arbeidsvoorwaarden via Epassi: Je ontvangt een vitaliteitsbonus van €250 bruto per kwartaal (naar rato) als je een kwartaal niet ziek bent. Die zet je flexibel in via Epassi, een digitaal platform waarin jij zelf kiest waaraan je je bonus besteedt en of het jaarlijkse fiscale voordeel benut. Denk aan sport, boodschappen of een leuk uitje. Kies je niet? Dan wordt de vitaliteitsbonus aan het eind van het jaar aan je uitbetaald.

  • vrije dagen: 18 verlofdagen + ruim 7 balansverlofdagen per jaar (naar rato). Dit laatste kun je opnemen, opsparen of investeren in jezelf.

  • pensioen bij Zorg en Welzijn: Goed geregeld voor later.

  • eigen ontwikkeling: Trainingen en cursussen om te groeien in je vak.

  • reiskostenvergoeding: Zodat je zorgeloos naar je werk reist.

Wanneer pas je bij deze functie?

  • Jij bent een verbinder die denkt in mogelijkheden;

  • Het kunnen bieden van een dagstructuur waarbij basisveiligheid en het kunnen bieden van duidelijkheid en veiligheid voorop staat, gaat je heel natuurlijk af;

  • Je hebt een grote mate van zelfstandigheid en flexibiliteit en je kunt makkelijk schakelen in begeleidingsstijlen;

  • Je bent duidelijk in communicatie naar zowel de kinderen, hun ouders als collega’s;

  • Je bent empathisch, blijft geduldig en toont begrip. Het geven en ontvangen van feedback zie je als waardevol element in je samenwerking;

  • Je hebt een gerichte opleiding op minimaal niveau 3.

Nog niet het juiste diploma?
Heb je een mbo- of hbo-achtergrond én herken je jezelf in wat dit werk van je vraagt? Dan kijken we graag verder dan alleen je diploma. Samen onderzoeken we welke route bij jou past, bijvoorbeeld starten als begeleider in opleiding of leren en werken.

Direct solliciteren?

Wil je eerst meer weten over de functie, onze organisatie of de sollicitatieprocedure? Neem dan contact op met Manon Verkuijl via

m.groen-verkuijl@onstweedethuis.nl en 0657406377

Mortenson is currently seeking a Lean Engineer to join our Solar group. This position will also support the overall Lean organization which will involve: data harnessing (collecting, organizing, and analyzing project information to guide better decision-making) and lead bigger projects that span across business functions.

Join us and challenge your IT expertise and analytical skills to help create vehicles that are as smart as you are.

Join Ford’s Enterprise Technology organization and help shape the global digital Ford.com and Lincoln.com non-vehicle ecommerce experience. The team is expanding how customers discover and purchase parts, accessories, and branded merchandise for both Ford and Lincoln online. As part of the global digital team, you will help make these shopping experiences useful, intuitive, and connected to the broader Ford and Lincoln brands.

In this position...

As the Non-Vehicle Ecommerce Group Product Manager for Parts, Accessories, and Merchandise, you will lead and mentor a team of product managers responsible for the strategy and evolution of Ford.com and Lincoln.com non-vehicle ecommerce experiences. You will set product direction, translate customer and business needs into an actionable roadmap, and work with design, engineering, analytics, merchandising, marketing, and other partners to deliver and continuously improve the end-to-end shopping journey—which includes both customer-facing commerce experiences and foundational commerce platforms that enable the experiences such as Product Information Management (PIM), Pricing, Promotion, and Order Management Systems (OMS). You will use customer insights and performance data to prioritize opportunities, improve conversion and usability, and support growth across Ford and Lincoln parts, accessories, and merchandise.

Based in Dearborn, MI, this is a hybrid position with a requirement to be onsite four or more days per week. Relocation assistance may be available for qualified candidates. Candidates who live in or are willing to relocate to Southeast Michigan are strongly preferred. The team collaborates across time zones, and availability during Eastern Time business hours is expected

What you'll do...

  • Leadership & strategy: Set direction, objectives, and priorities for the product management team, aligning its work with Enterprise Technology and Ford and Lincoln Non-Vehicle Commerce business goals.
  • Team leadership: Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of ecommerce product managers; provide coaching and support that strengthens product practice and delivery.
  • Portfolio and platform leadership: Lead a portfolio of ecommerce product teams responsible for the end-to end customer journey for both customer-facing Non-Vehicle Commerce experiences and foundational commerce platforms supporting Ford and Lincoln Parts, Accessories, and Branded Merchandise, including Product Information Management (PIM), Pricing, Promotion, and Order Management Systems (OMS) capabilities.
  • AI-enabled product strategy: Guide product strategy for key Non-Vehicle Commerce capabilities including search, recommendations, personalization, and AI-enabled customer experiences across Ford and Lincoln ecommerce platforms.
  • Emerging technology & industry leadership: Evaluate and apply emerging technologies and eCommerce insights, including AI and automation, to improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and product team effectiveness and innovation.
  • Business outcomes & performance optimization: Own and monitor key Non-Vehicle Commerce metrics, customer feedback, and research to prioritize data-driven opportunities that improve conversion, revenue growth, engagement, and customer satisfaction.
  • Experimentation: Establish and scale a culture of experimentation by leveraging A/B testing, customer research, and analytics to validate opportunities and optimize customer experiences.
  • Omnichannel Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap that connect Ford and Lincoln Non-Vehicle Commerce experiences for Parts, Accessories, and Branded Merchandise across Ford.com, Lincoln.com, mobile applications, dealer touchpoints, marketplaces, and emerging commerce channels.
  • End-to-end product management: Guide products across the full ecommerce funnel, including discovery, browse, product detail, cart, checkout, and relevant post-purchase experiences.
  • Stakeholder engagement: Partner with senior leaders and stakeholders across the global digital Ford and Lincoln Non-Vehicle Commerce team, including design, engineering, analytics, merchandising, marketing, and operations, to align on outcomes and priorities.
  • Cross-functional delivery: Work closely with UX and engineering teams to shape requirements, make trade-offs, remove roadblocks, and deliver accessible, reliable, and engaging customer experiences.
  • Budget & resource management: Plan resources and manage budgets for product initiatives, ensuring investment is focused on agreed priorities and outcomes.

You'll have...

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
  • 5+ years of experience in ecommerce product management, with a track record of strong leadership and results.
  • 3+ years of experience managing products across the ecommerce funnel, such as discovery, browse, and purchase.
  • 3+ years of experience working in agile product organizations.
  • 1+ year(s) of experience managing ecommerce platforms at scale.
  • 1+ year(s) of experience leading Product Managers or other product leaders.
  • 1+ year(s) of experience with experimentation and A/B testing.
  • 1+ year(s) of experience with personalization and recommendation technologies.
  • 6 months + experience leveraging AI-powered product capabilities.


Even better, you may have...

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience working on ecommerce for automotive accessories or aftermarket components.
  • Deep understanding of ecommerce technologies, market trends, and customer behavior.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and leadership skills.
  • A demonstrated ability to drive innovation and deliver measurable results.

  • Experience with marketplace or omnichannel commerce.

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? title: Retail Customer Experience Associate, Cool Springs - Full Time

Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. As a Customer Experience Colleague, you will create exceptional, personalized shopping experiences for our customers. With a deep understanding of fashion, fit, and function, you will make tailored product recommendations and leverage digital tools to enhance the customer journey. In addition to service and selling, you’ll support operational excellence through floor readiness, event execution, merchandise setup, and opening/closing procedures.

A positive, can-do attitude, strong communication skills, and a passion for delivering high-caliber service will be key to your success in this role.

How Our Selling Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They wear their name badge with pride, greet teammates with a warm hello, and help ensure the sales floor is clean, organized, and prepared for customers. Before getting started, they review their sales goals, learn about new arrivals and top-selling items, and stay up to date on current trends and promotions - so they’re fully informed and ready to engage, educate, and sell with confidence.
  • On the floor, they focus on the customer - offering a warm welcome, making eye contact, and creating friendly, personal conversations to create customer relationships to bring the customers back.
  • Throughout the day, they maintain a shoppable space by recovering the floor and fitting rooms, updating signs and pricing, and supporting any needed merchandise moves.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem
  • At least 2 years of selling or customer experience preferred

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: chargé(e) de projet / Project Manager

title: Senior databricks specialist/data architect | marc ellis | doha, qatar
description:

In this critical enterprise data leadership role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-scale data platforms using Microsoft Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, and Delta Lake architectures. The ideal candidate will bring 8+ years of experience in data engineering and architecture, at least 4+ years of strong hands-on Azure Databricks expertise, and deep technical familiarity with Unity Catalog and Medallion Architecture. If you possess a distinguished background in big data platform engineering and multi-system integration, we invite you to apply.

Detailed Job Description

As a Senior Databricks Specialist / Data Architect at Marc Ellis in Doha, Qatar, you will serve as the principal technical authority responsible for architecting, governing, and scaling the organization’s enterprise data platform and its integration with Dynamics 365 CRM and other core enterprise systems. Your daily responsibilities will encompass designing robust data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, implementing Delta Lake storage layers, configuring Unity Catalog governance and access controls, and driving performance tuning and cost optimization on Azure Databricks. You will troubleshoot complex production data issues and collaborate with engineering teams to automate CI/CD deployments via Azure Dev Ops.

Key Responsibilities Design, implement, architect, and optimize enterprise-scale data platforms using Microsoft Azure Databricks. Build and scale high-performance data pipelines and processing frameworks using Apache Spark and Py Spark. Architect and manage Delta Lake storage layers and implement Databricks Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold). Implement enterprise data governance, access control, and data lineage tracking using Unity Catalog. Integrate Azure Databricks seamlessly with APIs, enterprise applications, Dynamics 365 CRM, and auxiliary data sources. Design and maintain robust cloud data infrastructure using Azure Data Factory and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2. Apply advanced data modeling, dimensional modeling, and data quality standards across large enterprise datasets. Drive continuous performance optimization, cost reduction, and query tuning on Databricks clusters. Build automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, version control workflows, and infrastructure as code using Azure Dev Ops and Git. Troubleshoot complex production data issues, memory bottlenecks, and pipeline failures rapidly. Required Qualifications & Skills Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum of 8+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, or big data systems. Minimum of 4+ years of strong hands-on professional experience with Microsoft Azure Databricks. Deep technical proficiency in Apache Spark, Py Spark, and Delta Lake data formats. Strong experience designing enterprise data platforms, data pipelines, and Databricks Medallion Architectures. Advanced practical knowledge of Unity Catalog, data governance, security policies, and access controls. Strong SQL skills and proven capability in processing large-volume enterprise datasets. Solid background with Azure data services including Azure Data Factory and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2. Experience with CI/CD deployment automation, Git, and Azure Dev Ops pipelines. Immediate availability for 12-month contract mobilization in Doha. title: Senior Full Stack Developer at Metazyber Technologies
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer

Experience Level: 5 to 8 Years

Employment Type: Full-time

We are seeking an experienced and versatile Senior Full Stack Developer with 5 to 8 years of hands on software development experience to design, build, and maintain high-performance enterprise applications. In this role, you will lead end to end web application development-building scalable RESTful microservices and APIs using .NET Core / C#, creating data architectures using SQL Server, and engineering modern UI interfaces with Angular and React.

Key Responsibilities
  • Frontend Architecture & Development: Design and implement responsive, accessible, and high-performing client-side application interfaces using Angular and React. Architect modular, reusable UI components and integrate state management libraries (e.g., Redux, NgRx, or Context API). Ensure seamless performance across cross-browser platforms and devices.
  • Backend Development & Integration: Build scalable, secure, and maintainable web applications, microservices, and RESTful APIs using .NET Core / .NET 6+ and C#. Implement authentication, authorization, and security protocols (OAuth2, JWT, IdentityServer). Integrate third party systems, enterprise services, and asynchronous message queues.
  • Database & Data Layer Engineering: Write complex SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and views in Microsoft SQL Server (or PostgreSQL/MySQL). Design database schemas and optimize query performance, indexing, and data models. Implement ORM frameworks (Entity Framework Core / Dapper) for reliable data retrieval and mapping.
  • Quality Assurance & DevOps: Write unit, integration, and end to end tests across the full stack (e.g., xUnit, Jest, Jasmine, Cypress). Participate in CI/CD pipeline configuration and deployment processes (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins). Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application throughput across all application layers.
  • Agile Collaboration & Mentorship: Collaborate with cross functional teams including Product Managers, UX Designers, and QA Engineers in an Agile/Scrum environment. Participate in technical code reviews, technical architecture planning, and mentor junior developers.
Required Technical Skills & Qualifications
  • Experience: 5 to 8 years of continuous full-stack web development experience in an enterprise setting.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Applications Validation & Verification (AVV) Engineer
description:
Change the world. Love your job.

Texas Instruments is looking for a new Applications Validation & Verification (AVV) Engineer to join our Advanced Technology Integration (ATI) group. The AVV takes a top-down wholistic approach to validating our next gen Automotive and Industrial SoC designs. In this role, you will design, create, and execute tests that validate many of the system's features at once, mimicking end-user applications. You will analyze not only functionality but also performance(throughput, latency, MIPS, etc.) and power(Operational, Idle, Low-power modes) as well as work on both pre-silicon emulation platforms and real silicon. You will be working purely in baremetal(C with some assembly); no operating system, no kernel.


Come join us in cutting edge development of our next-generation System-on-Chip products!

Job Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate SoC designs with Systems Experts to determine key targets for V&V.
  • Design and document test plans for SoCs.
  • Create tests using C (with some assembly), with support from scripting languages.
  • Debug tests and designs on pre-silicon emulation platforms.
  • Repeat test execution and debugging on real silicon.
  • Work cross-functionally with design team and other validation teams to ensure all tests pass.
  • Document results, issues encountered, flows used, tools created, etc.
  • Support cross-functional teams and FAEs fielding customer questions.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelors in Electrical Engineering, ECE, Computer Engineering or related degree
  • 5 years engineering experience working with silicon design and/or validation
  • Experience with digital/embedded design on emulation/FPGA platforms/RTL Sim

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proficient in C/C++ programming
  • Advanced knowledge of computer architectures (at least those related to DDR interfaces and associated system interconnects)
  • Advanced knowledge of digital logic
  • Intermediate knowledge of hardware design languages
  • Experience with embedded systems debugging
  • Experience debugging with digital waveforms
  • Advanced level of technical competence and understanding
  • Advanced level of imaginative & process-based problem-solving skills
  • Multi-disciplinary; able to work and contribute in multiple technical domains
  • Self-learner; able to study from documentation and code
  • Taskmaster; able to self-start and still tackle complex tasks
  • Experience working with DDR(4/5/LP4/LP5) interfaces in both pre- and post-silicon.
  • Experience with cacheing and coherency validation
  • Experience with pre-silicon power measurement
  • Proficient in assembly programming
  • Experience with DSPs, especially C6x/C7x
  • Experience with TI SoCs
  • Proficient in automation/scripting using regular expressions

title: Project Manager
description:
ABM Industries is seeking a Project Manager to support the Electrical Power Services team. This position is responsible for the planning, execution, financial performance, and successful completion of electrical testing, commissioning, maintenance, engineering, and power systems projects. The Project Manager serves as the primary point of contact for customers and is responsible for managing project scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality, and customer satisfaction. This role collaborates with operations leadership, project coordinators, field supervisors, testing personnel, commissioning personnel, subcontractors, and customers to ensure projects are executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with company and customer requirements.

Essential Functions

  • Manage the full lifecycle of electrical testing, commissioning, maintenance, and engineering services projects from initiation through closeout.

  • Develop project execution plans, schedules, staffing strategies, and resource requirements.

  • Monitor project budgets, labor utilization, schedules, and overall project performance.

  • Ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contractual requirements.

  • Facilitate project kickoff meetings and establish project objectives and expectations with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Review and approve subcontractor invoices and project-related expenditures.

  • Promote compliance with OSHA regulations, NFPA 70E requirements, customer safety standards, and company policies.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to safety, quality, customer satisfaction, and operational performance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Construction Management, Business Management, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in electrical testing, commissioning, field service, utility operations, industrial maintenance, power systems, engineering services, or related industries.

  • Experience managing customer-facing projects and technical field service operations.

  • Strong understanding of electrical power systems, testing services, commissioning activities, and field operations.

  • Demonstrated leadership, organizational, and project management skills.

  • Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and project financial oversight.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project management software.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record.

  • Ability to travel as required to support customer and project needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7 or more years of experience in electrical testing, commissioning, engineering services, utility operations, or related power systems industries.

  • Experience supporting NETA testing projects, commissioning projects, protection and controls projects, or utility services.

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project management training.

  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and field service teams.

  • Familiarity with:

    • NETA standards

    • NFPA 70E

    • OSHA regulations

    • Utility and industrial power systems

    • Electrical safety practices

  • Previous supervisory or leadership experience.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong project planning, organizational, and time management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.

  • Strong customer relationship management and communication skills.

  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate project resources.

  • Strong financial and business management capabilities.

  • Ability to analyze project performance and implement corrective actions when necessary.

  • Commitment to safety, quality, customer service, and operational excellence.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to travel as required to support customer sites, project locations, outage activities, and business operations.

  • Ability to work in electrical rooms, substations, industrial facilities, construction sites, outdoor environments, and mission-critical facilities.

  • Ability to stand, walk, climb ladders, bend, kneel, crouch, and navigate active job sites and industrial environments.

  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull project materials, tools, or equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.

  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including arc-flash and electrical safety equipment, when visiting project sites.

  • Ability to work extended hours, weekends, holidays, and outage schedules as required to support project execution and customer requirements.

Career Progression

The Project Manager role serves as a key leadership position within Electrical Power Services and may progress to Senior Project Manager, Operations Manager, Regional Operations Manager, Technical Manager, Director of Operations, or other leadership roles based on demonstrated performance, experience, and business needs.

title: Product Development Engineer-Pre-Program Strategy and Implementation
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.


Product Development uses design thinking & user experience methods to deliver breakthrough products and services that delight our customers. We bring innovative, exciting, and sustainable ideas to life. We have opportunities around the world for you to contribute to advancements in autonomy, electrification, smart mobility technologies, and more!

In this position...
Pre-Program Strategy and Implementation Engineer will lead and manage new powertrain projects including ICE Transmissions, Power Split Transmissions, and Power Units. You will develop the new strategies when we bring on a full-service supplier vs internally made products. This will be done in the lens of maintaining quality, meeting vehicle requirements, as well as a large focus on minimizing our complexity through the company. You will set timelines, budget and coordinate with cross-functional teams in planning, manufacturing, supply chain, and product development to determine the efficiencies of an in-house vs. externally purchased unit. Will own the system's lifecycle from concept through release, ensuring seamless integration and adherence to vehicle targets.

The automotive industry is quickly moving towards a greater number of new powertrains to meet customer and market demands, many of which are new BEV and Hybrid programs. With this shift, there is an expanding need for development of new and unique powertrain architectures. Your work will span from the product concepts to full scale production, with an emphasis on quality, cost, weight, and functional performance.

What you'll do...

  • Launch new powertrain architectures through the unit approval process, garnering investment approvals to lead next generation powertrains into our vehicles.
  • Develop the new strategies moving forward on complexity vs carryover content.
  • Develop the new strategies of moving forward with an internally built unit vs utilizing a full-service supplier to meet program requirements but also minimize complexity.
  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance program execution, quality and speed.
  • Upfront manufacturing studies of make/buy business cases.
  • Direct involvement with our manufacturing plants to deliver content that matches manufacturing footprint allocations.
  • Establishment of cost targets that align with program targets and content that aligns with those targets
  • Work with purchasing and suppliers to deliver high-quality component designs with best cost, weight, and function.
  • Navigate through GPDS program gateways and deliverables including design, sourcing, prototype.
  • Project management interfacing with cross functional teams.
  • Provide estimates and review actuals for cost and timing of externally purchased vs. internally built units.
  • Maintain a list of deliverables for each milestone of the new products.
  • Support engineering change control activity and global coordination.
  • Support program deliverable assessments, monitor and track issues to closure, engage with plant floor activity from start to finish.
  • Support updates and publishing of various program review decks.
  • Update indicated cost tracking documents and program checkbooks.
  • Technology & Innovation: Drive development of advanced propulsion solutions, stay updated on trends, and contribute to technology roadmaps.

You'll have...

BS in Mechanical, Industrial, or Electrical Engineering or a related field.
3+ years of transmission or power unit development experience.

Even better, you may have...
Masters in product development or other Engineering degree.
2+ years of program management experience.
Experience developing cost studies and cost comparisons between multiple powertrain designs.
Proven delivery of balanced Quality/Cost/Weight/Function/Timing attributes for components or subsystems.
Formal Systems Engineering knowledge to solve complex problems.
Versed in BOM structure development.
Experience working with full-service suppliers.
Experience working with powertrain manufacturing on early development.
Experience working with powertrain planning.
Clear communication skills and highly motivated to exceed expectations in a constantly changing product landscape.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Tools.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
• Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
• Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
• Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
• Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
• Tuition assistance
• Established and active employee resource groups
• Paid time off for individual and team community service
• A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
• Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

This position is a salary grade 5 and ranges from $65,100-$109,300.

This position is a salary grade 6 and ranges from $74,300-$124,500.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Software Engineer, Production Inference (Distributed Inference)
description:
About Thinking Machines

The mission of Thinking Machines is to build AI that extends human will and judgment. We are training frontier models with Inkling, developing Tinker to let people make models their own, and crafting interfaces that broaden human-AI communication. We believe the future worth building is human, and we're hiring people who want to build it.

About the Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer to build and scale the distributed production inference systems that serve Inkling, Inkling-Small, and Tinker in production. You'll own the systems that turn trained models into fast, reliable, cost-efficient services — from request routing and batching to multi-node serving and GPU utilization at scale.

This is a systems-heavy, production-first role. You'll work closely with research and infrastructure teams to translate rapidly evolving model architectures into serving systems that meet real-world latency, throughput, and reliability requirements, and you'll be on the front line when production inference systems need to scale, recover, or improve.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and operate distributed infrastructure for large-scale model serving, including request routing, load balancing, batching, and multi-node coordination

  • Optimize inference latency and throughput in production, including work on KV cache management, continuous batching, speculative decoding, and quantization

  • Build and maintain high-concurrency serving systems with strong uptime, low tail latency, and deep observability

  • Benchmark, tune, and extend inference engines to support new model architectures as they move from research into production

  • Partner with research and infrastructure teams to translate emerging model designs into production-ready serving systems

  • Build tooling for tracing, debugging, and resolving issues across the serving stack, from orchestration down to GPU kernels

  • Participate in on-call rotation to support production inference systems

Skills & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience building and operating distributed systems in production

  • Strong systems programming skills in Python, C++, Rust, or similar languages

  • Experience with production infrastructure at scale: reliability, observability, and performance under real-world load

  • Solid understanding of networking, concurrency, and distributed systems fundamentals

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with LLM inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

  • Familiarity with GPU programming (CUDA) or low-level performance optimization

  • Experience with model parallelism, tensor/pipeline parallelism, or other distributed inference techniques

  • Track record of operating large-scale production systems with strict latency and uptime requirements

  • Experience with Kubernetes or similar orchestration systems for GPU workloads

  • Contributions to open-source ML systems or inference infrastructure projects

Logistics

  • Location: This role is based in San Francisco, CA.

  • Compensation: Depending on background, skills and experience, the expected annual salary range for this position is $350,000 - $500,000 USD (placeholder — verify against current internal bands before publishing).

  • Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas. While we can't guarantee success for every candidate or role, if you're the right fit, we're committed to working through the visa process together.

  • Benefits: Thinking Machines offers generous health, dental, and vision benefits, unlimited PTO, paid parental leave, and relocation support as needed.

title: Fritidspædagog? Så har du nu en sjælden mulighed - Randers Kommune
description:
I en verden, hvor SFO’er er mainstream, har du nu muligheden for at arbejde i et rigtigt fritidshjem.

Nu er der en sjælden mulighed for at arbejde i et rigtigt fritidshjem, hvor udvikling, relationer og fritidspædagogik er bærende – i samarbejde med hele vores hus og Nørrevangsskolen, der er vores tætte samarbejdspartner. Man er ansat i KFUM, men der er tradition for, at man som pædagog i KFUM’s fritidshjem har ca. halvdelen af sine timer på Nørrevangsskolen som skolepædagog – for nuværende er det på 0. årgang.

Vi er en selvejende institution, som har vuggestue, børnehave, fritidshjem og ungdomsklub - så vi har børn og unge i alderen 0-18 år. Vi skaber den røde tråd gennem barnets liv ved at have fokus på sammenhænge med respekt for det enkelte barns og families følelser, normer og kultur. Stillingen er til vores fritidshjem, men du skal være indstillet på, at vi tænker huset som en helhed med sammenhæng ud fra børnenes behov.

I dagligdagen vægter vi relationer, trivsel og et ”roligt nervesystem” i et fællesskab, hvor der er plads til alle og hvor alles bidrag bliver værdsat - det gælder for børn og familier, men også kollegialt.

Vores primære mål er at skabe positive spor i barnets/familiens liv - og det gælder gennem hele barnets liv i KFUM’s Institutioner.

Det er meget essentielt for os, at du i dit børne-, menneske- og dannelsessyn arbejder ud fra sætningen: “Relation før krav”.

Endvidere forventer vi, at du

  • indstillet på, at vi har høje forventninger til dine menneskelige egenskaber, din fagfaglighed og dine evner til refleksion - herunder selvrefleksion.
  • er psykisk robust, omstillingsvillig, fleksibel, handlingsorienteret - og har humor og tør træde på tynd is.
  • ser udfordringer i stedet for problemer.
  • er nærværende, engageret og motiverende i dit samvær med børnene.
  • kan etablere og understøtte alsidige lege- og læringsmiljøer i relation til børnegruppens behov og interesser med udgangspunkt i det fælles pædagogiske grundlag.
  • er forpligtende, relationel stærk og kompetent. Det gælder både i det relationelle arbejde mellem dig og børnene, børnene i fællesskabet og i samarbejde med forældrene.
  • kan indgå i et forpligtende socialt samarbejde med kollegaer og ledelse - hvor trivsel og ansvar påhviler den enkelte sammen med fællesskabet.
  • er uddannet pædagog.

KFUM’s Institutioner er en selvejende institution, hvilket giver os en lidt bredere mulighed for fleksibilitet - og som gør os lidt speciel…på den fede måde. Vuggestuen er normeret til 14 børn, børnehaven til 40 børn og i fritidshjemmet er der 30 børn pt.

Vi ser barn og familie som sammenhængende og vi arbejder med helheden som forudsætning for at skabe den rette udvikling. Børnene i fritidshjemmet går alle i skole på Nørrevangsskolen, der ligger lige i nærheden. Vi har et tæt samarbejde med de øvrige fritidshjem og daginstitutioner i Nordbyen og med Nørrevangsskolen - så det, at leve og bo i Nordbyen også opleves som en sammenhæng. I fritidshjemmet vægter vi naturligvis, at børnene har deres frie tid og at deres tid hos os komplementerer deres tid i skolen - og deres læring og udvikling begge steder hænger sammen. Personalet i vuggestuen, børnehaven og fritidshjemmet arbejder tæt sammen og oplever sig som en helhed med det samme mål for børnene og løsningen af kerneopgaven. I det tætte samarbejde indgår også ungdomsklubben, der har åbent torsdag, fredag, lørdag og søndag og er et tilbud til unge mellem 10 og 18 år. Personalet her er timelønsansatte og har jobbet i ungdomsklubben som deres sekundære job. Samarbejdet mellem fritidshjemmet og ungdomsklubben ønskes yderligere styrket således, at børnene fra fritidshjemmet oplever større sammenhæng når de bliver ”gamle nok” til at starte i ungdomsklubben.

Vi er beliggende på Glarbjergvej i Nordbyen, Randers. Selvom vi er placeret i boligområde med etagebyggeri har vi store og gode grønne områder med mange kvadratmeter legeplads, boldbaner, gemmesteder - og så har vi swimmingpool. Vi har også en minibus så børnene i mindre grupper kan komme på udflugt. Nordbyen er kendetegnet ved mangfoldighed på alle niveauer. Det ser vi som en gave og stiller krav til os som fagpersoner - og til vores tilgang til tingene som mennesker.

Vi opfordrer til, at hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, søger uanset hvilken erhvervserfaring du har som pædagog da vores holdning er, at du kan lære de praktiske ting, men de menneskelige egenskaber og værdier kan ikke tillæres - dem besidder man og de er for os de vigtigste.

Som pædagog i KFUM’s Institutioner vil du komme til at arbejde i et uhøjtideligt miljø, hvor faglighed og humor går hånd i hånd. Alle medarbejdere arbejder efter helårsnorm således at mødeplanen som hovedregel er kendt for et år ad gangen og møder, arrangementer m.m. er planlagt for et år ad gangen. Der er afsat tid til individuel ikke-skemalagt forberedelse for alle medarbejdere. Herved opnås en praksis, hvor den skemalagte tid med børnene også rent faktisk er TID MED BØRNENE, men at der også er tid til de øvrige opgaver.

Vil du høre mere om stillingen

– eller aflægge os et besøg – kan du kontakte souschef Sandra Gyde Rødbro på telefon 61 13 77 73 eller institutionsleder Claus Krogsholt på telefon 22 98 42 96.

Frist

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning vedlagt relevant dokumentation såsom uddannelsesbevis og anbefalinger via vores rekrutteringssystem - ansøgningsfristen er søndag den 25. oktober 2026 kl. 23.59.

Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Vi forbeholder os muligheden for løbende ansættelsessamtaler – ellers forventes de afholdt onsdag den 28. oktober 2026 om eftermiddagen/aftenen.

Stillingen er en fastansættelse på 37 timer ugentligt.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

Der indhentes børne- og straffeattest.

Tak for din interesse - hvis du bliver den heldige forventer vi, at du starter den 1. december 2026.

title: Regional Asset Protection Leader (NY Metro area)
description:
About us

KnitWell Group, a specialty retail operating company, comprises some of the most iconic brands in America – Ann Taylor, Chico's, Haven Well Within, Lane Bryant, LOFT, Soma, Talbots, White House Black Market. Individually, our brands are unique and strong. Together, we are powerful.Our common thread is our commitment to create exceptional products, provide memorable experiences, and achieve superior results. Our associates are innovators who thrive through collaboration and are dedicated to excellence. At the heart of it all are the customers we serve. We are dedicated to creating fashion that not only looks good but also makes our customers feel good.

Regional Asset Protection Leader (RAPL) – NY Metro

About the role

The Regional Asset Protection Leader (RAPL) is primarily responsible for preventing financial loss caused by theft and fraud and for supporting safe store environments and operational excellence within the assigned region of NY Metro, New England and northern Mid-Atlantic (approximately 250 multi-brand stores). Regional Asset Protection Leaders are responsible for a multi-state region and are relationship based. They use data to strategically plan their time and conduct impactful store interactions.

The RAPL’s region consists of fashion specialty retail locations across multiple KnitWell Group brands (Ann Taylor, LOFT, Lane Bryant, Chico's, Soma, WHBM, Talbots & Haven Well Within). The RAPL leverages tools to minimize loss to the Company, including (but not limited to) identifying incidents of theft and fraud, reviewing business and exception reports, and partnering with field leaders to address risk while doing so with the least amount of organizational effort and expense.

The impact you can have

  • Serve as a primary contact for store teams and District Leaders during escalated in-store incidents, including critical and active incidents. Partner with stores to gather details, provide guidance, and support the KnitWell culture through strong emotional awareness.
  • Work in partnership with stores and District Leaders to share observations, provide development, and invest in teams, strategies, and goal commitments that address shrink and SKU variance performance, customer engagement, omni-channel execution, theft awareness, and other operational controllables.

  • Partner with the analytics team and Manager of Investigations to resolve losses attributed to omni-channel fraud or external theft. Actively investigate concerns related to suspicious losses to determine situational facts; conduct interviews with involved parties; resolve theft/fraud matters; and, when warranted, submit detailed written reports for each investigation in accordance with established guidelines.

  • Ability to interact and communicate with varying levels within the organizational structure
  • Ability to interact and communicate with varying levels within the organizational structure

  • Advanced investigation, interview, and interrogation skills preferred

  • 50%+ Travel Requirement (covers all KWG Brands)
  • Required to work possible nights and weekends to respond to critical incidents, time sensitive investigations and address asset protection issues.
  • Extensive ability to manage administrative functions (time, expenses, budgets, scheduling, reporting, etc.)

Benefits

  • Support for your individual development plus opportunities for career mobility within our family of brands.
  • A culture of giving back – local volunteer opportunities, annual donation and volunteer match to eligible nonprofit organizations, and philanthropic activities to support our communities.*

title: Driftschef
description:
Driftschef med ansvar for 9.000 boliger på Fyn og øerne

I BOSERA ønsker vi at løfte den faglige- og ledelsesmæssige kapacitet i den daglige drift og i kommende projekter. Derfor har vi valgt en tydeligere opdeling mellem drift og byggeri i vores nyligt fusionerede organisation, hvor vi står foran en række store bygge- og renoveringsopgaver de kommende år.

BOSERA bygger, renoverer, vedligeholder, moderniserer og udlejer almene boliger. Vores ambition er, at vi indenfor en kortere årrække har udviklet vores paradigmer og strukturer – og med udgangspunkt i vores strategi og mål om højere og mere ensartet kvalitet i vores opgaveløsninger, søger vi derfor en driftschef til nyoprettet stilling, som skal stå i spidsen for hele driftsorganisationen.

Driftschefen får det samlede overordnede ansvar for driften, og skal være med til at udvikle driften, ledelsen og samarbejdet i hele organisationen.

Driftschefen får ansvar for den daglige drift, servicefunktioner og vedligeholdelsen af vores bygningsmasse med direkte ledelsesansvar for fire driftsledere. Driftschefen skal bidrage til en god kultur, hvor vi har fokus på videndeling, tydelig ledelse og god kommunikation på tværs.

BOSERAs drift af boliger og bygninger foregår med udgangspunkt i den gældende lovgivning for almene boligorganisationer. Driftschefens vigtigste opgaver er at sikre og udvikle fælles standarder og arbejdsgange i hele driften med sikker økonomisk styring af ansvarlig drift med mange prioriteringer og stærkt fokus på effektivitet.

Chefstilling med bred kontaktflade internt og eksternt

Driftschefen får ansvar for og skal medvirke til, at BOSERAs service og samarbejde omkring beslutninger om vedligeholdelse, foregår på en positiv og konstruktiv måde, der er funderet i stærk faglighed og klare rammer for driftens medarbejdere og samarbejdet med beboerdemokratiet. Resultatet er god dialog i øjenhøjde med beboere og beboerdemokrater og beslutninger truffet på kvalificeret, lovligt og oplyst grundlag.

Driftschefen har reference til direktøren, og hos os indgår du i et tæt samarbejde med chefgruppens tre andre chefer og direktøren. Med os tænker du på tværs og bidrager med dine og driftens analyser og perspektiver, så vi leder, udvikler og driver organisationen på tværs af intern administration og drift – og sammen under BOSERAs værdier: Ordentlighed, Kvalitet, Udvikling og Fællesskab.

Driftschefen har desuden en bred kontaktflade med vores mange eksterne samarbejdspartnere, og får ansvar for at udvikle og vedligeholde professionel styring af leverandører, rammeaftaler og partnerskaber mhp. at skabe kvalitet og effektiv ressourceudnyttelse i hele driftsorganisationen.

Erfaren personaleleder til stor driftsorganisation

Du har erfaring med at lede ledere, og du er en stærk og anerkendende leder, der skaber retning og går foran. Du får dine kolleger med dig. Du er handlekraftig og beslutningsdygtig, mens du skaber overblik for dine medarbejdere og følger op. Du er nærværende og med dit fokus på service og kvalitet i ledelsen af dine medarbejderes faglige og personlige udvikling, tager du initiativ og ansvar, og du giver sparring og respons.

Du evner at arbejde med mange bolde i luften, du kan gribe dem og du kan løse komplekse opgaver. Samtidig rummer du, at mange mennesker kontakter dig og ønsker din respons. Du er samarbejdsorienteret i din løbende dialog, og er en god kommunikator både skriftligt og mundtligt. Du løser samarbejdsproblemer på en professionel og respektfuld måde. Man kommer gerne til dig.

Du har en relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund og erfaring med – og forståelse for at arbejde med økonomi og budgetter. Du inspirerer med gode IT-kompetencer og motiveres af at bidrage til udvikling af værktøjer og skabeloner i driftsorganisationen og til BOSERA generelt.

Kendskab til den almene boligsektor er en fordel men ikke et krav.

Ønsker du at vide mere

Læs den fulde jobbeskrivelse her.

Stillingen søges besat d. 1. januar 2027.

Arbejdsstedet er BOSERAs hovedkontor i Odense S. Du skal have gyldigt kørekort og kunne stille egen bil til rådighed.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår forhandles individuelt.

Samtaler gennemføres d. 11. november og d. 24. november 2026.

Kandidater der går videre til 2. runde, gennemfører analyse og test inkl. ekstra interviewsamtale d. 17. eller 18. november 2026.

» Direktør Claus Krag, BOSERA på tlf. 2130 0714 (send sms først)

BOSERA er en almen boligorganisation og repræsenterer en fusion mellem Kollegieboligselskabet og Kristiansdal pr. 1. januar 2025. Vi håndterer 9.000 boliger på Fyn og øerne. 6.264 er almene boliger. Herunder er 3.800 familieboliger, 1.903 ungdomsboliger og 400 ældreboliger.

Derudover har vi ekstern administration af 2.703 boliger.

Vi er 60 medarbejdere fordelt på Kundeservice, Økonomi, Byg og Drift.

title: Residential Therapist
description:
Responsibilities/Expectations

  • Holistic and collaborative treatment planning for the client and his/her support network. Plans shall include an analysis of the youth’s strengths and needs in addition to the factors that affected the child from remaining in a less restrictive setting. Plans shall also include behavioral objectives for the child that, when achieved, shall lead to the child's discharge. The youth’s identified caregiver(s)/supports should be actively involved in the treatment and treatment planning process.
  • Be able to provide verbally and in writing a diagnostic conceptualization of client’s symptoms and presenting issues in light of systemic, environmental, and individual factors.
  • Provide individual and at times, group therapy sessions for children, working on issues as specified in the treatment plan, typically regarding attachment, trust, safety, expression of feelings, regulation, family relationships, future planning, past trauma, and client goals.
  • Participate in family engagement and conduct family therapy to help the resident and caregiver develop a healthy attachment, prepare both parties for step-down, teach the client how to apply what is learned in residential to a home setting, and provide parent coaching to the caregiver.
  • In collaboration with the case manager, oversee the development and maintenance of a continuing relationship with parents, siblings, caregivers, fictive kin, relatives, and other supports unless clearly contraindicated by specific factors.
  • Collaboratively plan and implement designated plans, as assigned, for the child's transition to his/her next placement setting.
  • In collaboration with other treatment team members, develop strategies and plans that pertain to the client’s behavior management and problem solving abilities while incorporating motivational incentives. Ensure the finalized plans are communicated to the necessary parties verbally and in writing.
  • Oversee case management of assigned clients in the absence of the case manager (e.g., conduct staffings; attend court).
  • Write case documentation (i.e., Medicaid-compliant case notes in SDS) for each child. Weekly contact with the client and family in addition to consultations with other professionals must be documented and the service documentation benchmark met.
  • Complete DCFS/COA/Medicaid required paperwork (e.g., IM+CANS Reports, treatment plans, and other associated clinical documents (e.g., at times, Clinical Summaries, Discharge Reports). Reports will review each child's current situation including progress towards behavioral objectives and transition plan, protective factors, presenting issues, and response to treatment.
  • Complete paperwork in a timely manner.
  • Participate in program development as it relates to the integration of therapeutic principles. Actively engage in trainings/consultations surrounding the Attachment, Regulation, and Competency [ARC] framework and Sensory Motor Arousal Regulation Therapy [SMART] and carry forth such principles both in practice and in trainings. Co-lead bi-weekly trainings on the milieu with the unit supervisor pertaining to the practical application of the therapeutic principles.
  • Participate in ongoing training program at Lydia Home. Conduct trainings when assigned.
  • Attend client consultations, staffings, internal agency staffings, and at times, Child Family Team Meetings. If unable to participate in a staffing, communicate this to the Residential Clinical so a plan can be made to communicate the necessary information.
  • Attend hospital staffings if a client is psychiatrically hospitalized. Formulate and communicate plan with treatment team for when client returns from hospital to Lydia Home. Provide therapeutic support to youth while he/she is hospitalized.
  • Participate in decision making process when establishing a mentor for a client and the initial meeting. Check in during therapy sessions about the client’s reactions to his/her mentor.
  • Collaborate, at times, with school personnel to regarding the client’s emotional and behavioral functioning in the classroom.

title: AP & Disbursements Specialist
description:
We're Hiring

AP & Disbursements Specialist

Pay:

$25.00 – $28.00 per hour, DOE

Schedule

Full-Time, Monday–Friday business hours

Status:

Non-Exempt (hourly, overtime eligible)

Finance

Finance Director

ABOUT FAMILY PROMISE OF SPOKANE

Family Promise of Spokane exists to end homelessness — one family, one person, one community at a time. Through shelter, housing, and prevention programs, we help families find stability and stay housed. As we grow to serve more families, we are building a strong in-house Finance team, and this role is one of its foundational seats.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Every payment you process has a face behind it. When rent assistance reaches a landlord on time, a family keeps their home. When vendors are paid accurately, our shelters keep running. When every transaction is coded and documented correctly, we protect the grant funding that makes our work possible. As our AP & Disbursements Specialist, you'll make sure all of that happens — accurately, on time, and with care.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Review, code, and enter approved vendor invoices in QuickBooks Online, typically within 5 business days of receipt.
  • Prepare a weekly payment run of checks and ACH payments, and process checks for leadership signature.
  • Process Direct Assistance payments — rent, deposits, and utilities for families — from approved applications in our MAPS system, typically within 2 business days.
  • Match Direct Assistance transactions from approval through payment to the accounting system each week.
  • Review and code Ramp card transactions and employee reimbursements, follow up on missing receipts, and sync to QuickBooks Online.
  • Set up and maintain vendor records and W-9s, and support year-end 1099 preparation.
  • Answer vendor and staff payment questions promptly, and keep records organized and audit-ready.
  • Help design and document the processes of a growing finance department, and bring ideas for working smarter.

WHAT YOU BRING

Required

  • High school diploma or GED, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 2+ years of accounts payable, disbursements, or full-cycle bookkeeping experience in a high-volume environment.
  • Experience with QuickBooks Online or a comparable accounting system, and intermediate Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Exceptional accuracy, organization, and follow-through on deadlines.
  • Discretion with confidential financial and personal information.
  • A valid Washington State driver's license and current auto insurance, for occasional travel to off-site meetings and trainings.

Preferred

  • Associate degree or coursework in accounting, bookkeeping, or business.
  • Experience in a nonprofit, government-funded, or grant-funded organization.
  • Experience processing rental assistance or other client-benefit payments.
  • Experience with Ramp or similar expense platforms, Bill.com or similar AP tools, or QuickBooks Online certification.
  • Experience in an organization that runs on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System).

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU ARE

  • Humble — you take pride in your work without needing the spotlight, and you own and fix mistakes.
  • Adaptable and flexible — you're energized, not rattled, by new systems and processes in a growing department.
  • Teachable — you welcome feedback and review as part of doing excellent work.
  • Service-minded — you're patient and kind with program staff who aren't finance experts.
  • Mission-driven — you want your work to help families find and keep a home.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Pay: $25.00 – $27.00 per hour, depending on experience; overtime eligible.
  • Health coverage: 100% employer-paid medical (Premera), dental (Delta Dental), and vision (VSP) for eligible full-time employees.
  • Paid leave: Accrued vacation, paid holidays, and paid sick leave.
  • Employee Assistance Program: Free, confidential counseling and support for employees and household members.
  • Supplemental benefits: Optional Colonial Life coverage (employee-paid).
  • Growth: Training in our finance systems, professional development, and regular coaching through EOS quarterly conversations.

HOW WE WORK

FPS runs on EOS, the Entrepreneurial Operating System. Every role is a "seat" with clear responsibilities, a weekly Scorecard number, and quarterly priorities called Rocks. Teams meet weekly in focused Level 10 meetings to review numbers and solve issues together. If you like knowing exactly what success looks like — and being supported to reach it — you'll feel at home here.
