title: QA Analyst
description:
QA Analyst

About Fellow

Fellow is the AI meeting assistant that helps teams turn conversations into decisions and action, built from the ground up with privacy and security in mind. Fellow supports the entire meeting workflow, from pre-meeting briefs to note-taking and recording to human-level recaps, so organizations can have fewer, better, and shorter meetings. Today, Fellow is evolving beyond notetaking into an AI Chief of Staff for the whole organization.

Founded in 2017 by the team behind Fluidware (acquired by SurveyMonkey), Fellow is a Series A company backed by Craft Ventures, iNovia Capital, and Felicis Ventures. We're a remote-first company headquartered in Ottawa, and leaders in 100+ countries rely on Fellow, including teams at Shopify, HubSpot, WarnerMedia, Tucows, and Dynatrace.

Our mission is simple: make work better for everyone. Because when meetings run better, work feels better.

Learn more at fellow.ai

The Role

Quality at Fellow covers the full meeting workflow: web, desktop, and mobile, across agendas, notes, recording, AI recaps, and the workflows customers rely on every day. As we grow, we need a QA Analyst who can protect that experience from planning through release and into production.

You will design and run test plans, explore beyond the written cases, and help the team decide when something is ready to ship. You will sit with Product, Design, and Engineering early enough to influence scope, catch gaps, and bring the customer perspective into the work.

We use tools like Cursor and Claude throughout how we plan, test, investigate, and release. We are looking for someone who already works this way: using AI with strong judgment, checking what it produces, and finding better ways to test without lowering the bar. The role stays centered on manual QA and holistic testing.

What You Will Do

  • Join projects from inception through deployment, contributing feedback on scope, functionality, design, risk, and testability.

  • Create and maintain detailed test plans for Web, Desktop, and Mobile, covering critical workflows, integrations, and edge cases.

  • Perform thoughtful exploratory testing beyond documented cases to reflect how customers actually use the product.

  • Own and maintain automated end-to-end regression tests as the product evolves.

  • Regularly review regression coverage, add tests for new risks and escaped defects, update outdated scenarios, and remove tests that no longer provide value.

  • Investigate automated test failures, distinguish product defects from test instability, and address flaky tests and false positives promptly.

  • Monitor scheduled regression and smoke suites, communicate failures clearly, and ensure the results remain trustworthy enough to support release decisions.

  • Collaborate with Engineering to improve testability and determine which scenarios should be automated, tested manually, or covered at another level.

  • Confirm deployment readiness by verifying tickets, running targeted manual and automated tests, assessing outstanding risk, and providing release approval.

  • Perform post-deployment checks of critical functionality and help investigate customer-reported issues.

  • Use AI agents to draft and refine test plans, identify edge cases, maintain automated tests, investigate failures, and improve release workflows—while independently validating their output.

  • Share knowledge and help improve the team’s QA practices, tooling, and AI-native workflows.

What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of manual QA experience with web, desktop, and/or mobile applications.

  • Experience creating, executing, debugging, and maintaining automated end-to-end regression tests.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, including the ability to notice subtle inconsistencies and assess their potential customer impact.

  • Strong prioritization and time-management skills; able to balance multiple projects, focus on the highest-risk areas, and make sound testing decisions under time constraints.

  • A positive, collaborative attitude and a genuine willingness to help teammates succeed.

  • Patience and sound judgment when requirements are unclear, incomplete, or changing.

  • Excitement about startup culture and comfort working in an environment where priorities move quickly, responsibilities evolve, and not every problem has a predefined process.

  • The confidence to raise concerns, ask clarifying questions, and advocate for quality while remaining pragmatic about delivery.

  • Hands-on use of AI tools such as Cursor, Claude, or similar in real QA work, with the judgment to verify their output.

  • Familiarity with browser developer tools, including the element inspector, console, and network inspector.

  • The ability to distinguish between a defect, UX feedback, and a feature request.

  • Strong knowledge of QA workflows, ticket-management tools such as Linear, and deployment activities.

  • Availability for occasional late deployments when needed.

Nice to Have

  • A track record of improving how a QA team tests with AI: prompts, agent workflows, investigation checklists, or release checks that made the team faster while keeping releases trustworthy.

  • Experience testing AI product behavior, including cases where output quality, privacy, or trust matters as much as whether a button works.

  • Experience in a high-growth product company or startup.

What We Are Not Looking For

  • A QA Engineer focused only on automation. Automation experience matters here, but the center of the role is manual QA and holistic testing.

  • A checkbox tester. We want someone who anticipates how people will actually use the product, models messy workflows, and gives feedback the team can act on.

  • Someone who treats AI output as a finished test result. We want judgment: you use the tools, and you still own the conclusion.

How We Work

We move quickly, share work early, and help one another get unstuck. Priorities and requirements can evolve as we learn, so patience with ambiguity is important. We expect people to ask good questions, identify what matters most, and move work forward without waiting for every detail to be perfectly defined.

Quality is a shared responsibility. Successful QA Analysts at Fellow are attentive, pragmatic, and collaborative. They bring positive energy to difficult situations, communicate risks without creating unnecessary friction, and help the team find solutions.

Fellow is a startup with ambitious goals and a culture of experimentation. This environment suits people who are excited to keep learning, adapt their approach, take ownership, and roll up their sleeves when something needs to get done.

What We Offer

At Fellow, we invest in the people who make our mission possible:

  • Fair, competitive compensation — we benchmark against the market and pay fairly for every role.

  • Health and dental coverage, including prescription drugs and life insurance.

  • Parental leave — 12 weeks of paid leave at 80% of salary for any parent welcoming a child into their family.

  • Time to recharge — three weeks of vacation, paid sick leave, and a paid company-wide break at the end of the year.

  • Remote-first flexibility — work remotely within Canada.

  • Room to grow — learning budgets, lunch-and-learns, and the freedom to own your work end to end.

description:

Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use.
  • Familiarity with AI engineering principles and agentic system design, including the ability to architect secure, scalable, and governed AI agents and workflows that maximize the responsible use of AI across the end-to-end Data journey.

title: Staff AI Engineering - Enterprise Architecture
description:
At American Express, AI is reshaping the future of commerce and redefining the experiences our commercial customers and card members expect. Within Amex Technology, we are building platforms, products, and governance that enable agentic AI systems to operate responsibly and at scale across the enterprise.

Our focus is on agentic AI development: designing intelligent, adaptive systems that can plan, reason, and act across complex workflows with appropriate levels of autonomy. These systems power autonomous workflows, decision support, and customer-facing experiences—while meeting the high standards for security, explainability, reliability, and compliance required in financial services.

We partner closely with product, design, and business teams to deliver agentic capabilities that reduce operational friction, improve decision-making, and transform how customers interact, transact, and grow.

The Role

As a Staff Software Engineer – Agentic AI, you will operate as a senior individual contributor within Amex Technology, helping define how agentic AI systems are designed, built, and operated across the company.

You will work at the intersection of agentic system architecture and hands-on execution: designing core frameworks, writing production code, reviewing critical designs, and guiding teams through complex technical decisions. This role does not include people management; your impact comes from technical leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to turn ambiguity into reliable, scalable agentic systems.

You will work closely with Product and UX partners to shape a shared vision for agentic AI experiences. While product teams own prioritization, Staff engineers are expected to actively influence what gets built and how agentic systems come together across teams.

We are primarily looking for senior individual contributors; however, as the team grows, you will take on increasing responsibility for technical leadership and people development within the agentic AI space. Mentoring, developing and managing direct reports may be in scope for some of our opportunities.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive technical direction for agentic AI initiatives, influencing architecture patterns, autonomy boundaries, and system design.
  • Design, build, and operate production-grade agentic AI systems used across multiple products.
  • Own and evolve shared agentic AI capabilities, including:
    • Agent frameworks and orchestration layers
    • Planning, tool use, and memory strategies
    • Retrieval and grounding (RAG) pipelines
    • LLM infrastructure, inference, and model gateways
    • Evaluation, observability, and safety tooling for autonomous systems
    • Lead technical design reviews and help teams navigate tradeoffs involving autonomy, safety, reliability, scalability, and cost.
    • Partner across teams to deliver complex, cross-cutting agentic AI initiatives from concept to production.
    • Evaluate emerging models, techniques, and agentic patterns and translate them into practical, enterprise-ready improvements.
    • Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar for agentic AI development through example and influence.

      Core engineering stack
    • Languages: Python, Go, TypeScript
    • APIs and RPC: REST, gRPC (and in some areas tRPC)
    • Cloud and infrastructure: AWS and/or GCP, Kubernetes

    • Distributed systems: event-driven architectures, including Kafka

      Agentic AI and ML

    • Integration of commercial and open-source LLMs into agentic workflows
    • Agent and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or CrewAI, with strong judgment about when to use frameworks versus building lighter-weight primitives
    • Model-level work using PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (embeddings, fine-tuning, inference tooling), with some exposure to TensorFlow
    • Strong schema, validation, and state management practices using tools such as Pydantic (Python) and Zod (TypeScript)
    • Across all systems, we emphasize evaluation, observability, safety, and reliability, reflecting the responsibility of deploying autonomous AI in a regulated, customer-facing environment.
  • +10 years of software engineering expereince, including deep, hands-on experience delivering agentic or LLM-powered systems to production
  • Proven ownership of complex, cross-cutting agentic systems spanning multiple teams or products. +10 years of software engineering expereince, including deep, hands-on experience delivering agentic or LLM-powered systems to production
  • Strong engineering fundamentals across backend systems, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Deep experience across the agentic AI stack, including planning, tool use, memory, and evaluation.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development workflows.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces and translating them into shipped, reliable autonomous systems.
  • Ability to influence technical direction and align teams without formal authority.
  • Experience in worflow engines, async processing, queues, and streaming systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building agentic systems in fintech or other regulated industries.
  • Experience as a founding engineer or early technical leader in AI-driven products.
  • Demonstrated success delivering technically complex autonomous systems that customers actively rely on.
  • Meaningful contributions to open-source AI or agentic frameworks.
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning, model optimization and inference pipelines is a plus.

title: Associate Director, SAP Center of Excellence
description:

Allogene Therapeutics, with headquarters in South San Francisco, is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of allogeneic chimeric antigen receptor T cell (AlloCAR T) products for cancer and autoimmune disease. Led by a management team with significant experience in cell therapy, Allogene is developing a pipeline of “off-the-shelf” CAR T cell product candidates with the goal of delivering readily available cell therapy on-demand, more reliably, and at greater scale to more patients.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly motivated individual to join us as an Associate Director, SAP Center of Excellence, serving as the SAP Business Owner for Allogene's SAP ERP platform. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with a proven record of sustaining and scaling enterprise systems in a regulated, cross-functional environment. The position will be located at Allogene headquarters in South San Francisco, CA.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Own the SAP Center of Excellence and drive the SAP roadmap and strategy, balancing sustainment of current operations with capabilities required for future commercial readiness.
  • Serve as SAP Business Owner per SOP, accountable for the validated state of the SAP system, including approval of service provider and shared account exceptions, incident response determination, user training, user security request approval and business continuity decisions.
  • Partner with IT (System Owner) and Quality to maintain SAP compliance with GxP, SOX, and Allogene computerized system procedures, including change controland user access management.
  • Develop and present business cases, project plans, and governance materials for new SAP capabilities and expansions; facilitate appropriate governance committees.
  • Define and maintain end-to-end SAP process ownership across plan, source, make, and deliver in partnership with finance and procurement; oversee staff accountable for master data management.
  • Lead the super user network and change management strategy for long-term sustainment and continuous improvement of core business processes.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing, regression testing, and release assessments with functional groups and the Core Team to ensure successful delivery.
  • Monitor SAP software updates and releases, assess potential GxP impact, and drive follow-on actions such as specification updates and testing.
  • Develop long-term planning tools and methodologies, including enhanced forecasting and advanced supply chain methods.
  • Other duties as assigned

Position Requirements & Experience:

  • BS required; degree in business management/science/engineering a plus. Master's degree (MBA) a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in an ERP, operations or supply chain role in biotech/pharma.
  • Proven experience serving as a Business Owner or Business Process Owner for a live SAP (or comparable ERP) system in a GxP/validated environment — including change control, user access, incident management, and business continuity.
  • Experience building or scaling an SAP/ERP Center of Excellence, including super user networks and governance models.
  • Strong knowledge of GMP, SOX, and computerized system lifecycle requirements (validation, change control, periodic review).
  • Proven change leadership and project management skills; experience developing and mentoring staff.
  • Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with broad stakeholders (IT, Finance, Manufacturing, Logistics, Quality, Supply Chain) across scientific/technical/business disciplines.
  • Ability to objectively evaluate options/trade-offs and develop executive management-level recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence all levels of staff, including executives.

We offer a chance to work with talented people in a collaborative environment and provide a top-notch compensation and benefits package, which includes an annual performance bonus, equity, health insurance, generous time off (including 2 annual holiday company-wide shutdowns) and much more. title: Civil Rodman
description:
SUMMARY Journeyman - Typically 3 years and above documented field experience in chosen craft discipline with ability to read and interpret instructions and document, plan and perform work activities independently.

RESPONSIBILITES

The Lifecycle Management team (LCM) sits within Global Procurement under Corporate Planning & Management (CPM).

The Analyst role is based in Bengaluru and sits within TPRM’s Lifecycle Management Team capability, which acts as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders helping them understand and deliver on the firm’s third party risk framework.

OUR IMPACT

The Lifecycle Management team plays a critical role in protecting the firm while enabling business activity. We ensure vendor usage is appropriately authorized, accurately recorded, and used in accordance with contractual terms, regulatory requirements, and firm policies. By maintaining disciplined controls, scalable processes, and robust documentation, LCM supports audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and financial transparency.

At the same time, LCM is a key contributor to the firm’s overall client and supplier experience. Through timely issue resolution, proactive communication, and ongoing process improvements, the team helps internal stakeholders navigate systems and workflows efficiently and confidently.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) policies, standards, and systems, including vendor onboarding, offboarding, and oversight requirements.

  2. Address stakeholder inquiries promptly and accurately, providing clear guidance on vendor workflows and program requirements.

  4. Build strong relationships firmwide by serving as a key advisor to internal stakeholders helping divisions understand and navigate third-party risk requirements.

  6. Engage with Risk Partners across the organization (e.g. compliance, technology), as needed, to assist the divisions if required

  7. Deliver on regional expectations and contribute actively to the goals of the TPRM Bengaluru team.

  8. Drive continuous process improvement and innovation, proactively identifying operational gaps and providing input for framework enhancements.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  1. Relevant Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification with an excellent academic record.

  2. 1 to 4 years’ experience in risk management, third-party risk management.

  3. Strong risk management and control mindset, with the ability to support and enable commercial outcomes.

  4. Analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and exemplary attention to detail.

  5. Highly organized with the ability to prioritize, multi-task, and deliver under pressure to tight deadlines.

  6. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills (both written and verbal), with the ability to adapt to a dynamic and changing organization.

  7. Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to de-escalate challenging situations and build consensus across divisions.

  8. Collaborative team player capable of coordinating complex activities with multiple interdependencies across global, cross-functional teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  2. Strong customer service mindset and user experience focus

  3. Exposure to control and risk management processes

  4. Excellent communication skills both written and verbal

  5. Prior experience supporting audits, internal reviews, or regulatory examinations.

The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. is a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm that provides a wide range of financial services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals. Founded in 1869, the firm is headquartered in New York and maintains offices in all major financial centers around the world.

title: Engineering Lead - Geographic Information Systems  (GIS)
description:
Metrolinx is connecting communities across the Greater Golden Horseshoe. Metrolinx operates GO Transit and UP Express, as well as the PRESTO fare payment system. We are also building new and improved rapid transit, including GO Expansion, Light Rail Transit routes, and major expansions to Toronto’s subway system, to get people where they need to go, better, faster and easier. Metrolinx is an agency of the Government of Ontario.

At Metrolinx, equity, diversity and inclusion are essential to living our values of serving with passion, thinking forward and playing as a team.

This role is an in‑office position based at our 20 Bay Street location. Our team is highly collaborative, and much of our work benefits from in‑person co‑creation, relationship‑building, and hands‑on partnership with leaders across the organization.

The Engineering & Safety Division is hiring an Engineering Lead, Geographic Information Systems (GIS) whom provides strategic leadership for the development, governance, integration, and application of Geographic Information Systems across the Engineering and Safety Division (ESD). The Engineering Lead, GIS is responsible for ensuring that geospatial information and analysis are effectively integrated into business processes and decision-making across the organization.

Working at the intersection of engineering, asset management, capital planning, operations, and technology, this role establishes the strategic direction and governance framework for GIS while leading the development of advanced geospatial capabilities that support a common, system-level understanding of the railway network.

The role will enable the organization to integrate asset location with condition, age, performance, lifecycle, operational, and project information to support evidence-based decisions and optimize infrastructure investment.

Why This Role Matters

The Engineering Lead, GIS will play a critical role in enabling Metrolinx to make increasingly integrated, evidence-based decisions about its infrastructure and assets.

As the Asset Management Program continues to mature, the organization requires the ability to understand not only asset inventories, but also how asset condition, risk, performance, operational constraints, capital projects, and planned interventions interact spatially across the network.

This position provides the leadership required to establish GIS as a foundational component of that capability. Through effective governance, data integration, spatial analytics, and cross-functional leadership, the Engineering Lead, GIS will enable the organization to:

  • Improve the prioritization of infrastructure investments.

  • Coordinate capital interventions across multiple programs.

  • Identify spatial dependencies, conflicts, and opportunities.

  • Strengthen risk-based asset management and State of Good Repair planning.

  • Improve visibility of asset condition and lifecycle requirements.

  • Integrate engineering, asset, operational, and project information.

  • Support system-level planning across the railway network.

  • Provide senior leaders with clear, spatially informed decision-support information.

  • Establish consistent enterprise geospatial standards and practices.

  • Advance the organization's digital asset management capabilities.

What Will I Be Doing?

Strategic GIS Leadership

  • Establish and lead the strategic direction for GIS within the Engineering and Safety Division, ensuring alignment with enterprise Asset Management, State of Good Repair (SOGR), capital investment, and infrastructure planning objectives.

  • Develop and maintain a division-wide GIS strategy, roadmap, and business plan that identifies priorities, capabilities, technology requirements, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Provide strategic advice and subject matter expertise to senior leadership on the use of geospatial information, analytics, and technology to support infrastructure and asset management decisions.

  • Represent GIS interests in strategic planning, program development, technology initiatives, and organizational decision-making forums.

  • Identify emerging geospatial technologies, analytical methods, and industry practices that can improve infrastructure planning, asset management, and operational performance.

Geospatial Governance and Data Management

  • Establish and govern division-wide geospatial standards, methodologies, data models, processes, and quality requirements.

  • Provide leadership for geospatial data stewardship, ensuring that critical asset and infrastructure information is accurate, current, consistent, accessible, and fit for business use.

  • Establish governance frameworks that clarify ownership, accountability, data stewardship, and standards across business units.

  • Ensure alignment between GIS data and enterprise systems, including Enterprise Asset Management, engineering, operational, project, and capital planning systems.

  • Develop and maintain a common geospatial framework for representing the railway network and its associated assets.

Asset Management and Spatial Analytics

  • Lead the development and application of advanced geospatial analytics to support evidence-based asset management and investment decisions.

  • Integrate spatial information with asset condition, age, performance, failure risk, maintenance history, operational constraints, and lifecycle information to support risk-based prioritization.

  • Develop spatial analysis capabilities that identify infrastructure risks, dependencies, opportunities, and relationships that may not be apparent through conventional tabular analysis.

  • Support the development of system-level State of Good Repair strategies through spatial analysis of asset condition, risk, criticality, and investment requirements.

  • Enable the use of GIS to identify geographic concentrations of asset risk and support prioritization of infrastructure interventions.

Capital Planning and Program Coordination

  • Lead the use of geospatial analysis to coordinate capital interventions and work planning across multiple programs.

  • Provide spatial analysis to identify conflicts, dependencies, access constraints, construction interfaces, and opportunities for coordinated delivery of capital and maintenance activities.

  • Develop geospatial tools and decision-support products that enable project teams to understand the cumulative impacts of proposed interventions across the railway network.

  • Support integrated planning between Engineering, Capital Projects Group (CPG), Operations, Asset Management, and other stakeholders.

  • Enable spatially informed planning of infrastructure investments to minimize conflicts, optimize delivery opportunities, and improve the overall effectiveness of capital programs.

Risk and Decision Support

  • Develop and implement geospatial approaches to infrastructure risk assessment and mitigation planning.

  • Integrate spatial, engineering, operational, and asset data to support data-driven risk assessments.

  • Provide senior leadership with geospatial analysis and visualization that clearly communicates infrastructure risk, investment requirements, project interactions, and potential service impacts.

  • Develop dashboards, analytical models, maps, and other decision-support products that translate complex geospatial information into actionable business intelligence.

  • Support scenario analysis to assess the potential impacts of infrastructure interventions, changes in asset condition, operational constraints, and capital investment strategies.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Establish effective working relationships with Engineering, CPG, Operations, Asset Management, Technology, and other business areas to ensure GIS capabilities address enterprise priorities.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, systems, datasets, and programs.

  • Facilitate the development of common geospatial approaches and standards across organizational boundaries.

  • Provide leadership and direction to GIS professionals, consultants, vendors, and project teams as required.

  • Influence stakeholders and business partners to adopt consistent geospatial practices and leverage GIS as an enterprise decision-support capability.

Technology and Digital Asset Management

  • Provide strategic direction for the evolution of GIS technology and its integration with enterprise digital asset management capabilities.

  • Guide the integration of GIS with Enterprise Asset Management systems, engineering systems, operational data, capital planning systems, and other enterprise platforms.

  • Assess technology solutions and architectural approaches to ensure GIS capabilities are scalable, secure, sustainable, and aligned with enterprise technology strategies.

  • Support the development of digital representations of the railway network and infrastructure assets to enable improved analysis, planning, and decision-making.

  • Promote automation, interoperability, and data integration to reduce duplication and improve the efficiency and reliability of geospatial workflows.

What Skills and Qualifications Do I Need?

  • Completion of degree or diploma in Geographic Information Systems, Geography, Geomatics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrates progressive experience in GIS, geospatial analytics, asset management, infrastructure planning, engineering, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience leading GIS programs, enterprise geospatial initiatives, or complex cross-functional projects.

  • Strong understanding of GIS principles, spatial databases, geospatial data management, spatial analytics, and enterprise GIS architecture.

  • Experience applying GIS and spatial analytics to infrastructure, transportation, utilities, asset management, capital planning, or other complex physical networks.

  • Demonstrated experience integrating GIS with enterprise systems and diverse business data sources.

  • Experience developing geospatial governance frameworks, standards, data models, and data stewardship practices.

  • Experience using spatial analysis to support risk assessment, asset prioritization, investment planning, or operational decision-making.

  • Demonstrated experience working with senior stakeholders and leading initiatives across multiple organizational functions.

  • Strong understanding of asset management principles and the application of data and analytics to support lifecycle planning and State of Good Repair.

  • Experience leading consultants, technical specialists, vendors, and/or multidisciplinary project teams would be considered an asset.

  • Professional certification in GIS, Geomatics, Engineering, Asset Management, or a related discipline would be considered an asset.

  • Leadership Competencies: The successful candidate will demonstrate:

    • Strategic Leadership: Ability to establish a long-term vision for GIS and translate organizational priorities into actionable strategies and programs.

    • Systems Thinking: Ability to understand relationships between assets, infrastructure, projects, operations, risks, and business processes across a complex transportation network.

    • Analytical Leadership: Ability to transform complex spatial and non-spatial data into meaningful insights that support investment and operational decisions.

    • Collaboration and Influence: Ability to build consensus and influence stakeholders across organizational boundaries without relying solely on formal authority.

    • Business Acumen: Understanding of how GIS, asset management, capital planning, engineering, and operations intersect to support organizational objectives.

    • Innovation: Ability to identify and implement new technologies, analytical approaches, and business processes that improve organizational performance.

    • Communication: Ability to communicate complex technical and analytical concepts clearly to technical specialists, business leaders, and executives.

Don’t Meet Every Requirement?
If you’re excited about working with Metrolinx but your past experience doesn’t quite align with every qualification of this posting, we encourage you to apply. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles. We are always looking for great talent to join our team.

We invite all interested individuals to apply and encourage applications from members of equity-deserving communities, including those who identify as Indigenous, Black, racialized, women, people with disabilities, and people with diverse gender identities, expressions and sexual orientations.

We are also committed to offering reasonable accommodation to job applicants in accordance with applicable legislation. If you require assistance or an accommodation at any point during the hiring process, please contact us at: 416-202-5601 or email hr.recruitment@metrolinx.com.

title: Staff Product Manager - ATP Sight / Sense Products
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.


Shape the Future of Manufacturing with ATP

At Ford, we aren’t just building vehicles — we are redefining how the world moves. Within the Advanced Industrial Technology and Platforms (ATP) organization, we are the architects of Ford’s next industrial revolution.

Our mission is clear: we build and scale industrial platforms, technologies, and capabilities that unlock Ford Firsts to drive sustained competitive advantage in manufacturing. Driven by our vision to "build once, scale everywhere," we bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and global physical deployment.

Our guiding mantra is simple yet relentless: Scale what matters, win what's next.

If you are a high-tech builder, thinker, or innovator who thrives at the intersection of software, hardware, and massive scale, ATP is where you belong. Join us, and write the next chapter of industrial history.

In this position...

Ford's Advanced Industrial Technology & Platforms (ATP) organization is leading a historic industrial transformation — scaling EVs, advanced robotics, additive manufacturing, AI vision, and digital platforms into one seamless operating system. As part of ATP, the Sight Vertical is building an end-to-end business around AI/ML anomaly detection products, spanning image-based detection (Vision) and parametric data-based detection (Sense).

As a Staff Product Manager, Vision, you will contribute to the broader product strategy and execution for Ford's Vision and Sense product lines, acting as the bridge between Ford plant customers and technical teams. You will define the “what” and the “why,” translate factory-floor problems into clear technical requirements, and drive products from discovery through pilot and scale. You will also represent Vision-specific needs to the Core Vertical, helping define the platform capabilities and data/ML requirements that image-based products depend on—leading through influence across data science, engineering, manufacturing, quality, and plant operations.

Location: Dearborn, Michigan. Hybrid is expected, with periodic global travel to Ford manufacturing sites across NA, EU, and IMG.

What you'll do...

  • Contribute to the product strategy and multi-release roadmap for the Sight vertical, aligned to the broader ATP enterprise direction.
  • Lead customer and stakeholder interviews at Ford plants to identify high-value problem statements (e.g., visual defect detection, safety anomalies, quality escapes) and translate them into clear, prioritized product requirements.
  • Partner with data science and engineering teams to define semantic layers, labeling strategy, and model performance criteria needed for image-based anomaly detection models.
  • Own and prioritize the vision/sense product backlog based on ROI, plant “pull,” technical feasibility, and alignment to program milestones (TRL/MRL/IRL gates).
  • Define and monitor product KPIs such as detection accuracy, false-positive/negative rates, OEE impact, scrap/warranty reduction, and deployment lead time.
  • Establish standardized customer feedback loops to monitor product health, adoption, and value realization post-deployment.
  • Partner with the sight/sense launch teams to launch products are “factory ready,” support zero-integration deployment into the Ford Production System based platform, and compress deployment cycle time from pilot to scaled rollout.
  • Serve as the primary Sight vertical interface to the Core platform, identifying and articulating platform capabilities, data models, and ML/infrastructure requirements that image-based products need—helping shape the core infrastructure required for Sight and build shared platform roadmaps so they serve Sight use cases effectively.
  • Drive the evolution of vision and sense products from standalone detection toward prescriptive, closed-loop capabilities connected to FPS issue-resolution and maintenance workflows.
  • Communicate product strategy, progress, and value delivered clearly to Sight Vertical leadership, plant stakeholders, and cross-functional partners.

You'll have...

title: SPS Ctr Specialist-Intermediat
description:
The position of Sponsored Programs Support Center Specialist - Intermediate will be responsible for working with assigned departments to perform post-award sponsored program activities while delivering excellent customer service. Under general supervision, this position will perform support functions for UT Health San Antonio's Principal Investigators (PIs), with a focus on ensuring that PIs and the Office of Sponsored Programs (OSP) have accurate and timely information to prepare and submit quality sponsored program proposals to sponsors, as well as monitor their portfolio of sponsored awards. This role is critical to supporting and enhancing UT Health SA's research and sponsored programs mission.

  • Proactively communicates internal submission deadlines and sponsor due dates to PIs.
  • Assists PI with completing Research Performance Progress Report (RPPR) and other progress report submissions.
  • Prepares and submits to the reporting office transfer grant applications for new incoming faculty.
  • Supports Principal Investigators (PIs) in understanding sponsored program administration, policies, and compliance on an ongoing basis.
  • Assists in connecting PIs to compliance units to ensure proactive monitoring and management of needed protocols.
  • Reviews awarded budget compared to proposal budget, appropriate compliance documentation, etc., and sends revised budget to OSP for processing after PI approval.
  • Coordinates payroll appointments with departmental personnel for sponsored programs. Assist departmental personnel to ensure that payroll distributions are correct for faculty, support staff, and graduate students and the like.
  • Submits requests for award extensions, revisions, carry forward, etc. to OSP, and assists PIs in transferring awards in and out of the institution.
  • Reviews and processes monthly EA-Grants Review and Analysis certifications for all assigned investigators.
  • Reports award spend rate periodically and manages award close outs at least 120,90,60 and 30 days from end date.
  • Reviews expenditures monthly and confirms expenses posted to the general ledger are appropriate with applicable Cost Principles, sponsor, and institutional policies; coordinates personnel and non-payroll cost transfers with the PI and applicable UT Health SA offices.
  • Prepares invoices for the Office of Sponsored Programs (OSP) approval for milestone based or complex sponsor invoices.
  • Supports the OSP with financial reporting reconciliation and validation of report prior to submission to sponsor; ensures all adjustments are processed in a timely matter to support award closeout by 120 days after the award ends, or as dictated by sponsor deadline.
  • Assists with development and submission program reviews and other activities related to the grant.
  • Attends regular meetings, training sessions, and professional development workshops to keep current on policies and procedures relevant to position responsibilities, as requested and approved by the Sponsored Programs Support Center Specialist - Supervisor.
  • Experience managing awarded sponsored projects, including budget oversight, compliance reviews, and administrative requirements.
  • General knowledge of applicable federal, state, and other sponsor regulations related to sponsored programs, especially the OMB Uniform Guidance.
  • Experience working with Enterprise Research Management Systems and financial administration software applications.
  • Ability to work independently in a team environment, take ownership of the resolution of problems, be flexible and accountable, manage conflicting responsibilities, prioritize tasks, and consistently meet both internal and external deadlines.
  • Capability to work with all types of sponsored programs including training, public service, and basic science and clinical research.
  • Attention to detail, problem-solving, and ability to prioritize multiple projects and responsibilities to meet deadlines.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience examining and analyzing financial transactions to develop accurate reports, identify viable solutions.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's degree is required.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, or project management is strongly preferred.

BONUS CERTIFICATIONS:

  • CRA (Certified Research Administrator, CFRA (Certified Financial Research Administrator) are preferred but not required.

Job Summary:

The Engineer III is a highly skilled maintenance professional responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient, and uninterrupted operation of all hotel facilities, building systems, and equipment while delivering exceptional guest experiences. This position performs advanced preventive and corrective maintenance, serves as a technical resource within their primary trade expertise, and provides guidance and support to junior engineering team members. The Engineer III responds to maintenance requests throughout guest rooms, meeting spaces, food and beverage outlets, public areas, and back-of-house facilities, while helping ensure compliance with all safety standards and regulatory requirements. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, hospitality experience, exceptional troubleshooting skills, and a commitment to maintaining the luxury standards of Regent Santa Monica Beach.

A little bit about your day:

Reporting to the Assistant Director of Engineering every day is different, but you’ll mostly:

  • Perform advanced preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs involving electrical, plumbing, HVAC, refrigeration, carpentry, painting, locksmith, fire life safety, lighting, communication, and other building systems while serving as the primary resource within your designated trade expertise.
  • Respond to maintenance requests, guest concerns, and emergency situations throughout guest rooms, meeting spaces, food and beverage outlets, public areas, and back-of-house facilities while maintaining luxury service standards.
  • Review complaint logs, maintenance requests, and work order systems daily, completing assignments dispatched through HotSOS, Espresso, or similar platforms.
  • Provide training, guidance, and technical support to junior engineering team members while promoting teamwork and operational excellence.
  • Monitor, maintain, and help optimize the safe, efficient, and economical operation of all hotel equipment and building systems.
  • Assist the Chief Engineer and Assistant Director of Engineering with room inspections, facility inspections, regulatory compliance efforts, and preventative maintenance programs.
  • Complete documentation related to maintenance activities, communicate assignment status to supervisors and dispatchers, and promptly report significant repair concerns or unusual operating conditions.
  • Perform minor function and event setups, equipment repairs, guest assistance requests, and maintenance support activities throughout the property.
  • Maintain inventories of tools, equipment, supplies, and replacement materials while ensuring engineering shops, storage areas, and workspaces remain clean, organized, and operationally ready.
  • Safely operate tools, equipment, materials, and chemicals in accordance with hotel standards, manufacturer guidelines, and safety procedures.
  • Execute hotel emergency procedures, support sustainability initiatives, comply with all safety regulations, policies, and grooming standards, and remain current on hotel updates and operational changes.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned by hotel leadership.

Requirements:

  • High school diploma, vocational training, or post-secondary education in Engineering, Maintenance, Facilities Management, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Minimum three (3) years of hands-on maintenance experience required, preferably within a luxury hotel, resort, or commercial facility environment; previous hospitality experience required.
  • Ability to read, write, and speak English fluently and communicate effectively with guests, colleagues, and leadership.
  • Advanced knowledge of plumbing, electrical, HVAC, refrigeration, boilers, pumps, lighting, fire life safety, communication systems, and preventative maintenance practices.
  • Experience using maintenance management and building systems software such as HotSOS, Espresso, Opera, Lutron, Bartech, Inncom, Microsoft Office, or similar platforms preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex maintenance issues, safely operate hand and power tools, and mentor junior engineering team members.
  • Must be guest-focused with exceptional hospitality, organizational, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, climb, and lift up to 75 pounds, and work a flexible schedule including weekends, holidays, and varied shifts.

title: Director, Consumer Digital Experience
description:
Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country.

Our Support teams work with multiple departments in a dynamic environment that promotes flexibility and autonomy, while offering the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse group of professionals. We work to comply with our company standards, exceed customer expectations, and drive our Great Place to Work culture. We deliver high-quality services aligned to business needs, driving innovative improvements that support our company strategy and modern operating principles.

We are seeking a Director, Consumer Digital Experience to join the Credit Acceptance marketing team, reporting to the VP of Marketing. Credit Acceptance helps people with credit challenges buy a vehicle and build a stronger financial future. This leader owns the vision for the consumer digital experience across every surface and every stage of that journey — our website, mobile app and web portal — from the first moment someone wonders whether a car is possible, through the purchase, and across the life of the loan.
This is where our emerging consumer value proposition will live. The Digital Vehicle Marketplace — giving consumers the ability to shop for and purchase a vehicle online from a Credit Acceptance dealer — is the future of the company, and it will be delivered through these surfaces. This role owns all of them: the website, the app, the portal and payments, the experience standard that holds them together, and a single prioritized roadmap that decides what gets built and when.
This leader is expected to define the destination state for the consumer digital experience — what it should become over the next several years — and then sequence the work that gets us there. The leaders of Consumer Acquisition and Customer Loyalty & Retention are this role’s closest partners: they bring the business opportunity and the target, and this role is accountable for the experience that delivers it. Success requires someone who moves fluidly between long-range vision and shipping product, and who makes prioritization decisions transparently when demand exceeds capacity.

Outcomes and Activities:

  • This position will work from home; occasional planned travel to our Southfield, Michigan office may be required. However, this position is permitted to work at our Southfield, Michigan office if requested by the team member.
  • Define the destination state for the consumer digital experience and the multi-year path to reach it, and own a single prioritized roadmap across website, mobile app, web portal and payments — directly accountable for digital engagement, collection rate and cost to serve.
  • Set and enforce the experience standard across surfaces so the website, app and portal work as one brand to the customer, regardless of how we are organized internally.
  • Partner with Consumer Acquisition and Customer Loyalty & Retention to translate business opportunities into digital experiences, and sequence competing roadmap demand on value and capacity while making the tradeoffs explicit.
  • Own the website experience that earns the purchase — conversion rate optimization, prequalification, dealer finder and marketplace surfaces, lead capture and dealer matching.
  • Own the app and portal experience that owns the relationship — self-service, benefits delivery, progress and next-loan re-entry, and the work with Servicing to reduce assisted contacts.
  • Own end-to-end digital payments — the payment methods and channels we offer, how payments are processed, retried and recovered, governance and compliance, and the processor, card network and financial institution relationships behind them.
  • Build the shared foundations the roadmap depends on — one login and customer profile across surfaces, notifications, personalization and marketing technology integration — in partnership with Engineering.
  • Define the success measure and expected value for each initiative with the business owner, own the release date and build plan, and hold the team to measured movement rather than delivery milestones.
  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing product, design and digital team across payments, app and portal, website and experience design.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Digital Product Leadership: Proven ownership of consumer-facing web and mobile product surfaces — able to define a multi-year destination and break it into work that ships, without losing the through-line.
  • Payments & Self-Service: Working command of digital payment methods and processing, servicing workflows, vendor and processor management, and the economics of reducing assisted contacts.
  • Conversion & Experimentation: Fluent in funnel instrumentation, testing and conversion rate optimization; sets the test agenda and ships winners rather than debating opinions.
  • Prioritization Under Constraint: Able to weigh competing demand from multiple internal partners with a transparent, value-based method, and to hold a sequence once it is set.
  • Quantitative & Insights-Driven: Comfortable with napkin math and sizing opportunities, and draws sharp, metrics-driven implications from qualitative and quantitative data alike.
  • Executive Communication: Confident, polished communicator able to present and influence at the executive level.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Builds strong partnerships across marketing, product, engineering, servicing, analytics and compliance to deliver shared outcomes.
  • Team Leadership: Builds and develops a high-performing team across more than one product surface, with genuine commitment to treating customers well.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Product Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in digital product, digital customer experience, or ecommerce, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Proven track record owning consumer-facing website and mobile app experiences and the business outcomes they drive.
  • Experience leading product managers and designers across more than one product surface.
  • Experience owning or heavily influencing budget/investment decisions for a function or program area.
  • Experience running an experimentation program and using quantitative and qualitative data to inform strategy and measure impact.
  • Experience managing engineering, design and vendor partners to deliver a roadmap on a committed cadence.
  • Demonstrated experience presenting to and influencing senior/executive audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred:

  • MBA or other advanced degree.
  • Experience in financial services, fintech, or subprime/near-prime lending.
  • Experience with digital payments, billing or account servicing platforms.
  • Experience with marketplace, ecommerce or vehicle retailing experiences.
  • Experience with AI-assisted service experiences and the containment economics behind them.

Hos Beritech leverer vi procesudstyr og projektløsninger til food- og farmaceutiske industrier og arbejder tæt sammen med vores kunder gennem hele værdikæden – fra rådgivning og design til produktion, installation og service. Hos os er det menneskene bag teknologien, der gør forskellen. Vi leverer ikke bare produkter og løsninger; vi skaber dem gennem dybtgående samarbejde, nytænkning og en ufravigelig forpligtelse til højeste kvalitet.

Om stillingen
Som Project Manager får du det samlede ansvar for at planlægge, styre og gennemføre projekter inden for maskiner og proceslinjer til lakse- og ørred forarbejdning. Du følger projekterne fra overdragelse til endelig levering og bliver det centrale bindeled mellem kunden og vores interne fagområder. En vigtig del af rollen er projektøkonomien, hvor du ejer budgettet og følger op på omkostninger, forecast og margin med fokus på at sikre en sund projektøkonomi og håndtere eventuelle afvigelser og risici.

Dine primære ansvarsområder:

  • Du planlægger og driver projekter fra overdragelse til afslutning med ansvar for scope, tidsplan, kvalitet og økonomi.
  • Du ejer projektbudgettet og følger løbende op på omkostninger, forecast, margin og afvigelser.
  • Du identificerer og håndterer projektmæssige og kommercielle risici samt ændringer i projektets scope.
  • Du rapporterer på projektstatus, økonomi og risici til ledelsen.
  • Du sikrer tydelig kommunikation og forventningsafstemning med kunder, interne stakeholders og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.
  • Du bidrager i kalkulations- og tilbudsfasen med estimater, tidsplaner og projektinput.
  • Du sikrer, at kunden får en løsning af høj teknisk kvalitet, og at projekterne afsluttes struktureret med fokus på læring og videndeling til fremtidige projekter

Om dig
Du er en erfaren og forretningsorienteret Project Manager, der trives med det samlede ansvar for projektets fremdrift, økonomi og leverance. Du arbejder struktureret, reagerer proaktivt på afvigelser og har blik for, at projekterne både skal levere den rette løsning og skabe en sund forretning. Du har gennemslagskraft, træffer beslutninger og tager naturligt de nødvendige dialoger med kunder, leverandører og interne samarbejdspartnere.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du har:

  • En relevant teknisk uddannelsesbaggrund, eksempelvis som ingeniør, maskinmester eller tilsvarende.
  • Det er et krav, at du har erfaring med projektledelse af tekniske projekter inden for maskinløsninger eller procesanlæg til fødevareindustrien.
  • Solid erfaring med økonomistyring i projekter og praktisk erfaring med budgettering, cost control, forecasting og marginstyring.
  • God kommerciel forståelse og evnen til at omsætte projektmæssige beslutninger til økonomiske konsekvenser.
  • Stærke kommunikative evner og erfaring med at navigere mellem kunder, teknikere, specialister, leverandører og ledelse.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?
Hos Beritech får du en central rolle i gennemførelsen af komplekse tekniske projekter og mulighed for at få reel indflydelse på både den tekniske og kommercielle projekteksekvering. Ydermere tilbyder vi:

  • En selvstændig rolle med stort ansvar og mulighed for at præge dine projekter fra start til slut.
  • Et stærkt fællesskab med engagerede og fagligt dygtige kollegaer i hele Beritech Group.
  • En kultur præget af samarbejde, innovation og udvikling.
  • En uformel og nærværende ledelse, som er tæt på hverdagen.
  • Lækker kantineordning, hvor du hver dag kan glæde dig til frisklavede retter, salatbar og sunde alternativer – og selvfølgelig med plads til lækkerier.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold
Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt med løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Vil du vide mere?
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Peter Møller, Chief Technology Officer på pmo@beritech.dk.
Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og lukker stillingen, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så send gerne din ansøgning og dit CV snarest muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Om Beritech

Beritech er en international samarbejdspartner indenfor tank- og procesudstyr til fødevare- og farmaceutisk industri. Med mere end 25 års erfaring og en arbejdsstyrke på over 500+ medarbejdere er det vores mission at levere innovative og bæredygtige løsninger for at understøtte produktionen af sikre og prisoverkommelige fødevarer og lægemidler i højeste kvalitet.

Beritech Group er en privatejet organisation, der består af flere enheder med hvert sit speciale, hvilket gør det muligt at give kunderne et omfattende og samlet tilbud af produkter og services ét sted. Vores hold består af alt fra konstruktører, smede, montører, ingeniører og administrative medarbejdere, som sammen sørger for, at vi bevarer og udvikler vores ledende markedsposition.

Beritech har hovedkvarter i Nørresundby og har desuden afdelinger i Aalborg, Randers, Hinnerup, Hillerød og Kalundborg. De seneste år har Beritech gennemgået en enorm udvikling og vækst med en løbende udvidelse af værditilbuddet til vores kunder – og der er intet der tyder på, at vi sætter farten ned foreløbigt.

Nøglen til fælles succes

Beritech er en energisk organisation med en flad struktur, hvor vi ved, at vores medarbejdere er det vigtigste, vi har. Hver eneste person spiller en vigtig rolle i den kollektive succes, og vi kan tydeligt se, hvordan trivsel og resultater går hånd i hånd.

Derfor er det også en topprioritet for os fortsat at kunne tilbyde et arbejdsmiljø, hvor vores medarbejdere kan udnytte deres fulde potentiale og trives i en atmosfære præget af fleksibilitet, ansvar og motivation. Kun ved at tiltrække og fastholde de bedste kompetencer i branchen, kan vi levere løsninger kendetegnet ved pålidelighed, bæredygtighed og innovation.

Selvom vi er fordelt på flere lokationer i Danmark, har vi formået at skabe et unikt sammenhold og en kultur præget af humor og forbedringskraft. Beritech er kendt for at være en attraktiv og engageret arbejdsplads, og i 2022 blev Bent Larsen, Group CEO, kåret som årets ejerleder i Nordjylland for hans bemærkelsesværdige lederskab og engagement i at skabe et positivt arbejdsmiljø.

Vil du være en del af noget større?

Hos Beritech er vi dybt afhængige af at have de dygtigste medarbejdere. Derfor er vi altid på udkig efter nye talenter og kollegaer, der deler vores passion for innovation og kvalitet. Går du derfor med en drøm om at blive en del af et ambitiøst team i en uformel organisation, så hold øje med vores sociale medier og vores stillingsopslag her på siden.

Måske du er vores næste kollega.

title: Roaming Business Expert – Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description:
Tieto Tech Consulting, is looking for a highly skilled and motivated Roaming Business Expert, a professional who will join a project within a Telecom Team for our respectful client BICS.

Join the team of our customer BICS – a global telecommunication enabler with a physical network stretching through the globe! Grow your expertise through interacting with A-level mobile carriers from all over the world. Get your hands on the vast network with on land, underwater, and space points of presence.Join our decade-long partnership with BICS to ensure confidence in your future and long-term growth! Tieto-BICS team has been growing since 2010… and we are looking forward to grow with you!

  • Develop your telecom expertise in diverse portfolio of BICS products, including Voice, Cloud, Signaling, LTE, IoT, etc.
  • Enjoy unmatched growth opportunities with BICS vast network and customers around the world.

Tieto - BICS team has been growing since 2010… and we are looking forward to growing with you!

Role Purpose:

The Roaming business Expert is responsible for representing the commercial interests of a designated customer in all roaming-related negotiations with international mobile network operators (MNOs). The role ensures that Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) agreements are aligned with the customer’s strategic goals and budget expectations, while maintaining strong industry relationships and ensuring compliance with regulatory and contractual frameworks.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Representation:
    • Act as the commercial voice of the customer in all IOT negotiations, ensuring their strategic and financial objectives are met.
    • Translate customer P&L targets into negotiation strategies and commercial outcomes.
  • Negotiation & Contract Management:
    • Lead bilateral and multilateral negotiations with roaming partners and groups to secure optimal IOT terms.
    • Ensure contracts reflect agreed commercial conditions and are aligned with GSMA standards and RAEX processes.
    • Monitor contract lifecycle and proactively manage renewals and amendments.
  • Financial Reconciliation & Settlements:
    • Perform regular reconciliations between operational and financial data (e.g., invoices, payments, service delivery, usage reports).
    • Validate and process settlement reports, ensuring accuracy of financial postings and balances.
    • Perform Monthly Accruals for discounted commercial deals.
    • Support monthly and quarterly financial closing activities, ensuring all settlements are captured and accrued correctly.
  • Commercial Strategy & Analysis:
    • Analyse roaming traffic, cost trends, and partner performance to identify negotiation opportunities.
    • Collaborate with finance, pricing, and analytics teams to model commercial scenarios and assess impact on customer P&L.
    • Support the development of roaming pricing strategies and discount frameworks.
  • Stakeholder Engagement:
    • Maintain strong working relationships with internal stakeholders (e.g., finance, legal, operations) and external roaming partners.
    • Provide regular updates and reporting to the customer on negotiation progress, risks, and outcomes.
  • Market Intelligence & Compliance:
    • Stay informed on industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitive benchmarks.
    • Ensure all agreements comply with GSMA guidelines, roaming regulations, and internal governance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Telecommunications, or related field
  • 3–7 years of experience in roaming, wholesale, or telecom commercial roles
  • Experience negotiating IOT agreements or managing roaming partnerships
  • Fluency in verbal and spoken English; additional languages are a plus
  • Strong presentation skills

Personal Skills

  • Growth Mindset: Eager to learn, adapt, and continuously improve negotiation strategies and outcomes
  • Can-Do Attitude: Proactive, solution-oriented, and resilient in the face of challenges
  • Accountability: Takes ownership of deliverables and follows through on commitments
  • Collaborative Spirit: Easy to work with, respectful, and able to build trust across cultures and teams
  • Professionalism: Maintains a high standard of integrity, discretion, and customer focus in all interactions

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Director, Audit Operations – Client Tooling & Supplier Banking Programs
description:
Director, Audit Operations – Client Tooling & Supplier Banking Programs

Do you have experience leading complex supplier audit programs within automotive or manufacturing environments?

Are you a strong operational leader who can manage audit teams, client relationships, financial findings, and program performance from start to finish?

About the Role

The Director, Audit Operations is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of supplier tooling and banked inventory audit programs. This role oversees audit operations, field resources, client governance, quality assurance, financial analysis, reporting, and overall program performance across multiple supplier locations.

In this role, you will provide strategic and operational leadership to ensure audits are completed on schedule, findings are accurately documented, risks are appropriately escalated and identified recovery and cost-avoidance opportunities are supported through resolution.

The Director will serve as a key client-facing leader, partnering with Purchasing, Finance, Vendor Tooling Engineering, suppliers, and other stakeholders to drive high-quality execution, contractual compliance, continuous improvement, and measurable business outcomes.

Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end execution of supplier tooling and banked inventory audit programs.

• Provide strategic direction and operational leadership across multiple audit workstreams, supplier locations, and field teams.

• Manage audit schedules, resource assignments, capacity planning, workload balancing, and overall program delivery.

• Ensure audit activities are completed in accordance with contractual requirements, established procedures, and client expectations.

• Lead client governance meetings, operational reviews, executive updates, risk management, issue resolution, and change-control activities.

• Monitor key performance indicators including audit completion, cycle time, quality, findings, financial opportunities, and client satisfaction.

• Lead technical auditors, inventory auditors, analysts, and other supporting resources.

• Oversee pre-audit planning, scope validation, supplier prioritization, risk assessments, documentation reviews, sampling strategies, and site planning.

• Review and approve audit findings, workpapers, reports, and executive summaries for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and traceability.

• Serve as a senior operational liaison between Conduent, client stakeholders, and supplier representatives.

• Partner with Purchasing Buyers, Finance, Vendor Tooling Engineering, and other key stakeholders to resolve audit findings and operational issues.

• Present audit progress, findings, risks, trends, financial exposure, and recovery or cost-avoidance opportunities to client leadership.

• Oversee reconciliation of tooling purchase orders, supplier quotes, invoices, payment documentation, inventory records, and related financial information.

• Ensure identified recovery, cost-avoidance, policy deviations, and inventory discrepancies are appropriately validated and supported by documentation.

• Support resolution activities including debits, purchase-order modifications, piece-cost adjustments, and supplier negotiations as directed by the client.

• Analyze trends across suppliers, programs, locations, audit categories, and financial findings to identify risks and improvement opportunities.

• Establish consistent quality standards, audit procedures, reporting templates, and documentation expectations.

• Drive continuous improvement across audit methodology, standard work, reporting, quality, and operational processes.

• Lead, coach, and develop team members while promoting accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Support recruiting, onboarding, training, performance management, workforce planning, and succession planning.

• Manage program performance, resource utilization, productivity, engagement revenue, margin, and delivery within the Director’s span of responsibility.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Operations, or a related field.

• Seven or more years of experience in audit, supplier management, manufacturing operations, inventory control, finance, consulting, program management, or a related area.

• Three or more years of leadership experience managing teams or complex operational programs.

• Experience working within automotive OEM, Tier 1 supplier, or complex manufacturing environments.

• Demonstrated experience leading client-facing programs and communicating with senior and executive-level stakeholders.

• Strong knowledge of audit operations, financial reconciliation, supplier management, risk management, and quality assurance.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, resources, and supplier locations simultaneously.

• Strong financial and analytical skills with the ability to identify, validate, and communicate financial findings and business opportunities.

• Strong executive communication, presentation, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with tooling lifecycle management, capital asset audits, supplier banking programs, or inventory governance.

• Experience with ERP, warehouse management, inventory management, or financial reconciliation systems.

• Experience identifying, substantiating, and tracking financial recovery and cost-avoidance opportunities.

• Knowledge of automotive tooling, supplier operations, purchasing processes, and manufacturing environments.

• PMP, Lean Six Sigma, audit, supply chain, or related professional certification.

• Advanced degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.

Flexible Working

At Conduent, we value individuality and flexibility in how our associates work and deliver their best. In this role, you can expect the following working conditions:

  • Remote work: Enjoy the flexibility of working from home, optimizing your work-life balance.

Working For You:

Perks and rewards designed for you:

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Tailored to fit your and your family's needs, effective from day one.
  • Retirement Savings: Supportive plans to help you secure your financial future.
  • Employee Discounts: Access a broad array of discounts on merchandise, services, travel, and more.
  • Career Growth Opportunities: A variety of opportunities to advance your career within a global company.
  • Paid Training: Earn while you learn with access to award-winning learning platforms.
  • Paid Time Off: Attractive packages designed to help you enjoy your life outside of work.
  • Great Work Environment: Join an award-winning culture recognized for diversity and inclusion efforts.

Join Us:

At Conduent, we are united by a single mission. We know that our success is tied to the success of our associates. We strive to create an environment where you can:

  • Bring your authentic self to work every day.
  • Grow and thrive both personally and professionally.
  • Make a meaningful impact with our clients, in our communities, and for the millions of people we serve.

When you join Conduent, you are part of a future-oriented team – shaping both the company's and your own future. With more than 54,000 associates in 24 countries, you'll have opportunities to grow with people who inspire you to be your best.

title: Development Officer, Athletics
description:
USF Advancement connects the university with donors who want to make a difference by providing philanthropic support to promote student success, research, academic excellence and other strategic priorities. With an endowment that now exceeds $700 million in value, our dedicated team of approximately 200 professionals, including 60 fundraisers, encompasses alumni, development and foundation operations. The team is responsible for raising more than $150 million annually and has broken records year after year with more than $184 million raised in fiscal year 2025.

The Development Officer, Athletics serves as a key member of the USF Athletics Development team and is responsible for leading annual giving strategy, donor engagement, and operational support for the Bulls Club. This position drives philanthropic support through direct marketing, personal solicitation, stewardship, donor benefits administration, and data-driven fundraising initiatives designed to increase annual fund revenue and donor participation.

The Development Officer, Athletics oversees the day-to-day administration of Bulls Club membership and benefits while executing comprehensive annual giving strategies that cultivate, solicit, retain, and upgrade donors at all giving levels. Working collaboratively with Athletics, Advancement, Ticket Operations, and external stakeholders, this position ensures exceptional donor experiences while building a pipeline of future major gift prospects in support of USF Athletics priorities.

The role combines frontline fundraising, annual giving operations, donor relations, analytics, and strategic communications to increase unrestricted philanthropic support and strengthen long-term donor engagement with USF Athletics.

Employees of USF Advancement live out the values of responsibility, innovation, service, and excellence in each of its highly collaborative departments. We use trusted data and ethical AI to enhance decision-making, strengthen engagement, and enable our teams to focus on what matters most: relationships and impact.
