title: DiL Simulator Track Modeling Engineer
description:
As our Executive Chairman, Bill Ford himself states, "When we race, we race to win". At Ford Racing, this is our core philosophy as we race toward the 2030’s. We pride ourselves on being a technical leader in the industry, developing the most innovative tools and methodologies. As Ford Racing continues to grow and expand our team to better support the various automotive racing series we compete in, we need people like YOU to help us achieve our goals together!

In this position...

This position will be responsible for updating, developing and maintaining our entire Ford Racing library of DiL simulator tracks to ensure they match the real world as closely as possible. We’re looking for a bright and self-motivated individual to help catapult our DiL (Driver in the Loop) simulator program to the next level, where a single tool can be used to support all our racing programs (ie. NASCAR, SportsCar, WRC, Off-Road, Electrified Demonstrators, etc.), as well as our production car programs (ie. Mustang, Raptor, etc.). This position will be responsible for updating, developing and maintaining our entire library of DiL simulator tracks to ensure they match the real world as closely as possible. This opportunity is a golden ticket for periodic travel to the various racing circuits and testing facilities across the country to collect first-hand information and apply your learnings digitally to our simulator tracks.

**Ability to travel

What You’ll Do…

  • Collect Information: Work directly with sanctioning bodies of our various race series, track & facilities management, and travel to locations as needed to collect information which will be used to improve the accuracy of our simulator tracks library.

  • Utilize & Develop CAE Tools: Utilize commercially available and proprietary tools to implement learnings directly to our tracks libraries. Contribute to the development and maintenance of our DiL Simulator track manipulation tools, continuously adding capability and efficiency to the process.

  • Close the Gap Between the Real World and Simulation: Understand the unique physical aspects of vehicles and develop solutions to replicate those attributes in the simulation environment.

  • Documentation: Maintain a database for our library of tracks, organize and archive supporting documentation in a logical manner for efficient user access.

  • Team Player: Work directly with colleagues from our various divisions to help tie together the individual components (ie. Aero, Powertrain, Chassis, Race Team Strategy, etc.) which comprise a successful simulator program.

You’ll Have…

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Mechanical, Computer or Electrical Engineering

  • 1 + years programming languages for data processing and tool automation (MATLAB, Simulink, C++, Visual Basic, Python, Java, etc.)

  • Passion for Motorsports

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize work and manage multiple projects simultaneously

Even Better, If You Have...

  • Master’s or PhD in Mechanical, Computer or Electrical Engineering with a focus on Vehicle Dynamics or Control Systems

  • Experience with computer-based race gaming, along with having developed custom tracks, vehicle models and liveries

  • 2+ years of Automotive Vehicle Dynamics, CAE, and/or DiL Simulator experience, with an emphasis on performance or racing vehicle design and modeling

  • 2+ years of experience using parametric and/or multi-body dynamics tools like Dymola, CarSim, VI-CarRealTime, ADAMS, ADAMS Car, AVL or similar software packag

  • Participation in Formula SAE, Baja SAE, Robotics or professional motorsports engineering experience modeling various aspects of race car vehicle dynamics.

  • A personal passion for track driving or off-roading, with an ability to subjectively evaluate vehicle handling limits

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? title: Mental Health Specialist II - Acute Behavioral Services * Up to $3000 Bonus *
description:
About the Program:

Our Acute Behavioral Services (ABS) group homes support individuals with complex mental health and behavioral needs. Many of the people we serve have experienced frequent crises, hospital stays, or legal involvement. They may have a history of failed placements and need a highly structured environment to succeed.

Our homes are specially designed for safety, and our approach is consistent, person-centered, and focused on helping individuals reach their goals while maintaining safety for everyone. Due to the challenging nature of this work, staff receive training in behavioral support and crisis response, including the use of manual restraints when necessary.

What You’ll Do:

  • Provide direct support to individuals with intensive behavioral and mental‑health needs, using person‑centered approaches focused on safety, skill‑building, and positive engagement.
  • Support individuals in accordance with behavior support plans, treatment plans, crisis-prevention strategies, de-escalation techniques, and manual restraint procedures as trained.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, structured living environment; assist with daily living skills, household tasks, activities, transportation, and community engagement.
  • Accurately document services, behavioral observations, health concerns, and program activities using electronic systems (T‑logs, Therap, health tracking).
  • Monitor behavioral changes, identify escalation indicators, and communicate proactively with supervisors and team members during crisis or safety situations.
  • Support family and personal contacts, assist with appointments, medication administration tasks (as allowed), and follow all medical and nutrition plans.
  • Participate in team meetings, provide feedback on individuals’ needs, and assist in training new staff while modeling positive, professional behavior.
  • Maintain home safety, follow emergency procedures, and ensure compliance with protocols and individual support plans.

Required (Must-Have)

  • High school diploma or GED
  • 3 years minimum of experience working with individuals with chronic and severe mental illness OR a degree in a mental-health–related field
  • Must be at least 18 years of age; some programs require employees to be 21 years of age or older
  • Valid driver’s license and proof of auto insurance
  • Basic computer skills and ability to use electronic documentation systems

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods
  • Ability to safely manage physically demanding situations

Skills & Abilities

  • Follow behavior support plans, treatment plans, functional assessments, and person-centered plans
  • Use crisis prevention, de-escalation, redirection, and manual restraints as trained
  • Communicate clearly and professionally in writing and verbally, including documentation
  • Work effectively in crisis situations and exercise sound judgment
  • Collaborate with team members and external partners (case managers, law enforcement, mental health professionals)
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving, consistency, time-management, and independent prioritization skills

  • en veldrevet skole med sund økonomi, stærke traditioner og gode faciliteter
  • engagerede og kompetente medarbejdere med høj faglighed og udviklingslyst

  • balancerer empati og beslutningskraft

title: Klasselærer 6. klasse på Vidar Skolen
description:
Vidar Skolen

Websted Vidar Skolen

Vidar Skolen tilbyder en stilling som klasselærer i vores nuværende 6.klasse med ansættelse snarest muligt.

Vidar Skolen er Danmarks ældste steinerskole med klassetrin fra børnehaveklasse til 12. klasse (2. HF) og dertil vuggestue og børnehave. Vi er en 12 års helhedsskole, der hviler på steinerpædagogiske læringsprincipper. Det betyder, at vi sammen skaber alsidige skoledage, hvor intellekt, følelse og krop dagligt er i bevægelse.

Vi følger opmærksomt med i tidens strømninger for at hjælpe den enkelte elev til at kunne orientere og bevæge sig i samfundets fællesskaber. Vores ønske er i samarbejde med elever og forældre at bidrage til at skabe frie selvstændige mennesker, der efter afsluttet skolegang vil kunne tage fat på livet med glæde, selvstændighed og virkelyst.

Stillingen

Vi forestiller os følgende profil:

  • du har en pædagogisk grunduddannelse gerne fra lærerseminariet samt Sofiaseminariet
  • du har erfaring med undervisning og klasserumsledelse
  • du er tydelig og professionel i din kommunikation med elever, kolleger og forældre
  • du ser din professionelle relationskompetence som en vigtig del af dit virke som lærer
  • du er nærværende og engageret
  • du er interesseret i skolens antroposofiske værdigrundlag og kultur

Praktiske informationer

Løn og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Lærernes Centralorganisation.

title: Cybersecurity Presales Engineer Cisco Security ALM Data Systems Doha, Qatar
description:
Job Title: Cybersecurity Presales Engineer (Cisco Security) ALM Data Systems Doha, Qatar

Recruiting Company: ALM Data Systems
Job Location: Doha, Qatar
Job Type: Full-Time
Application Method:
Location: Doha, Qatar
Experience Required: 4-10 Years
Industry Focus: Enterprise & Government Cybersecurity Solutions
Preferred Candidates: Qatar/GCC-based professionals; strong India-based candidates will also be considered

Position Summary

ALM Data Systems is seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Presales Engineer specializing in Cisco Security solutions to support enterprise and government customers across Qatar. This role combines deep cybersecurity expertise with customer-facing consulting skills, enabling organizations to design, evaluate, and implement modern security architectures that protect critical business environments while supporting digital transformation initiatives.

Detailed Job Description

As a Cybersecurity Presales Engineer, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the sales lifecycle, helping customers assess security challenges and develop effective, scalable cybersecurity solutions. Working closely with sales teams, technology partners, and Cisco stakeholders, you will design security architectures, conduct workshops and demonstrations, prepare technical proposals, and support strategic bid responses. The role requires strong expertise across network security, Zero Trust, Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Extended Detection and Response (XDR), cloud security, and secure access technologies. You will play a critical role in winning new business opportunities by translating complex security requirements into compelling technical solutions that align with customer objectives and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities
  • Engage with enterprise and government customers to understand business, technical, and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Design and develop Cisco Security architectures aligned with customer security strategies and compliance requirements.
  • Prepare High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), Bills of Materials (BOMs), and Bills of Quantities (BOQs).
  • Deliver compelling technical presentations, executive briefings, solution demonstrations, workshops, and proof-of-concept engagements.
  • Partner with sales teams to identify, qualify, and pursue cybersecurity opportunities.
  • Develop technical proposals, solution documentation, and compliance matrices for RFP and RFQ submissions.
  • Provide expert technical consultation and architectural guidance throughout the sales cycle.
  • Conduct technical assessments and recommend security modernization strategies.
  • Position Cisco security solutions effectively against competing technologies and vendors.
  • Collaborate with Cisco, distributors, and strategic technology partners to develop winning solutions.
  • Assist customers with technology evaluations, migration planning, and cybersecurity transformation initiatives.
  • Support commercial and technical negotiations through solution validation and technical justification.
  • Stay current with emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, technologies, and industry best practices.
  • Contribute to business growth by identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts.
Required Qualifications & Skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Telecommunications, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in Cybersecurity Presales, Solutions Engineering, Security Consulting, or Security Architecture roles.
  • Strong hands on experience with Cisco Security technologies and platforms.
  • Expertise in Cisco Secure Firewall (Next Generation Firewall), Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS), and Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS).
  • Knowledge of Cisco Secure Access, Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), and Security Service Edge (SSE) architectures.
  • Experience with Cisco Umbrella, Cisco Duo, Zero Trust frameworks, and identity based security solutions.
  • Understanding of Cisco Extended Detection and Response (XDR) and modern threat detection capabilities.
  • Strong knowledge of network security principles, segmentation, secure access, and cloud security.
  • Experience preparing technical proposals, architecture documents, BOMs, BOQs, and bid responses.
  • Ability to conduct technical workshops, demonstrations, and proof of concept engagements.
  • Experience supporting enterprise and government customers.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and customer engagement skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem solving, and solution design capabilities.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with sales, engineering, partners, and customer teams.
Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Hands on experience with Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, Check Point, CrowdStrike, Zscaler, or Microsoft Security solutions.
  • Cisco Certified Network Professional Security (CCNP Security) certification.
  • Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Security (CCIE Security) certification.
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification.
  • Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) certification.
  • Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) certification.
  • Experience with cloud security architectures across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Arabic language proficiency for customer facing engagements across the GCC region.
Recruitment Pro Tip

The strongest candidates demonstrate not only technical expertise but also measurable presales success. Make sure your CV highlights Cisco Security solutions you have architected, the value of projects won, successful RFP/RFQ responses, proof of concept engagements delivered, and how your technical recommendations directly contributed to revenue growth or customer acquisition.

title: College Advising Mentor Specialist
description:
Company Overview:

Improve Your Tomorrow (IYT) was founded in 2013 with the mission to increase the number of young men of color (YMOC) to attend and graduate from colleges and universities. We envision a world where men of color are overrepresented in higher education, underrepresented in the criminal justice system, and leaders in their communities. Position Overview:

The College Advising Mentor Specialist is the primary relationship, college advisor, and college-going culture builder for students in grades 9–12. Under the FY26/27 restructure, this role operates as the senior site-based leader for daily programming — present on campus every day, owning the daily IYT experience for students, and serving as the consistent human connection between students, their families, and the college-going path ahead.

Key Responsibilities:

Mentorship & Daily Student Support

  • Serve as the senior site-based leader for daily IYT programming; maintain consistent, visible presence on campus every school day.
  • Deliver 1:1 mentorship to all grade levels on the site roster.

Open Study Hall

Structured Programming

  • Led structured programming at the site: own the full Brotherhood experience including rituals (Brotherhood Clap, Creed, Family Love, announcements, energizer) and the Member Development Workshop.

Family Engagement

  • Conduct a family touchpoint after every mentorship session — affirm student growth, share a win, or invite the family into an upcoming opportunity.
  • Led quarterly family engagement touchpoints throughout the year (Q1 Orientation/Welcome, Q2 Milestone, Q3 Mid-Semester, Q4 Celebration).

Academic Monitoring & College Readiness

  • Monitor student GPA, A–G/college eligibility progress, and attendance across assigned caseload.
  • For 12th graders, coordinate FAFSA/CADAA timelines, college applications, and senior readiness with the College Completion Mentor Specialist.

Data & Documentation

  • Log all mentorship sessions, programming attendance, and family touchpoints in Salesforce within 24 hours of occurrence.
  • Maintain up-to-date academic records for each student on caseload — including GPA, A–G/college eligibility progress, attendance, and D/F flags — and surface concerns to the Associate Program Director in a timely manner.
  • Track and document all grade-level milestones, including FAFSA/CADAA completion, college applications, intent-to-enroll, orientation, registration, declared major, education plan, and counselor connection for 12th grade students.
  • Maintain accurate intervention notes and academic recovery plans for students carrying D/F grades or falling below a 2.0 GPA, documenting follow-up actions and progress.
  • Complete end-of-week Salesforce logging and review students not yet seen to ensure no member falls through without contact or a scheduled follow-up.
  • Document the warm handoff to the College Completion Mentor Specialist for each 12th grade student, ensuring the introduction and transition are recorded before graduation.

title: Senior specialist data science
description:
About Us

Ooredoo is a dynamic global Telecommunications player operating in 10 countries serving more than 138 million customers. Ooredoo Qatar employs approximately 1,600 people driving Ooredoo to be the number one choice for world‑class communications services in Qatar, and it is a team that you can be part of!

About the Role

This role is responsible for strengthening the AI practice by working closely with the relevant stakeholders (B2 B/C, Technology, Finance etc.) on impactful AI/ML and Gen AI use cases to contribute to business strategy, digital growth and an evolving data & AI roadmap. The role will focus on translating customer and commercial needs into scalable ML/Gen AI/Data Science models and decisioning capabilities across business domains including customer value management (CVM), marketing, digital sales and customer care.

Functional Context

Ooredoo places strong emphasis on a data‑driven culture. In an ever‑changing business landscape, there is increasing organizational focus on using AI/ML in day‑to‑day practice to create value, efficiency, and diversification. The AI Hub division is responsible for putting in place and executing the data & AI roadmap, business plan, and strategy. Ooredoo is building cloud platform‑based solutions involving GCP that hosts the data platform and supports analytics and ML workloads, while Azure hosts Gen AI and agentic AI workloads.

Role Accountabilities Understand business requirements for Telecom business (B2 C/B2 B) and develop AI/ML based data science models to do value addition. Own end‑to‑end AI/ML model lifecycle: problem framing, data discovery, feature engineering, training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement (self‑learning where applicable). Deliver Customer Value Management (CVM) use cases such as churn prediction and prevention, customer lifetime value (CLV), propensity models for upsell/cross‑sell, and Next Best Offer / Next Best Action frameworks. Enable hyper‑personalization and real‑time decisioning by designing decision logic, recommendation models and event‑driven scoring to support always‑on campaigns and contextual offers. Support AI‑enabled marketing and digital sales optimization, including audience segmentation, campaign optimization, attribution/uplift measurement, personalized messaging, and digital funnel conversion analytics. Develop call‑center efficiency use cases including call volume forecasting, workforce optimization inputs, routing/prioritization analytics, and AI‑assisted service journeys. Design and implement conversational AI and Gen AI solutions (e.g., virtual assistants, agent‑assist, summarization, knowledge retrieval) to improve customer experience and operational efficiency while adhering to governance controls. Command on PL/SQL with feature extraction, pre‑processing of data, training, scoring, and actionable insight extraction in leading database platforms e.g., Teradata, Oracle etc. Build insights through statistical measures/algorithms/graphs/info graphics and communicate results in a business friendly format for stakeholders and leadership. Evaluate models and establish robust tracking mechanisms for adoption and realized business outcomes; proactively follow up on lead utilization with use case owners. Ensure Responsible AI practices: model governance, documentation, privacy‑by‑design, bias/robustness testing, explainability where required, and secure handling of customer data. Manage and continuously improve the Data Science Operational Framework, including standards for reusable code, model registries, versioning, and release management in collaboration with Technology teams. Work as part of a shared function across organization on use cases to support product growth, cost optimization, customer engagement and customer experience improvements. Minimum Entry Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or Similar

Minimum Experience, Essential Knowledge & Skills

10 years' experience in a similar role. Prior experience in data science and AI/ML‑based advanced analytics, including hands‑on development on leading data science platforms (Dataiku as the primary platform) using Python and R. Demonstrated expertise in predictive modelling for telecommunications (telco) customer analytics (e.g., churn prediction, propensity, customer lifetime value (CLV)) as well as segmentation,recommendation/decisioning systems, and timeseries forecasting. Experience implementing hyper‑personalization and Next Best Offer/Action frameworks in marketing and digital sales contexts. Practical knowledge of Gen AI/LLM solutions (e.g., prompt engineering, retrieval‑augmentedgeneration, evaluation methodologies, and model guardrails) and hands‑on experience using Gemini and/or Azure AI for automation and customer experience use cases, Strong command of SQL and PL/SQL for advanced feature extraction with large‑scale data on enterprise data platforms (e.g., Teradata, Oracle, Big Query) Familiarity with MLOps practices – such as version control, pipeline orchestration, model registry, CI/CD deployment patterns, monitoring, and lifecycle management – within Dataiku and incollaboration with Technology teams. Understanding of Responsible AI principles, including privacy, security, and bias mitigation for AI models and automated decisioning. Excellent understanding of telecommunications commercial practices and customer journeys, andthe ability to work cross‑functionally with Product, Marketing, Sales, Digital, Technology teams. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Project Scheduling Specialist
description:
We’re hiring a Project Scheduling Specialist to develop and update project schedules across the company. This position will work closely with the director of scheduling and project teams providing training and support.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
As a project scheduler you'll confidently and professionally represent Dowbuilt, with a positive attitude and customer service driven approach. To succeed in this position, you’ll bring:

  • Coordinate schedule activities between various projects and stakeholders. In collaboration with project teams, prepare, monitor and update overall project schedules using MS Project Online, following guidelines and policies.
  • Run regular update meetings with project teams to assist and assess conflicts in schedule logic and risks to schedule critical path and deadlines.
  • Provide clear and accurate schedule update reports identifying long and short-term resource requirements for projects, Critical Path drivers and risks, work with project teams to ensure proper planning, and to identify scheduling conflicts as well as offer solutions.
  • Clear understanding and working knowledge of critical path scheduling.
  • Learn and apply scheduling logic, based on construction sequencing of project; use Dowbuilt scheduling templates to incorporate project specific tasks, milestones, project calendars and other schedule constraint controls.
  • Develop an understanding of the design process, construction planning and procurement as it relates to the residential market and incorporate these processes into all schedules.
  • Integrate subcontractor and supplier schedules, as provided by project teams into master schedules and update regularly.
  • Collaborate with Direct of Scheduling, project teams and related stakeholders to develop and capture scheduling and planning best practices for Dowbuilt.
  • Train project engineers, project managers and superintendents on MS Project to allow teams to independently update and maintain schedules; provide troubleshooting support.
  • Participate in internal project reviews as requested.
  • Assist in other scheduling department functions, as needed (including by not limited to developing SOP’s).
  • Demonstrate and support a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion
TRAVEL: Some nationwide travel to job sites may be required. Less than 10% of time.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED
To be successful as a Dowbuilt project scheduling specialist, you’ll need:

  • Undergraduate degree in Building Science, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field or equivalent professional experience
  • High degree of proficiency in MS Project and critical path scheduling methodology
  • Ability to collaborate and build relationships with project teams that transcend a project
  • Detail-oriented and proactive problem solver
  • Proficiency with MS Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word)
  • Experience with applications such as Smartsheet, Egnyte, Slack and Asana is preferred
  • Demonstrate and support a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion
  • Operate with a high level of integrity, positivity, and emotional intelligence

Essential Functions

  • Collaborate with project build teams to create, monitor and update project schedules using MS Project software.
  • Generate and distribute project schedule update reports identifying controlling issues and risks to project progress.
  • Ability to work minimum Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 4:30pm, not including commute time
  • Must have reliable transportation to get to/from work and to/from job sites safely and on-time
  • Must comply with Dowbuilt’s drug and alcohol policy
  • Must be able to pass a criminal background check and drug screen

Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

The duties of this position require the employee to constantly operate a computer and other office equipment, as well as the ability to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time. The duties of this position also require the employee to frequently communicate with employees and clients, and the employee must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

WHAT WE OFFER
​​​​​​​We are a fun, easygoing bunch of professionals who take a lot of pride in the work we do. We acknowledge the contributions and talents of our team members by providing benefits that support you at work and in life:

  • Competitive pay commensurate with skills and experience
  • 100% paid Medical, Dental, Vision, short-term disability and $50k in basic life insurance for full-time employees – 1st of the month following DOH
  • 35% Medical and 30% Dental + Vision coverage for eligible dependents
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan with 3% employer safe harbor contribution
  • 8 paid holidays each year, no waiting period
  • Paid Time-Off (PTO) – 0.046 hours per 1 hour worked (approx. 12 days for full-time employees) with an increase to this accrual each January with years of service up to max of 176 hours/22 days annually
  • Annual tool stipend and tool loan policy
  • Education/Tuition Reimbursement program
  • Opportunities to build for Dowbuilt in other regions, if desired
The base pay range for this position is $85,000 - $130,000 per year. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity.

New hires typically start below the midpoint of the range, with the opportunity for growth and advancement over time.

WHO WE ARE
Dowbuilt is a construction company founded in 1980, and today our talented teams can be found from coast to coast. We excel at cutting-edge, innovative, never-been-done-before residential projects and home service—all of which require precision and impeccable attention to detail. We work with top architects, and our builds are regularly featured in publications such as Architectural Digest, Architectural Record, and Dwell.

The Dowbuilt culture is one of care—care for our employees, clients, and the talented craftspeople we partner with—resulting in care for the incredible designs we bring to life.

HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT
We’re committed to investing in our team members’ ongoing professional development, and as a leader with Dowbuilt, you play a big part in ensuring that your team has equal opportunity to play to their strengths, fill gaps in knowledge and grow professionally.

Effective career development requires two-way, open communication between employee and manager. This means expectation setting happens on both sides, along with support, mentorship, and goal setting at regular intervals. Find out how you can take your own career to the next level and inspire the next generation of talent with Dowbuilt.

Dowbuilt is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Agentic AI security - 2 positions
description:
Tigera—the pioneer behind Calico and Lynx—is defining the future of AI agent security, workload governance, and cloud-native networking. As autonomous AI agents, LLM frameworks, and microservices proliferate across enterprise infrastructure, Tigera delivers the deep visibility, runtime protection, and eBPF-driven enforcement control required to secure the next generation of computing.

From modern cloud-native architectures to cutting-edge AI agent ecosystems, our technology safeguards over 1 million Kubernetes clusters across multicloud and hybrid environments. Trusted by world-class innovation leaders—including NVIDIA, Royal Bank of Canada, Bloomberg, Chipotle, GoDaddy, and Upwork—we empower enterprises to build, scale, and innovate with AI safely and without compromise.

At Tigera, our customers are the heroes of our story. We aim high, move fast, foster continuous learning, and build a high-trust, highly collaborative environment where every voice shapes the future of AI security. If you are looking to help make a substantial impact, and our values and products align with your vision of your career growth, we want to hear from you!

About Your Role

Tigera is looking for passionate and skilled software engineers to join us in our mission to secure the next generation of agentic AI workloads running on Kubernetes and beyond. With Lynx by Tigera, we have a platform that discovers agentic AI on any host, secures it through the kernel and our gateway. You will get to work at the cutting edge of AI agent security and help define what makes an agent an agent. You will help build the tools to distinguish an AI agent from a standard workload and secure it so it cannot go rogue! You will get to work with technologies such as eBPF, Go, Python, Cedar, agentgateway, OpenTelemetry, ClickHouse and more.

You will be joining a team that is highly engineering-focused with a culture that values diversity, collaboration, agility, and innovation, keeping us one step ahead in the exciting and fast moving cloud-native technology space. You’ll work on the hardest parts of the stack: traffic interception, policy enforcement, and observability for agentic workloads. You’ll take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

For this role, we are looking to hire in Vancouver (Hybrid).

Vancouver Salary Range: CAD $125,000 to CAD $150,000

You Have

  • 5+ years as a software engineer with a track record of shipping and supporting production code
  • Strong proficiency in one or more of Go, C/C++, Rust, or Python
  • Solid working knowledge of Kubernetes and containers, including how workloads are deployed, networked, and secured
  • Understanding of Linux systems and networking outside Kubernetes (hosts, VMs, cloud infrastructure)
  • Thrives on fast iteration and MVP work, and likes taking on hard, open-ended technical problems
  • Comfortable owning features end to end in a fast-moving, early-stage product environment
  • CS degree or equivalent practical experience

Nice-to-Haves

  • Expertise in proxy or service mesh technologies such as Envoy and/or Istio, including Kubernetes Gateway API or AI Gateway implementations
  • Experience building detection, discovery, or asset inventory systems, such as traffic analysis, workload fingerprinting, or runtime telemetry
  • Experience with eBPF or other kernel-level observability
  • Experience with AI/ML systems, data pipelines, analytics, or modeling
  • Familiarity with emerging agent protocols such as MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent)
  • Background in cloud-native security, zero-trust networking, or workload identity (e.g., SPIFFE/SPIRE)
  • Open source contributions in the cloud-native ecosystem

But more than any specific experience, the most important criteria for success will be your talent, energy, and passion to help build and shape the future within a collaborative, agile, community-based environment.

With offices in San Francisco, San Jose, Vancouver (Canada), Cork (Ireland), and London (England), we have a thriving team of diverse individuals from all over the world. We believe in a collaborative, flexible work environment based on respect for, and commitment from, every employee. We also offer a competitive compensation package along with full health, vision, and dental benefits. These benefits, coupled with an amazing team of individuals who believe in our mission and value openness, collaboration, and teamwork, make Tigera an awesome place to work.

title: Program Manager
description:

The program spans multiple business areas and interconnected workstreams, requiring strong coordination, communication, and stakeholder management across a complex, matrixed environment.

title: Executive Desk Public Adjuster
description:
Allied Public Adjusters (APA) is currently expanding and seeking motivated individuals to join our team as an Executive Desk Public Adjuster. The Executive Desk Public Adjuster is a senior professional desk claims handler who advocates for the policyholder and serves as the Executive Public Adjuster’s claims counterpart on the firm’s large-loss and high-value claims. The Executive Desk Public Adjuster works well in a rapid-paced environment, models behaviors that reflect APA’s core values, and reports to a Managing Public Adjuster as part of a pod team structure. The Executive Public Adjuster is the field expert with eyes on the property and direction of each claim. The Executive Desk Public Adjuster partners in developing that approach and owns the execution. The purpose of an Executive Desk Public Adjuster is to independently handle the day-to-day management of the shared caseload, serve as the primary point of contact with the carrier, client, and vendors by phone, email, and letter, and drive every claim forward to resolution for matters not involving field work. This is a senior claims professional role requiring a high level of independent file handling, judgment, and follow-through.

The ideal applicant must have:
  • 7+ years of property claims experience with a proven record of independently managing files to resolution
  • Experience handling large-loss, commercial, and/or complex residential claims
  • Strong knowledge of coverage, claim planning, and negotiations
  • Confident and persuasive communicator with the carrier by phone, email, and formal letter
  • Proficiency in Xactimate, including building, revising, and supplementing estimates
  • Extensive knowledge of residential and commercial building construction
  • Active State Public Adjuster License (or ability to obtain within the first 90 days)
  • Exceptional writing, organization, follow-through, and professionalism
  • Sound judgment and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision on a high volume of concurrent, high-value files
  • Understanding of insurance Industry standards, policies, applicable laws, and regulations, including the California Fair Claims Settlement Practices Regulations
  • Maintain a clean driving record and an active California Driver’s License (in the event supplemental field work becomes necessary on any given claim)

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

The following is a summary of the essential functions of this position. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Responsibilities may change from time to time based on business needs.

  • Serve as the Executive Public Adjuster’s claims counterpart, independently handling the day-to-day management of the shared large-loss and high-value caseload
  • Partner with the Executive Public Adjuster in developing the claim approach, contributing coverage analysis, documentation review, and carrier history
  • Execute the established approach with the Executive Public Adjuster in the field and execute it from the desk through resolution while maintaining high documentation standards
  • Serve as the primary point of contact with the carrier, client, and vendors on shared claims, communicating by phone, email, and formal letter
  • Draft and send position letters, demand letters, proof of loss packages, and responses to carrier requests and denials
  • Negotiate with carrier adjusters within the approach and authority established with the Executive Public Adjuster, and escalate when the approach needs to change
  • Drive carrier accountability by tracking requests and responding to deadlines, pushing for timely payments, scheduling re-inspections, and escalating delays
  • Prepare, submit, and track supplements, and keep Xactimate estimates current as scope develops, coordinating with in-house estimators as needed
  • Effectively analyze policy coverage and identify coverage issues, scope gaps, and strategic opportunities, and bring recommended next steps to the Executive Public Adjuster
  • Keep the Executive Public Adjuster informed through regular claim reviews so field insight and desk execution stay aligned
  • Track critical policy and claim deadlines and act on them well in advance
  • Own file discipline on the shared inventory: file hygiene, timely activity notes, and audit-ready documentation
  • Maintain timely client communication and expectations
  • Effectively and efficiently utilize support teams such as legal, estimating, and leadership where needed to resolve claims for clients
  • Follow internal processes, documentation standards, timelines, and compliance requirements
  • Attend inspections, re-inspections, and site meetings as needed.
  • Ability to drive regularly to the office and client property inspection sites

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Settlement outcomes and recovered value on the shared inventory
  • Carrier response and payment cycle times
  • Supplement turnaround time and approval rate
  • File quality and audit-readiness
  • Stalled-file rate on the shared inventory
  • Files moved to resolution monthly

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months:

  • Fully assumed day-to-day handling of the Executive Public Adjuster’s book, with no claim stalling on the desk side
  • Established as the trusted primary contact for carriers on shared claims, with professional, well-documented phone, email, and letter communication
  • Built a trusted partnership with the Executive Public Adjuster that turns field direction into consistent desk execution
  • Achieve strong claim outcomes for clients through disciplined execution and relentless advocacy
  • Delivered accurate, defensible estimates, supplements, and position letters that hold up in negotiation, appraisal, or litigation
  • Create Executive Public Adjuster capacity to take on additional large-loss claims
  • Produce audit-ready files with complete, timely documentation
  • Meet or exceed claim cycle time standards while balancing quality and urgency
  • Anticipate carrier tactics and deadlines, escalating issues before they become problems
  • Collaborate effectively with internal business partners and the pod to drive results
  • Show ownership mentality by treating every claim like it matters in a proactive manner
  • Contribute positively to the company culture and results

Logistics

  • Location: Remote

Salary

  • $110,000 to $150,000 base + performance bonus

Benefits

  • 401(k) with 3% non-elective contribution
  • Health and dental insurance options
  • Car & phone allowance
  • Generous paid holidays and paid time-off policy
  • Career advancement and professional development opportunities

Our Core Values: We Show Up with G.R.I.T.

  • Go-Getters: We pursue truth and fairness with rigor and expertise. We are proactive, responsive, and committed to professional service.
  • Relationship Builders: We nurture relationships based on mutual respect, challenging insurers when we must and helping them when we can, all in the spirit of resolving claim matters fairly.
  • Intelligent Experts: We work to achieve mastery of our respective crafts, trusting our teammates to do the same. By focusing on core competencies, we create a team stronger than the sum of its parts.
  • Truth Champions: We pursue truth above all else. To champion our clients' interests most effectively, we seek precisely what is owed, nothing more, and absolutely nothing less.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment:

The mental and physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

  • Ability to remain stationary and work in an office or home office environment for extended periods, including sitting, typing, and completing computer-based tasks
  • Ability to communicate effectively with others through verbal and written communication, including talking, hearing, writing, and typing
  • Ability to read materials in paper format, on a computer screen, and on a phone
  • Ability to perform repetitive motions that may include the wrists, hands, and fingers
  • Ability to adjust focus and have depth perception
  • Ability to maintain visual acuity to identify and assess property damage, review documents, photographs, and inspection reports
  • Ability to walk and stand for extended periods and perform physical movements such as bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, twisting, and reaching while conducting property inspections
  • Ability to maintain balance while working on uneven terrain, and similar surfaces
  • Ability to walk through properties with multiple levels, which may require frequent use of stairs or steps, as well as walking for extended periods
  • Ability to lift and carry equipment (camera, laptop, measuring tools) weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to navigate in and out of a vehicle to drive and sit for periods exceeding one hour from the starting point
  • May be exposed to all weather conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, and wind

title: Quality Management System Coordinator
description:
AFC Industries is a dynamic organization dedicated to providing supply chain management solutions for fasteners and assembly components to original equipment manufacturers, assembly plants, and other users of these products.

We support a diverse industry base of manufacturers across a broad range of industries. Our experienced team has a proven track record of helping manufacturers and assemblers reduce cost, improve quality, and increase efficiency.

We are A Company Culture Devoted to Innovation & Improvement

AFC provides localized expertise to customers in particular industries and geographies. We don't have a traditional hierarchical management structure where everyone simply "reports up." Instead, our company is made up of on-the-ground experts operating in an entrepreneurial fashion with the backing and support of an enterprise-grade organization.

Sharing cultural values breeds consistency and quality throughout our organization. Collectively, we are committed to a simple management approach, which influences our company culture and our management style.

Mission: To execute the operating model consistently by delivering for customers every day.

The QMS Coordinator supports the development, implementation, centralization, standardization, administration, and continuous improvement of the company's enterprise Quality Management System (QMS).

This role coordinates QMS documentation, audits, corrective actions, training, metrics, certifications, and quality initiatives across the organization.

Working cross-functionally with Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Sales/Commercial, and other stakeholders, the QMS Coordinator helps standardize processes, strengthen quality system compliance, and provide the tools and visibility needed to support effective quality ownership and continuous improvement.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Enterprise QMS Centralization and Standardization: Support the Corporate QMS Leader in the development and implementation of a standardized enterprise Quality Management System.
  • Document and Record Control: Coordinate the enterprise document and record control process to ensure QMS documented information remains accurate, current, approved, accessible, and appropriately controlled.
  • QMS Process Deployment: Support process owners with the deployment of standardized enterprise quality The Coordinator will help maintain process documentation, implementation tools, deployment schedules, training materials, and evidence of implementation.
  • Internal and External Audit Coordination: Support development and administration of the enterprise internal audit program.
  • Corrective Action and Continuous Improvement Coordination: Support disciplined corrective action management across the enterprise. The position coordinates and facilitates corrective action discipline but does not replace process-owner accountability for resolving issues.
  • Certification and Standards Management: Support enterprise certification activities and compliance with applicable management-system requirements.
  • QMS Training and Competency Administration: Coordinate enterprise QMS training and awareness activities.
  • Management Review and QMS Performance Reporting: Support preparation and administration of enterprise management review and QMS performance reporting.
  • QMS Governance and Administration: Support the operating rhythm and governance of the enterprise QMS.
  • Cross-Functional Support: Work collaboratively with Quality, Operations, Supply Chain/Procurement, Sales/Commercial, Engineering, IT, HR, and other functions to support effective QMS implementation.
  • Follow applicable policies, procedures, and work
  • Support department and continual improvement

  • Accuracy and Attention to Detail -- Completes work accurately, thoroughly, and in accordance with established procedures and requirements.
  • Communication -- Communicates clearly, professionally, and in a timely manner with customers, vendors, coworkers, and management.
  • Organization and Time Management -- Effectively prioritizes responsibilities, manages multiple tasks, and meets established deadlines.
  • Teamwork and Collaboration -- Works cooperatively with others and contributes to a positive, respectful, and productive work environment.
  • Accountability -- Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, follows through on commitments, and promptly addresses issues or concerns.
  • Problem Solving -- Identifies problems, evaluates available information, and takes appropriate action or seeks assistance when necessary.
  • Professionalism -- Maintains a professional attitude, appearance, work ethic, and conduct consistent with company expectations.
  • Quality and Compliance -- Follows applicable company policies, procedures, work instructions, and ISO-related requirements and maintains accurate documentation.
  • Continuous Improvement -- Identifies opportunities to improve processes, efficiency, accuracy, customer service, and overall business performance.
  • Confidentiality and Integrity -- Protects confidential information and conducts all business activities with honesty, integrity, and sound judgment.

Physical Requirements: Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods, frequent use of keyboard, mouse, telephone, and other office equipment in an indoor climate-controlled setting, moderate standing, walking, bending, squatting, and occasional lifting of up to 10 pounds from floor to desk height and minimal overhead lifting

To be the name Gallatin Valley homeowners give their neighbors when asked who to call: the company that answers the phone, shows up when promised, and stands behind the work a year later. And to be the company the valley's best tradespeople choose to partner with, doing the craft they love without the burden of running the office side of a business.

CRAFTSMEN FIRST
That vision starts with you. A craftsman who is looked after looks after the customer, so we build our business around yours: a consistent flow of customers, published pay terms we honor, and consistent payment schedule. Our core values, Delivering on Our Commitments, Respecting the Connections, Taking Pride in Our Work, and Practicing Continuous Improvement, apply to how we treat you as much as how we treat our customers.

At Handyman Connection of Bozeman, we connect skilled handymen and handywomen with steady, high-quality work without the headaches of running a business. You won’t have to worry about finding jobs, chasing payments, or dealing with customers on your own. We take care of that so you can focus on doing what you love.

WHY PARTNER WITH US
  • Earn $40–$60 per hour based on experience
  • Performance bonuses
  • A consistent flow of customers with no marketing cost to you
  • Pre-screened customers and detailed work orders, so you know what's expected before you arrive
  • Materials ordered for you, so you show up and do what you do best
  • Customer calls, billing, and collections handled by our local office
  • A mobile app that keeps job details, addresses, and customer notes in one place
  • Full freedom to accept or decline any project that fits your availability
  • A supportive local office invested in your success
WHO YOU ARE
  • Paid experience in carpentry, drywall, painting, minor plumbing, minor electrical work, or general home repairs.
WHAT YOU'LL DO:
  • Repairs and maintenance: drywall patching, door and cabinet adjustments, caulking, weatherstripping, and squeaky floor fixes
  • Installations: TV mounting, shelving, curtain rods, grab bars, smoke detectors, and light fixtures or ceiling fans (non licensed electrical work only)
  • Fixture updates: faucet, toilet, and garbage disposal replacement (minor plumbing that doesn't require a Montana license)
  • Exterior upkeep: fence and gate repair, deck board replacement, gutter cleaning, and screen or storm door repair
  • Small projects and honey do lists: furniture assembly, touch up painting, trim repair, and bundled multi task visits
WHAT YOU BRING
  • Proven finish carpentry experience and an eye for flawless, clean results
  • Skill with miter saws, routers, chisels, planers, finish nailers, and precision measuring tools
  • Knowledge of hardwoods, softwoods, MDF (medium density fiberboard), and specialty woods
  • Work that meets building codes and installation best practices
  • Professionalism: on time, clean job sites, and respect for every customer's home
  • An established trade business with its own phone listing and business cards
  • Your own tools, a truck or van, a valid driver's license, and a smartphone
  • Commercial liability insurance
  • Montana Independent Contractor Exemption Certificate or willingness to obtain. We can assist.
  • Successful completion of a background check and credential verification
OUR HIRING PROCESS
  • Within 24 hours: Contact from our team
  • Within 3-5 days: In person interview in our office or mutually agreed location
  • Within 5-7 days: Offer letter with start date and onboarding overview
WHO WE ARE LOOKINIG FOR
Independent general handymen or women tired of inconsistent job flow, who want more quality projects without the hassle of running the office side of a business.

APPLY TODAY!

Handyman Connection of Bozeman is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a team of skilled professionals who take pride in their work and want to grow in their craft.

title: Account Engineer
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Account Engineer is a high-impact, cross-functional role designed to accelerate the customer journey from initial acquisition to successful platform adoption and expansion on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. You will contribute to this mission by driving initial utilization, leveraging modern AI-powered tools and coding agents to ensure technical success.

This role bridges the critical gap by helping new and early-stage customers achieve rapid implementation, quick value, and a world-class experience on the Snowflake platform. You will be the dedicated customer technical partner, responsible for driving technical enablement and supporting the overall activation and adoption of our customers initial use cases.

This is a fantastic opportunity for technical professionals to develop deep expertise in cloud data architecture, make a measurable impact on customer success, and contribute to one of the fastest-growing technology companies.

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables

  • The Account Engineer manages a critical portfolio of new and early-stage customers, and is accountable for accelerating their time-to-value and achieving sustained platform growth. Operating as a Full-Stack Technical Resource, this role blends deep hands-on expertise with the strategic acumen of a business leader.

  • Strategic Ownership and Value Creation

  • Lead Your Account Micro-Business: Take ownership of the technical success and consumption trajectory within your assigned portfolio, driving adoption metrics in your assigned accounts, acting as a single point of contact for all customer needs.

  • Driving Outcome-Based Utilization: Apply an outcome-based selling mindset to customer engagements, focusing on how the Snowflake AI Data Cloud helps them solve complex data challenges and unlock maximum business value—not just product features.

  • Strategic Advisory and Guidance: Serve as a trusted strategic advisor immediately following the initial contract close, providing guidance on data strategy, technology stack integration, and ensuring a swift, successful activation of Use Cases.

  • Deliver Technical Value with AI: Deliver technical value efficiently by leveraging cutting-edge AI-powered development tools and automation to accelerate solutions and implementation guidance, helping customers move faster to production.

  • Technical Execution and Collaboration

  • Architectural Leadership: Provide customers with critical, Snowflake-specific foundational guidance, including Architectural Best Practices, Workload Isolation & Warehouse Utilization, Resource Monitoring & Alerts, Budgeting, and RBAC/Security Setup.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with the Account Team to highlight risks and establish and nurture trusted relationships with internal Snowflake teams (e.g., Professional Services, Support) and external partners to ensure seamless resource orchestration.

  • Develop Scalable Programs: Create and deliver reusable, high-impact programs, such as Hands-on Labs (HoLs) and webinars, to educate a wide customer audience on specific platform features and industry best practices.

  • Technical Feedback Loop & Innovation: Act as a key feedback loop from the field to influence future product development, working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams.

  • Expert Support and Triage: Efficiently triage a broad array of incoming customer inquiries, assisting the field team with demos, troubleshooting, and identifying opportunities to qualify potential business value for the Expansion team.

Required Qualifications

  • We are seeking highly skilled and motivated technical professionals eager to launch their next career chapter with us.

  • Technical Aptitude: Hands-on experience with SQL is required.

  • Data & Cloud Knowledge: Strong foundational understanding and experience with data architecture, data analytics, and the core concepts of major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

  • Growth Mindset: A strong desire to learn, grow your technical skills, and become an expert in the Snowflake platform.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences.

  • Professional Skills: Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and possess Project Management skills to track, manage, and drive customers to an agreed-upon timeline.

  • Education: University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related fields, or equivalent practical experience in a technical role.

  • What Sets You Apart (Preferred Qualifications)

  • SnowPro Core certification.

  • Proficiency in additional coding languages, particularly Python, Java, or Scala, especially in a data or application development context.

  • Experience with modern data technologies (e.g., CI/CD tooling, orchestration tools) or a basic understanding of Data Science concepts.

  • Prior experience or strong interest in leveraging AI-powered development tools and coding agents to increase solution delivery efficiency.

Performance Assessment & Career Path

  • This role is designed as a direct path to a successful career within the Snowflake Solution Engineering organization.

  • Impact Metrics: Performance is primarily assessed on customer success and platform adoption metrics:

  • Consumption: Driving new customer consumption for the initial contract period.

  • Use Cases: Documented success of helping customers move Use Cases to Production.

  • Growth: Measured via customer retention and growth within the managed portfolio.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Office Associate, Outpatient, Full Time, Hidden Valley Lake
description:

      Job Roles

      • Tracks all patient visits as far as frequency and duration on physical therapy prescriptions within the guidelines of authorizations if applicable. Tracks patient specific data in computer on a daily basis (i.e., patient name/address/telephone number; diagnosis, prescription date, insurance information and dates attended physical therapy).
      • Tracks Medi-Cal TARs as needed and verifies Medi-Cal eligibility.
      • Willingly performs other duties and innovations as assigned.

title: Universal Banker
description:
Who We Are

West Coast Community Bank is a top-rated community bank with a focus on serving the banking needs of businesses and individuals along the Central Coast, in Silicon Valley and throughout the Bay Area.


Delivery of relationship-based service with a solutions-driven focus sets us apart from the competition. We offer direct access to decision-makers combined with modern banking technologies and digital tools. The Bank is a leading SBA lender in Santa Cruz County and Silicon Valley and a top USDA lender in the state of California.


Since opening in 2004, we have proudly upheld our commitment to support regional well-being by actively participating in and donating to local nonprofit organizations. We engage in impactful volunteerism and support the greater economic vitality within our four-county reach, contributing more than 2,000 hours of volunteering annually.


Position Overview

This position is located onsite at our San Jose location and requires travel up to 40 miles to provide scheduled coverage at our San Mateo branch as needed.


As a Universal Banker, you'll assist clients and potential clients by opening a variety of new accounts including checking, savings, IRA, CD and others. Collect required information from new account customers and complete account set up process including data input, verifying references, and documentation. Provide information and answer questions regarding bank products and services. Make referrals as appropriate to cross-sell a variety of bank services.


The UB possesses a thorough knowledge and understanding of all Bank operations and processes client transactions according to Bank's policies and procedures. Performs all required job duties in accordance with the Bank’s regulatory standards. As the first line of defense against risk exposure, you'll ensure all safety and security protocols are followed: to include cash controls dual control, transaction processing and approvals.


Essential Job Functions

  • Perform a full range of teller and new accounts functions, including deposits, withdrawals, and account maintenance
  • Open and service consumer and business accounts in accordance with Bank policies and procedures
  • Originate new accounts and ensure accurate completion of all required documentation
  • Review and understand business entity documentation
  • Provide excellent client service by identifying client needs and offering appropriate Bank products and services
  • Accurately handle cash and balance drawer within established limits
  • Comply with all applicable regulations, including Reg E, Reg CC, and BSA/AML
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of Bank systems and technology
  • Follow established security, audit, and operational procedures
  • Maintain reliable and regular attendance
  • Performs additional duties as assigned that are consistent with the business needs of the Bank and the scope, responsibilities, and level of the role.

title: Community Specialist
description:
Evergreen Residential is a high growth Real Estate Company and institutional investment platform in the single-family residential ('SFR') and build-to-rent (“BTR”) sectors. We are committed to changing the way investors own and manage SFR homes, and to building a modern way to deliver the data, tools and services that enable our clients to invest in the world’s largest asset class at scale. Our team is collaborative, open-minded and curious. Transparency is a core value, we speak our minds, are responsible for our actions and celebrate our wins. We are serious about our business, but we don't take ourselves too seriously.

We offer a flexible, empowering culture, competitive compensation and benefits, and the opportunity to work with and learn from industry pioneers and experts.

If you are self-motivated and mission driven with a ‘can do’ mindset and see solutions where others may see problems, come and grow with us!

Evergreen Live is seeking a highly motivated, independent, and service-driven Community Specialist to lead daily on-site operations at Maxwell Creek, a stunning new Build to Rent community. This is a single-office role, ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment where leasing performance and resident experience go hand in hand. This role will serve as the face of the community, overseeing resident experience, amenity operations, property appearance, vendor relationships, and overall community standards while delivering an exceptional living experience for residents in a beautiful community.

As a Community Specialist, you’ll be the primary on-site team member responsible for delivering exceptional resident experience and maintaining the highest standards across the community. You’ll serve as the on-site primary point of contact for prospects, guiding prospective residents through the leasing journey up to application and move-in while overseeing day-to-day community operations, amenities, vendor relationships, and overall property experience.

This position operates in the Dallas, TX area and is temporary (possibly temp to hire)

Key Responsibilities

Leasing & Pre-Lease Execution

  • Execute lease-up strategies to meet occupancy targets within defined timelines
  • Conduct property tours and effectively communicate features, benefits, and lifestyle offerings
  • Respond promptly to inquiries via phone, email, and in-person with professionalism
  • Assist with pre-leasing efforts including outreach, marketing, digital campaigns, and local events
  • Maintain accurate records of leasing activity, traffic, and conversion metrics

Marketing & Outreach

  • Support marketing initiatives including social media, signage, and local partnerships
  • Distribute promotional materials and engage with local businesses and referral resources
  • Monitor competitor offerings and market trends to properly communicate to revenue management for pricing and promotions

Application & Lease Processing

  • Guide prospective tenants through the application process, including screening and documentation requirements
  • Assist the Applications team with ensuring all paperwork is submitted timely accurately and timely
  • Assist the Move In team with coordinating move in schedules and ensure units are ready for occupancy
  • Partner with centralized support teams to ensure smooth operations
  • Maintain compliance with Fair Housing and company policies

Resident Experience

  • Provide exceptional customer service to prospective and current residents
  • Assist with resident retention efforts including welcome events and communication
  • Conduct Community Walks
  • Address resident concerns with empathy and efficiency
  • Take pride in the community’s appearance, readiness, and reputation

What We’re Looking For

  • 1-3 years of leasing experience, with direct involvement in lease-up or new construction
  • Sales-driven mindset with a customer-first approach
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities
  • Passion for creating a welcoming, well-run community
  • Experience in leasing, hospitality, or customer service preferred
  • Knowledge of Fair Housing regulations
  • Active Real Estate License

Valid Driver’s License and reliable transportation.

Please do not rely on compensation estimates for our jobs that are posted on sites other than our direct website as these may be misleading.

About Evergreen Residential

Founded in 2021, Evergreen Residential is a full-service SFR platform leveraging proven operational practices and the latest technological advances to optimize investor returns and achieve positive outcomes for our residents and the communities in which we operate. We offer a full suite of services, including Investment Management, Asset Origination, and Advisory Services. The firm is headquartered in Dallas with offices in New York City.

The leadership team has extensive experience dating back to the early institutionalization of SFR and unrivaled depth of experience in the complete asset life cycle. We are built to withstand changing market conditions, and our business produces resilient, predictable cash flows and margins. We are committed to charting new paths and using data to achieve best-in-class results. Our business is evergreen.

Beyond financial returns, the Company is committed to measurable impact objectives. We believe that inclusive and equitable management, environmentally sustainable long-term strategies, and resident-focused policies are good business - for our residents, our investors, and our team. We are committed to using environmentally sustainable practices and empowering our residents to improve their financial health.

Our cornerstone values - Accountability, Transparency and Partnership - are built on a foundation of Integrity and provide the roadmap for our daily actions, interactions and decisions.

Equal Opportunities and Other Employment Statements

We are deeply committed to building a workplace and community where inclusion is not only valued but prioritized. We take pride in being an equal opportunity employer and seek to create a welcoming environment based on mutual respect, and to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, family status, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, neurodiversity, disability, age, or veteran status, or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Recruiting Assistant
description:
FrankCrum is a Top Workplace!

The FrankCrum "Family of Employer Solutions" began in 1981 when The Great American Temporary Service was founded. Over the years, Frank W. Crum, Jr. renamed the staffing company from Crum Staffing to now, FrankCrum Staffing. FrankCrum Staffing has grown to become a national company that specializes in contract, temporary to permanent and direct hire staffing with a unique combination of personal care and technology. We help businesses secure the very best talent for temporary jobs, entry level and permanent positions. We cultivate a large network of thoroughly screened and qualified applicants who we carefully match to the unique needs of each client company.

Click here to learn more about FrankCrum!

The Role You'll Play to Create Success

  1. Answers phones, transfers calls, assists callers, retrieves branch voicemail messages and communicates to appropriate team member.
  2. Format resumes for Recruiters
  3. Staffs reception desk by greeting visitors and applicants, notifying team of visitor/applicant arrival.
  4. Performs the applicant registration process to completion.
  5. Performs I-9 authorizations, criminal background checks, verifies employment history, schedules pre-employment drug screens, skill testing, and other activities to support the recruitment process.
  6. Assists with the weekly payroll process upon request.
  7. Sources for candidates and assists with creating positions and matches; ensures information is correct including pay rate, bill rates, workers’ compensation codes, pay groups, invoice groups and invoice methods
  8. Assists with sending assignment confirmations.
  9. Assists with promoting job openings and filling job orders.
  10. Assists with open houses and attends job fairs as needed.
  11. Assists with social media posts to promote job openings and hiring events.
  12. Performs data entry, filing, scanning, and copying.
  13. Clocks in and out consistently and accurately by using the electronic timeclock system for all time worked and does not perform any work when not clocked-in.

The Attributes We Seek

Keys to success in this position include exceptional customer service, written, listening and communication skills, and time management and organization skills. In addition, high school diploma or equivalent, two (2) years of administrative experience. Fluent in Spanish and English.

Our Competitive Benefits

Along with this great opportunity, FrankCrum also provides exceptional benefits from top carriers including:

  • Health Insurance is just twenty-five dollars per month for employee only coverage and a very low cost for family levels.
  • Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Short Term Disability and Term Life Insurance at no cost to the employee
  • Long Term Disability and Voluntary Term Life Insurance
  • Supplemental insurance plans such as Accidental, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Legal Services and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan where FrankCrum matches 100% of the first 4% the employee contributes, and the employee is immediately vested in the employer match
  • Flexible Spending Accounts for Medical and Dependent Care Reimbursement
  • Health Savings Account funded by FrankCrum
  • Paid time off and holiday pay
  • Education Benefit Program at the IRS Maximum allowance
  • PTO cash out
  • Tickets at Work
  • Alero Financial and its robust credit union benefits program
  • Employee and client referral bonus programs
  • Disaster Relief Fund for employees

What's Special About FrankCrum

FrankCrum, a family-owned business-to-business entity since 1981 is made of several companies: FrankCrum Corporate (a professional employer organization), FrankCrum Staffing, Frank Winston Crum Insurance Company, and the FrankCrum Insurance Agency - all based in Clearwater, Florida. This "family of employer solutions" employs approximately 400 people who serve over 4,000 clients throughout the United States. FrankCrum employees are trained to deliver high value through exceptional customer service and treat clients and coworkers like family. By living by our Brand Pillars of Integrity, Affinity, and Prosperity, employees are recognized at quarterly events for exceptional customer service and milestones in tenure.

The FrankCrum headquarters spans 14 acres and includes a cafe, subsidized for employees.
