title: Retail Customer Experience Associate, Santa Maria Town Center - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Customer Experience Colleague, you will create exceptional, personalized shopping experiences for our customers. You’ll prioritize customer satisfaction by actively engaging with shoppers across all touchpoints - both in-store and online - and drive cross-category sales to support overall business goals. With a deep understanding of fashion, fit, and function, you will make tailored product recommendations and leverage digital tools to enhance the customer journey. You also will work across different departments daily, often transitioning between multiple areas throughout the day.

In this role, you’ll also play a key part in client relationship building through outreach tools like My Client and social media. Your collaborative approach with peers, store leaders, and brand partners will help identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and elevate the overall customer experience. In addition to service and selling, you’ll support operational excellence through floor readiness, event execution, merchandise setup, and opening/closing procedures.

A positive, can-do attitude, strong communication skills, and a passion for delivering high-caliber service will be key to your success in this role.

How Our Selling Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They wear their name badge with pride, greet teammates with a warm hello, and help ensure the sales floor is clean, organized, and prepared for customers. Before getting started, they review their sales goals, learn about new arrivals and top-selling items, and stay up to date on current trends and promotions - so they’re fully informed and ready to engage, educate, and sell with confidence.
  • On the floor, they focus on the customer - offering a warm welcome, making eye contact, and creating friendly, personal conversations to create customer relationships to bring the customers back.
  • Throughout the day, they maintain a shoppable space by recovering the floor and fitting rooms, updating signs and pricing, and supporting any needed merchandise moves.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem
  • At least 2 years of selling or customer experience preferred

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

You will gain familiarity with different asset classes while working on various trades and projects and build a broad foundation of product knowledge.

  • Improve existing pricing models and create new ones for structured products.

  • Understand transaction risks and analyse drivers of profits and losses.

  • Provide analysis for new transactions.

  • Drive commercial outcomes using data.

  • Improve existing and create new models for the pricing and analysis of derivatives

  • Identify, curate, and integrate new structured and unstructured datasets into models.

  • Build end to end solutions from data collection to automated actions.

  • Strong quantitative and coding skills with desire to develop commercial mindset

  • Solid work ethics, team oriented, high levels of motivation.

  • Ability to work in fast-paced environment and time-sensitive situations.

  • Effective communication skills in verbal and writing to both technical and business audience.

  • Excellent academic record in a relevant quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Engineering or Computer Science.

  • Strong math and quantitative skills

  • Experience in object-oriented programming with a language such as C++, Java or Python.

  • Knowledge of Stochastic calculus and derivatives pricing, or Machine Learning background

  • Knowledge of credit market and products, interest rates, FX, or risk management is preferred.

title: Leasing Consultant - Multifamily
description:
Position: Leasing Consultant
Location: On-Site
Reports To: Property Manager
Industry: Multifamily Property Management
Job Type: Full-Time| Must be available for weekends and holidays
SunRidge Management Group is a trusted name in multifamily property management with a strong track record of success and over 35 years of experience managing apartment communities across the country. From affordable housing to luxury lease-ups, we pride ourselves on delivering exceptional service, operational excellence, and a people-first culture. Our Dallas-based corporate team supports communities coast to coast with a hands-on, detail-driven approach. SunRidge Management Group is an equal-opportunity employer that promotes a drug-free workplace.
We believe our people are our greatest strength. That’s why we foster a collaborative, ethical, and resident-focused culture where every team member plays a vital role in our continued success.
Position Summary
The Leasing Consultant serves as the primary sales and customer service representative for the apartment community. This position is responsible for greeting prospective residents, identifying their housing needs, and professionally presenting the features and benefits of the property to secure lease agreements. The Leasing Consultant also provides support with resident relations and administrative duties, helping to ensure smooth daily operations and high resident satisfaction.
This role plays a key part in achieving occupancy goals, maintaining resident retention, and representing SunRidge’s standards of service and professionalism.
Key Responsibilities
Leasing & Marketing
  • Greet all prospects warmly and professionally, qualify needs, and guide them through tours of available apartments.
  • Present the community’s features and benefits to prospects, including floor plans, amenities, and neighborhood offerings.
  • Process applications and leasing documents in accordance with company standards and lease guidelines.
  • Maintain knowledge of market trends and competitors through regular market surveys and contribute marketing ideas to the Property Manager.
  • Perform outreach marketing and participate in resident and community engagement events.
Resident Relations
  • Promote outstanding customer service to current and prospective residents.
  • Assist with resident communication, lease renewals, notices to vacate, and resident satisfaction efforts.
  • Respond to resident inquiries and service requests in a timely, professional manner.
  • Support community retention initiatives and help foster a welcoming and inclusive community atmosphere.
Administrative Support
  • Accurately complete lease files, guest cards, application verifications, and follow-ups.
  • Collect rent payments (excluding cash) and issue receipts when requested.
  • Maintain organized leasing files, complete daily traffic logs, and update leasing reports.
  • Document all resident and prospect interactions using proper logging procedures.
  • Assist with property inspections, identify potential service needs, and report to the Property Manager.
  • Support the Property Manager and Assistant Manager with daily administrative tasks and reporting.
Qualifications
  • Minimum 1 year of leasing or sales experience in multifamily housing preferred.
  • New Development Experience or Class A or B leasing preferred
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
  • Knowledge of Fair Housing regulations, ADA, and leasing compliance (or must complete training within 90 days).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and property management systems (e.g., Yardi or OneSite) preferred.
  • Positive attitude, team-oriented mindset, and commitment to excellent customer service.
  • Ability to work weekends and occasional holidays as needed.
Work Environment
This is a Full-time, on-site position at the assigned apartment community. Some weekend and holiday availability is required for tours, events, and operational coverage.
Physical Requirements
  • Must be able to walk the property daily, show apartments, climb stairs, bend, and lift light items.
  • Frequent standing, walking, and interaction with residents and prospects.
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license, automobile insurance, and reliable transportation for work-related travel (bank runs, marketing, errands).
Join the SunRidge Team
If you're a motivated, ethical, and service-minded leader ready to take ownership of a thriving community, we want to hear from you. Apply today and be part of a company where people truly are our greatest strength.

title: CNC Lathe Operator
description:
Employment Type
Existing, Full-Time, Permanent Position

Hourly Rate
$28/hour - $30/hour, depending on experience

Hours of Work
40 hours / week
Monday – Thursday: 7:30AM - 4:30PM
Friday: 7:30AM - 1:45PM

About the Organization
BEX Engineering is a family-owned manufacturing company. We specialize in designing and producing a wide variety of spraying and mixing industrial parts, such as spray nozzles, tank mixing eductors, air atomizers and more.

Since 1962, BEX has been a leader in designing products that suit the needs of practically every industry in the world. Chemical processing, aerospace engineering, television and film, pharmaceuticals, food processing, and pulp and paper are just a few of the major industries which BEX has supported for decades with our state-of-the-art products. Utilizing cutting-edge technology and machining processes is essential to our core values. We strive to be a global leader in our ability to produce high-quality industrial goods. Our headquarters and plant are located in Mississauga, Ontario, and we have two international sales offices – one in Ann Arbor, Michigan, and another in Düsseldorf, Germany.

What we offer:
  • Competitive compensation with growth potential
  • Health benefit coverage
  • Collaborative and supportive work environment
  • Family-run company with company events (summer BBQ, Holiday lunch, monthly pizza lunches)
About the Opportunity:
The CNC Lathe Operator will be responsible for the setup and operation of three Citizen 8-axis CNC lathes, each equipped with a main spindle and a sub spindle, producing precision turned components as assigned by their lead hand. The basic skill sets required for this position include knowledge of G/M code programming for multi-axis lathes, the ability to set up and change over tooling on both the main and sub spindle sides of the machine, the ability to read blueprints, and the ability to measure using a Vernier caliper and micrometer.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Set up and operate three Citizen 8-axis CNC lathes (main and sub spindle) to complete production parts.
  • Perform complete job changeovers, including loading bar stock and adjusting the bar feeder, changing collets and guide bushings, and installing and touching off turning, drilling, cross-working and back-working tools.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings to determine the sequence of machining operations, including how operations are split between the main spindle and the sub spindle.
  • Set and adjust tool geometry and wear offsets on both spindles to maintain dimensions and accuracy.
  • Edit and prove out G/M code programs at the control, running new setups safely before releasing to production.
  • Perform QC inspections to complete first offs, and carry out in-process checks throughout the run.
  • Confirm specification of parts conform to drawings using Vernier Calipers, Micrometers, thread gauges, pin gauges and other precision measuring instruments as needed.
  • Perform precision lathe operations such as turning, facing, boring, drilling, grooving, threading, tapping, cross-drilling, live-tool milling and part-off.
  • Optimize programs to reduce cycle time and setup times, including balancing work between the main and sub spindle and overlapping operations where possible.
  • Monitor tool wear and replace inserts and tools as needed; maintain coolant/oil levels, the chip conveyor and routine machine upkeep.
  • Confirm part performance meets Engineering specifications.
  • Other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

Qualifications and Experience:
  • High school diploma or equivalent; College diploma an asset.
  • 2-5 years of experience in setting up and operating CNC lathes in a manufacturing environment is preferred.
  • Experience with Citizen machines, Swiss-type lathes, or multi-axis lathes with a sub spindle is a strong asset.
  • Working knowledge of G/M code for multi-axis lathes, including synchronized main/sub spindle operations and part transfer.
  • Programming with Mastercam is an asset.
  • Understanding of turning tooling, inserts, and speeds and feeds for materials such as stainless steel, brass and engineered plastics.
  • Ability to use measuring tools such as calipers, micrometers, thread gauges and height gauges required.
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time and lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to keep up in a fast-paced environment.

Interested in being a part of BEX Engineering? We look forward to your application!

BEX Engineering is committed to meeting the accessibility needs of all applicants throughout the recruiting and selection process. Please let us know about any accommodation and/or support requirements. Please note that only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please note: We are only accepting applications from candidates authorized to work in Canada, and we are not currently sponsoring temporary or permanent work visas.

BEX Engineering is working in partnership with HR à la carte for our recruitment efforts.

title: Afdelingsleder til Digitale Markedsprodukter og Porteføljestyring
description:
Vil du arbejde med at udvikle digitale løsninger, der understøtter morgendagens energimarkeder, og samtidig sikre overblik over en digital portefølje samt et solidt fokus på cybersikkerhed og risikostyring i Systemansvar?

Energinet er en central virksomhed i energisektoren i Danmark. I Energinet Systemansvar arbejder vi med at sikre en stabil og bæredygtig energiforsyning til gavn for samfundet. I Energinet spiller digitale løsninger en afgørende rolle i den grønne omstilling og udviklingen af et effektivt og velfungerende elmarked. Vi søger en leder til afdelingen Digitale Markedsprodukter og Porteføljestyring, som kan sætte retning, skabe resultater gennem andre og fremme samarbejdet på tværs af organisationen.

Sæt retning for en strategisk digital produktportefølje

Som leder af Digitale Markedsprodukter og Porteføljestyring udvikler og leder du en afdeling, der understøtter nogle af Energinets vigtigste strategiske mål. Du skal skabe sammenhæng mellem forretning, digitalisering og governance og sikre, at Systemansvars digitale initiativer prioriteres og realiseres med fokus på værdiskabelse og effekt.

Du får det overordnede ansvar for den digitale udviklingsportefølje i Systemansvar, herunder de processer og styringsmekanismer, der understøtter prioritering, investeringsbeslutninger og gevinstrealisering.

Samtidig er du forretningsansvarlig leder for udvikling og drift af digitale markedsprodukter, der understøtter Energinets kerneleverance omkring effektive elmarkeder. En væsentlig del af rollen er at opnå gode resultater i et tæt matrixsamarbejde mellem Systemansvar og Tech & Innovation. Produktorganisationen ledes på tværs af de to områder, hvor forretningsmæssige mål, markedsudvikling og regulatoriske krav skal gå hånd i hånd med teknologi, arkitektur og leveranceevne. Du skal derfor kunne skabe fælles retning, bygge bro mellem forskellige fagligheder og sikre, at beslutninger træffes med fokus på både forretningsværdi, teknisk bæredygtighed og langsigtet udvikling af produktporteføljen.

Derudover får du en central rolle i at udvikle cyber- og risikostyringen på tværs af Systemansvar, så området er godt forberedt på både nuværende og kommende krav fra myndigheder, lovgivning og samarbejdspartnere.

Erfaren leder, der skaber retning og følgeskab

Du er en erfaren leder, der trives i krydsfeltet mellem forretning, digitalisering og regulering. Du har erfaring med ledelse af højt specialiserede medarbejdere og med at omsætte strategiske mål til konkrete resultater gennem digital produktudvikling, porteføljestyring eller større udviklingsinitiativer.

Du er dygtig til at skabe relationer og følgeskab på tværs af organisatoriske og faglige skel og navigerer i kraft af dine analytiske evner sikkert i en organisation med mange interessenter og afhængigheder. Samtidig arbejder du struktureret og skaber klarhed om prioriteringer, mål og resultater.

Du formidler budskaber tydeligt og skaber forståelse for prioriteringer, mål og resultater på tværs af organisationen. Derudover har du en relevant videregående uddannelse og en oprigtig interesse for sammenhængen mellem digitalisering, markedsudvikling og samfundskritisk infrastruktur.

Erfaring fra energisektoren eller andre regulerede områder, hvor forretning, teknologi, governance og myndighedskrav skal balanceres og omsættes til robuste løsninger, vægtes positivt.

Du bliver en del af et engageret og dygtigt ledelsesteam, hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle dine ledelsesmæssige og faglige kompetencer.

Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel sammen med os?

Så ser vi frem til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning og dit cv senest 22-10-2026. Sæt allerede nu et par forsigtige kryds i kalenderen. Vi forventer at holde 1. samtale online 29. og 30. oktober og 2. samtale i Fredericia 10. novenber. Er du nysgerrig på din kommende leder eller har du spørgsmål til jobbet? Se nærmere på LinkedIn eller ring til Jesper Abildgaard på tlf.

Særlige forhold: Da Energinet løser samfundskritiske opgaver, udfører vi baggrundstjek forud for ansættelsen. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at dit baggrundstjek er foreneligt med ansættelse i Energinet. Baggrundstjekket gennemføres desuden én gang årligt.

Jobbet kræver desuden, at du kan opnå og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelse. På PET's hjemmeside kan du læse mere om sikkerhedsgodkendelse.

title: Data engineering consultant
description:
Role Purpose

The Data Engineering Consultant designs, builds and supports reliable data pipelines, integrations and services for client data and analytics solutions. The role converts approved architecture, business requirements and governance controls into tested technical components that move, transform and deliver data with appropriate quality, metadata, lineage, security and operational monitoring. The consultant works with architects, analysts, platform teams, security specialists and client system owners throughout design, development, testing and transition. The role may implement within client environments under authorised access, but production ownership and operational authority remain with the client. The expected outcome is maintainable engineering work with clear source-to-target logic, automated controls, deployment evidence, runbooks and knowledge transfer suitable for client operation after handover.

Key Responsibilities

Analyse approved requirements, source systems, target models, data volumes, schedules, controls and service expectations. Design and build batch, streaming or API-based data ingestion and transformation pipelines. Implement source-to-target mappings, business transformations, reference-data logic and data-standardisation rules. Embed validation, reconciliation, exception handling and data-quality controls within engineering workflows. Capture technical metadata, lineage, schedules, dependencies, ownership and operational information for delivered pipelines. Apply approved security, privacy, classification, access, encryption and logging requirements. Develop automated unit, integration, regression and data-validation tests and retain execution evidence. Optimise performance, scalability, reliability and cost within the approved architecture and platform constraints. Implement deployment automation, version control, configuration management and controlled release practices. Monitor pipeline operation, investigate failures and support defect resolution during implementation and transition. Prepare technical specifications, code documentation, support procedures, runbooks and handover records. Walk client engineers through design decisions, operating procedures and known limitations before transition.

Minimum Requirements Education

Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data engineering or a related field. An equivalent combination of relevant education and directly applicable consulting or implementation experience may be considered.

Professional Experience

Typically 3-8 years in data engineering, integration, ETL/ELT, software or cloud data platforms. Experience in data engineering, integration, ETL/ELT, software development or cloud data delivery. Experience building and testing production-grade pipelines, APIs or data-processing services. Experience with version control, automated deployment, monitoring and operational support. Experience working from architecture, security and data-quality requirements in multidisciplinary teams.

Technical and Domain Knowledge

Data ingestion, transformation and orchestration patterns. SQL and one or more relevant programming or scripting languages. Batch, streaming, API and integration technologies. Cloud or enterprise data platforms and storage patterns. Data quality, reconciliation, exception handling and test automation. Metadata, lineage, source-to-target mapping and documentation. Security, access control, encryption, logging and secrets management. Version control, CI/CD, configuration and operational monitoring.

Core Competencies

SQL and programming. Data pipelines. APIs and integration. Cloud/data platforms. Testing and observability. Security and quality controls. Engineering discipline. Problem solving. Reliability focus. Automation mindset. Clarifying technical requirements and identifying missing decisions early. Estimating engineering effort, dependencies and delivery risk. Explaining technical designs and defects to mixed audiences. Producing maintainable documentation and auditable test evidence. Collaborating with client engineers, vendors and multidisciplinary teams. Working within controlled client access and change processes. Transferring engineering knowledge and supporting operational handover.

Preferred Certifications

Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or comparable cloud data credential CDMP Associate or Practitioner

Focus areas

SQL and programming Data pipelines APIs and integration #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Technical Program Manager/Delivery Manager
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

Do you believe data tells the real story? We do! Redefining mobility requires quality data, metrics and analytics, as well as insightful interpreters and analysts. That's where Global Data Insight & Analytics makes an impact. We advise leadership on business conditions, customer needs and the competitive landscape. With our support, key decision makers can act in meaningful, positive ways. Join us and use your data expertise and analytical skills to drive evidence-based, timely decision making.

In this position...

The Design, Cost & Complexity (DCC) team in Ford's Global Data, Insight & Analytics (GDI&A) organization builds data and AI products that help Ford design better vehicles at lower cost and with less complexity. Our products serve engineers, program teams, purchasing and business leaders across product development, from vehicle configuration and parts complexity to design cost, reductive design, and AI-enabled engineering tools.

We are a global team of product managers, engineers, data scientists and designers. We work closely with our business partners to take products to real adoption, and we increasingly build with AI at the core.

You will own delivery for one or more products in the DCC portfolio, depending on business priorities, and ensure they deliver measurable outcomes for real users. Your assignment may change as the portfolio evolves. Working closely with the Product Manager, you will turn vision and strategy into an executable plan, clear the path for the team, manage dependencies across engineering, IT and business partners, and make sure we prove value with users, not just in demos.

What you'll do...

  • Own the delivery roadmap. Partner with the Product Manager to translate vision and strategy into quarterly plans and milestones. Keep scope, sequencing and trade-offs clear.
  • Drive measurable results. Plan pilots and releases with business partners: choose users, set baselines, and track adoption, time saved and quality.
  • Manage cross-functional dependencies. Coordinate with leadership, subject-matter experts, program teams, IT, security and data teams. Resolve blockers before they reach the team.
  • Lead integration and transition planning. Plan the move from legacy tools and processes to new ways of working, including risks, cutover and change management.
  • Connect the workstreams. Make sure products and components fit together as one system rather than separate projects.
  • Run an effective delivery system. Facilitate planning, reviews and retrospectives. Keep work structured in Jira so visibility comes from the work itself.
  • Manage risk honestly. Surface risks, prototype-versus-production gaps, and schedule realities early and transparently.
  • Champion adoption. Partner with users and domain experts on onboarding, feedback loops and change management.
  • Work across a global team. Coordinate delivery with teammates in multiple locations, and keep work moving across time zones.
  • Go deep on technical problems. Dig into complex issues to understand root causes, evaluate trade-offs, and propose solutions. Understand the product's architecture, integration points and future scalability needs well enough to spot risks early.
  • Improve how we deliver. Design and champion delivery practices, frameworks and governance that make delivery more predictable and reduce overhead across teams, not just your own.
  • Move between products as priorities shift. Ramp up quickly on new domains, teams and technologies.
  • Model our culture. Think like a founder, move fast and learn faster, start with the user, win together, and always do the right thing.
  • Run delivery AI-first
  • Use AI to build and maintain plans, work breakdowns and dependency maps, and to adjust timelines as conditions change.
  • Use project data and AI to spot risks, bottlenecks and schedule slips before they affect delivery.
  • Automate administrative work (meeting notes, action items, Jira updates and progress summaries) so your time goes to stakeholders, decisions and outcomes.
  • Use AI to run what-if scenarios on scope, resources and trade-offs.
  • Apply judgment to everything AI produces, and make sure AI use is transparent, secure and ethical.

You'll have...

  • A bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years in technical program management, delivery management, or a similar role delivering software products or platforms.
  • Experience taking products toward production and real user adoption.
  • A proven ability to lead through influence: aligning engineers, stakeholders and leaders without formal authority.
  • Strong command of agile delivery (Scrum/Kanban and portfolio-level planning) and Jira.
  • Experience managing complex integrations and dependencies across multiple teams and legacy systems.
  • Enough technical depth to engage credibly with engineers on architecture, data flows, APIs, cloud platforms and AI/ML trade-offs, and the ability to quickly learn any technology well enough to evaluate proposed solutions and raise risks.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your own program management work.
  • Ability to learn new domains quickly and become credible with subject-matter experts.
  • Strong knowledge of change management principles.
  • Clear, candid communication with both engineers and senior leadership.
  • A bias for action: you create clarity and move forward without waiting for direction.

Even better, you may have...

  • Experience delivering AI/ML-enabled products or engineering tools for technical users
  • Automotive product development experience: vehicle configuration, bills of materials and parts data, cost engineering, or complexity reduction
  • Experience with resource planning or capacity modeling
  • Experience in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments
  • User adoption experience
  • Experience working in a global team across time zones

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

  • Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
  • Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
  • Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more

description:
Job Title: Del Dia Studio Production Coordinator

Job Level: Entry-Level

Job Type: Full-Time, Non-Exempt

Job Compensation: $20.40/hour

About Cotopaxi:
We make adventure travel gear to empower people to see the world and make it better. As a Certified B Corporation, our Gear for GoodⓇ promise drives everything we do - from ethical and sustainable sourcing to products built to last and create lasting change. Through the Cotopaxi Foundation, we dedicate 1% of our revenue to nonprofits that fight poverty and support communities in need. Cotopaxi is looking for a creative, technically curious, and highly organized Del Día Choice Production Coordinator to help bring our one-of-a-kind Del Día products to life online. This hands-on role sits at the intersection of studio photography, emerging technology, and eCommerce, creating high-quality, catalog-ready product imagery through a combination of traditional photography, technology-powered rendering, and image-generation tools.

You’ll work within established production workflows while also helping us test new tools, refine processes, and find smarter ways to create accurate, consistent, and brand-right imagery at scale. The ideal candidate has a strong visual eye, enjoys experimenting with technology, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-volume environment where creative problem-solving and operational precision go hand in hand. This is an in-person role based at Cotopaxi’s Distribution Center, five days per week.

Job Responsibilities (How You’ll Make An Impact):

  • Create high-quality, catalog-ready Del Día Choice product imagery using traditional photography, technology-powered rendering, and image-generation tools.
  • Capture source photography and product references, including product setup, lighting, tethered capture, and standardized compositions.
  • Develop, test, and refine technology-assisted image workflows, including prompt development, source-image preparation, editing, and output validation.
  • Review and edit photographed and rendered assets to ensure product accuracy, color fidelity, construction details, realism, and brand consistency.
  • Follow established production workflows, style guides, quality standards, and file-management practices to prepare accurate assets for publication.

  • Collaborate with eCommerce, Creative, Merchandising, and Distribution Center teams to improve product imagery and scale Del Día Choice production.

The Ideal Candidate (What You’ll Bring to the Role):

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; degree or formal education in photography, digital media, graphic design, or a related field preferred.

  • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop and Lightroom, and comfort working in a macOS environment.
  • Familiarity with DSLR or mirrorless cameras, studio lighting, and tethered photography.
  • Experience with technology-powered image generation, product rendering, or AI-assisted editing is a plus; demonstrated curiosity and aptitude for quickly learning emerging tools is equally important.
  • Comfort experimenting with new technology, testing workflows, and working through ambiguity while maintaining high standards for quality and accuracy.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work toward production, quality, and turnaround goals.
  • A process-oriented mindset with the ability to identify inefficiencies, troubleshoot challenges, and develop repeatable workflows and documentation.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across eCommerce, Creative, Merchandising, and Distribution Center teams.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and work on-site at Cotopaxi’s Distribution Center five days per week.

Job Benefits (Your Perks):

At Cotopaxi, we care deeply about our people. Our team is at the heart of everything we do, and we’re proud to invest in their growth, well-being, and success. We prioritize fair wages, meaningful benefits, and an employee experience that supports balance, belonging, and purpose - inside and outside of work.

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits with HSA, FSA, and DCSA options.
  • Company-paid basic life insurance with the option to purchase additional coverage.
  • Voluntary short-term and long-term disability coverage.
  • Voluntary accident and critical illness insurance.
  • Company-paid employee assistance program.

Wellness Benefits:

  • Company-paid volunteer time.
  • 401(k) plan with employer match.
  • Paid time off, sick time, and company holidays.

Uniquely Us:

  • Enjoy deep product discounts with 60% off Cotopaxi gear - perfect for living out your next adventure in style.
  • Gear up for the outdoors with exclusive discounts from partner outdoor and lifestyle brands.
  • Grow personally and professionally through thoughtfully curated learning and development opportunities.
  • Stay connected and celebrate often with regular in-person and virtual events that bring our team together, no matter where you work.
  • Be part of a vibrant, values-driven culture that champions purpose, performance, and belonging in everything we do.

Please note, our hiring ranges are determined and built from market pay data. In determining the specific compensation for this position, we comply with all local, state, and federal laws.

We’re on a mission to Do Good - for people and the planet - and we know that starts with our team. Cotopaxi is proud to be a brand that celebrates every person for who they are and what they bring to the table. No matter your background, age, race, gender, ability, or faith - you belong here.

You don’t have to come from the outdoor industry to make an impact with us. We value curiosity, compassion, and the courage to collaborate openly. So tell us your story - how your journey has shaped you and how you’d like to help Cotopaxi Do Good. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: ASIC Design Engineer (Silicon Engineering)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

ASIC DESIGN ENGINEER (SILICON ENGINEERING)

At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.

We are seeking a motivated, proactive, and intellectually curious engineer who will work alongside world-class cross-disciplinary teams (systems, firmware, architecture, design, validation, product engineering, ASIC implementation). In this role, you will be developing cutting-edge next-generation FPGAs and ASICs for deployment in space and ground infrastructures around the globe. These chips are enabling connectivity in places it has previously not been available, affordable or reliable. Your efforts will help deliver cutting-edge solutions that will expand the performance and capabilities of the Starlink network.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design ASICs and/or FPGAs for Starlink projects, implementing complex SoC blocks and SoC integration tasks using Verilog/System Verilog
  • Optimize designs for power, performance and area
  • Participate in the full ASIC/FPGA design lifecycle for Starlink projects, from high-level conceptual and architectural discussions through microarchitecture, design partitioning, and collaboration with backend/implementation teams, and assist in lab bring-up and validation
  • Contribute to continual improvements to our designs by building physical and digital tools to analyze data collected on orbit and in the lab
  • Engage in high-level architectural design for test systems to support FPGA/ASIC validation, generational interoperability, and integration with DSP/communications subsystems for comprehensive lab and on-orbit verification
  • Collaborate with software engineers in developing production software for your designs

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or Physics
  • 1+ years of experience in RTL Design using SystemVerilog, Verilog or VHDL

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • ASIC/FPGA system integration experience
  • Proficiency in Python, C/C++, and Bash
  • Experience in designing DSP, digital communication system datapath blocks, and/or modem design
  • Experience with EDA tools such as HDL simulators (e.g. VCS, Questa, IES), HDL Lint tools (e.g. Spyglass), FPGA tools (e.g. Xilinx Vivado, Altera Quartus II)
  • Experience and understanding of AXI/AHB/APB protocols
  • Strong foundation in electrical engineering fundamentals
  • Experience debugging complex PCBs containing Microprocessors and FPGAs in the lab using equipment such as oscilloscopes and spectrum analyzers
  • Ability to work in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements
  • Team-player, can-do attitude and ability to work well in a group environment while still contributing on an individual basis
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a highly cross-functional role
  • Enjoys being challenged and learning new skills
  • Master’s in Electrical/Computer Engineering or related field

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission critical deadlines
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $135,000.00 - $175,000.00
Level 2: $155,000.00 - $210,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

title: Vice President, Field Operations
description:
About Jetson

Jetson is on a mission to accelerate the transition of 100 million homes across North America away from fossil fuels toward sustainable energy use. We believe in a future that is 100% electric and 100% better.

Homes are one of the largest sources of carbon emissions, yet adoption of solutions like heat pumps remains slow due to cost and complexity. Jetson is solving this by building the first fully vertically integrated home electrification company — making clean energy simple, transparent, and affordable.

We rely heavily on technology, automation, and data to scale this impact. At Jetson, we value people who are excellent at their craft, curious about new tools (including AI), and motivated to continuously improve how work gets done.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for an extremely motivated and passionate field operations leader interested in being part of a new, exciting organization fighting climate change by disrupting the residential home services industry.

The Vice President of Field Operations will be responsible for the safe, high-quality and profitable delivery of every heat pump, heat pump water heater and EV charger installation Jetson performs across Canada and the United States. This role leads the General Managers who run each branch, and through them the Field Operations Managers, Field Supervisors, lead installers, electricians and service technicians who are the face of Jetson in our customers’ homes. The VP of Field Operations will set the organizational structure, standards and operating rhythm for field teams in Colorado, British Columbia, Massachusetts, New York and California, and will scale that model into new markets as Jetson grows.

What You Will Do:

  • Develop and execute the field operations strategy to deliver installation volume, quality and margin targets across every market in Canada and the United States.
  • Lead, coach and hold accountable the General Managers who run each branch, ensuring every branch hits its KPIs for installs, revenue, NPS, safety and crew compliance.
  • Define the field organizational structure and roles, including General Managers, Field Operations Managers, Field Supervisors, lead installers, electricians and service technicians, and build a bench of leaders ready for new markets.
  • Own installation quality and first-time-right performance, setting Jetson installation standards and driving down callbacks, rework and warranty cost.
  • Champion a safety-first culture, owning the Jetson Health & Safety program, incident reporting and investigation, and compliance with OSHA, WorkSafeBC and local regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure field teams meet licensing, permitting and inspection requirements in every jurisdiction, including municipality-level permitting where no statewide framework exists.
  • Drive crew productivity and capacity planning, balancing in-house crews and subcontractor partners to meet demand without sacrificing quality or customer experience.
  • Partner closely with the VP of Customer & Service Operations to align scheduling, system design, project coordination and technical service with field throughput, so every job is ready to install and every install closes out cleanly.
  • Own the field technology stack, including Zuper, in partnership with Customer Operations and Systems, to improve dispatch, job checklists, commissioning and real-time job visibility.
  • Lead fleet, tools, uniforms and warehouse operations in partnership with Supply Chain, ensuring crews are equipped, stocked and on brand.
  • Build and run recruiting, onboarding, training and leveling programs for field roles, including installer certification and apprenticeship pathways, with People Operations.
  • Lead new market launches in partnership with the Expansion team, standing up branches, hiring local leadership and bringing them to steady-state performance.
  • Develop and manage field operating budgets and branch P&Ls, driving labour efficiency, materials cost control and installation margin.
  • Define, report and act on field KPIs, providing clear performance visibility to the executive team.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Construction Management, Engineering or a related field (MBA preferred), or equivalent field leadership experience.
  • 10+ years of field operations experience in residential HVAC, home services, solar, electrical or construction, including 5+ years leading multi-branch or multi-market operations.
  • Experience taking a field operation from startup to scale up across geographically dispersed locations.
  • Proven experience leading General Managers and large field teams across the United States and Canada, including a mix of in-house crews and subcontractors.
  • Deep working knowledge of heat pump and HVAC installation, electrical scopes, permitting and inspections.
  • A strong safety record and experience building safety programs and culture in a field environment.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets, branch P&Ls, labour productivity and cost-control measures.
  • Experience with field service management and dispatch platforms such as Zuper or ServiceTitan, and CRM platforms such as HubSpot.
  • Ability to analyze data and make informed decisions to drive operational excellence.
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness to travel frequently across the U.S. and Canada as needed.

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: $190,000 - $220,000 per annum

Benefits:

Dental Care, Vision Care & Life Insurance premiums fully paid by Jetson

Health Insurance premium 85% paid by Jetson

Education Support

Parental Leave Top Up

Equity

401k program

Work Location: Remote in the USA

Do you feel like you don't have everything that's listed above but can still do the job? If you have the core skills and experience that we're looking for and are willing to use your talent to learn the rest, we encourage you to apply!

title: Guest Experience Scheduling Coordinator (Part-Time)
description:
About Hollywood Park

Hollywood Park, a near 300-acre sports and entertainment destination, is being developed by Los Angeles Rams Owner/Chairman E. Stanley Kroenke with the 70,000-seat SoFi Stadium as its centerpiece. Hollywood Park is the largest urban mixed-use mega development under construction in the Western United States. When complete, Hollywood Park will have up to 2,500 residences, a hotel, a retail district reaching up to 890,000 square feet, up to 5 million square feet of office space, and more than 25-acres of public parks and open space.

Home to the Los Angeles Chargers and Super Bowl LVI Champion Los Angeles Rams, SoFi Stadium is the host of world-renowned sporting events, including Super Bowl LVI in 2022, College Football Playoff National Championship game 2023, WrestleMania 2023, World Cup 2026, and the Opening and Closing Ceremonies of the Olympics in 2028. Adjacent to the stadium and under the same roof canopy is a 2.5-acre open-air plaza, American Airlines Plaza, and the 6,000-seat YouTube Theater. YouTube Theater is an intimate venue, making it the perfect place for concerts, comedy, awards shows, esports competitions, community gatherings, conferences and more.

Culture

Hollywood Park is being brought to life by a deeply experienced team of creative forward-thinkers. The project is a celebration of all that Los Angeles has to offer. We are inspired by our diverse Inglewood community as a place for the community to be, to see and to connect.

Hollywood Park is committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our team members, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

At the heart of Hollywood Park, lies our dedication to our purpose, promise, and commitments. Our PURPOSE is creating extraordinary experiences, one moment at a time. Our PROMISE is to be an iconic destination that celebrates our diverse and vibrant community. We promise to exceed expectations while cultivating a fun and safe experience where lasting memories are made. Our COMMITMENTS are outlined by S.T.A.R.S.

Our S.T.A.R.S. commitments are enabled by five foundational principles:

Start with Care – create a lasting impact through genuine care

Thrive as a Team – create an environment of collaboration and encouragement

Anticipate Unspoken Needs – be proactive in delivering extraordinary service and support others

Resolve with Respect – treat others with empathy, patience, and kindness

Safety Always – maintain a safe and secure environment


As the Scheduling Coordinator (Part-time), You Will
Report to the Guest Experience Scheduling Manager, you will provide frontline scheduling and administrative support for the Guest Experience (GX) department at SoFi Stadium and Hollywood Park. This role will focus on scheduling, timekeeping, administration, and employee communication to ensure events are properly covered. You will play a key role in resolving routine scheduling matters, maintaining schedules, and supporting event-day operations.


More Specific Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To
  • Assist with event-day scheduling for SoFi Stadium and Hollywood Park, ensuring all zones are filled and operational needs are met before doors open.
  • Monitor GX scheduling email account and update management on staffing trends for upcoming events.
  • Maintain a constant presence throughout the stadium to conduct zone audits, verifying that staff are in position and aligned with the master schedule.
  • Manage the staff check-in and check-out process, including uniform inspections and station assignments.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for frontline staff to resolve immediate scheduling issues and inquiries, and technical login issues in real time.
  • Use ABI MasterMind to track employee availability, process time-off requests, and maintain accurate scheduling records.
  • Proactively monitor timekeeping to ensure all event-day staff strictly adhere to California meal-break and rest-period requirements.
  • Track and report staff attendance and punctuality in real-time, escalating gaps to the Guest Experience Scheduling Manager to maintain service standards.
  • Assist with post-event labor summaries to identify "bottleneck" areas, recommending staff reassignments to improve efficiency and optimize staff coverage for future events.

  • 1–3 years of experience in guest services, hospitality, or a customer-facing leadership role.
  • Strong presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Preferred
  • Experience in large venues such as stadiums, arenas, theme parks, or hospitality environments.
  • Previous experience in scheduling and timekeeping, ABI MasterMind and Paycor.
  • Bilingual or multilingual skills are a plus.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Strong organization and time-management skills.

  • High Level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

title: Engineering Co-op
description:
Engineering Co-op

About Us

Salient Motion is building a modular motion and actuation platform that is redefining how aerospace, defense, and industrial systems are designed, built, and deployed. We move fast, operate with high ownership, and expect real contribution from every member of the team. Co-ops are treated like engineers, not observers. You will own real work, ship to production hardware, and leave with a body of work you can point to.

Role Overview

As an Engineering Co-op, you will embed with our engineering team across mechanical, electrical, software, manufacturing, and systems-level work for six months or longer. Unlike a short summer internship, this role is designed for students who want to take a project from specification through qualification, see a full product cycle, and operate as a contributing member of the team.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced startup environment. You will be expected to ramp quickly, take ownership of a defined workstream, and ship work that goes into customer programs.

What You Will Do

  • Own a scoped engineering workstream from design through test and release, with support from a senior engineer
  • Design, build, and test electro-mechanical systems and subassemblies on active customer programs
  • Build, maintain and improve test fixtures, data collection infrastructures
  • Firmware bring-up, design validation tests for electronics boards
  • Lead prototyping, assembly, and hands-on lab and shop work
  • Plan and execute engineering tests, collect data, and present results to the team
  • Drive manufacturing and supplier activities including part preparation, first-article inspection, and validation
  • Build and improve engineering and documentation processes that outlast your co-op term
  • Partner with senior engineers and program leaders, and present progress in design and program reviews

What We Are Looking For

  • Enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field, with the ability to commit to a minimum 6-month co-op rotation
  • Available for a full-time term, whether a full academic semester, summer plus a connecting semester, or two consecutive semesters
  • Strong curiosity and willingness to work across disciplines
  • Comfortable in a lab or shop environment with hardware and tools
  • Clear communicator who can document work, present results, and ask thoughtful questions
  • Prior hands-on experience through projects, labs, clubs, personal builds, or a previous internship or co-op is a strong plus

What You Will Gain

  • Ownership of real production-bound hardware over a long enough window to see it ship
  • Exposure to aerospace and defense engineering standards and practices through a full program cycle
  • Mentorship from experienced engineers and direct access to founders and program leadership
  • A portfolio of shipped work and a reference from a startup that moved on your contributions
  • Co-ops completing 9+ months in good standing are evaluated for a full-time return offer at graduation

Co-op Details

  • Full-time, paid co-op, with pay tiered by commitment length:
    • 6-month rotation: $28 to $34/hr
    • 9 to 12 month rotation: $34 to $40/hr
  • Minimum 6-month commitment; 9 to 12 month rotations preferred
  • Start dates flexible to align with your school's co-op calendar. Common cadences include January to June, July to December, and July to June for full-year rotations
  • Onsite in Torrance, CA; relocation support includes a $1,200/month housing stipend for students relocating more than 50 miles

title: PMO Master Scheduler
description:
Change the world. Love your job.

The Design & Construction (D&C) PMO (Project Management Office) is actively seeking a PMO Master Scheduler to join our team. The Master Scheduler will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and overseeing comprehensive project schedules for the PMO Major Construction Team. This role ensures that all construction projects are planned, tracked, and executed efficiently to meet deadlines, budgets, and quality standards. The Master Scheduler will collaborate with project managers, contractors, and stakeholders to align schedules, mitigate risks, and optimize resource allocation. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proficient in predictive scheduling, Earned Schedule (ES) and experienced in large construction projects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and Maintain Schedules: Create and maintain owner controlled integrated master schedules using tools like Primavera P6, OPC, Microsoft Project, or equivalent software, ensuring alignment with project objectives, and milestones.
  • Create detailed work breakdown structures (WBS): Work with project team to develop a project WBS for project control systems to guide scheduling and monitoring.
  • OFCI Tracking: Integrate timelines with supply chain and procurement teams to ensure timely delivery of materials and equipment.
  • Resource Planning: Coordinate with project managers to allocate resources effectively, including labor, equipment, and materials, to avoid bottlenecks and ensure project progress.
  • Predictive Scheduling: Forecast major milestone, identify bottlenecks and proposing strategies to prevent delays.
  • Critical Path Analysis: Identify and monitor critical path activities, proactively addressing potential delays and proposing mitigation strategies.
  • Earned Schedule (ES): Link cost baselines to planned milestones in order to transform EVM metrics into duration-based forecasts for an improved schedule performance evaluation of critical path activities
  • Schedule Performance Index (SPI): Measure progress with objective indicators of schedule against earned value metrics or order to enable proactive risk management
  • Risk Management: Identify scheduling risks and constraints, collaborating with the project team to develop contingency plans and solutions.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with project managers, contractors, vendors, and clients to ensure schedule alignment and clear communication of timelines and dependencies.
  • Change Management: Evaluate the impact of scope changes, delays, or resource constraints on schedules and adjust plans accordingly.
  • Process Improvement: Contribute to the development of scheduling best practices, templates, and governance tools to enhance PMO efficiency and standardization.
  • Compliance & Documentation: Ensure schedules comply with contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and company standards. Maintain accurate documentation for audits and reviews.
  • Progress Tracking & Reporting: Track project progress, update schedules in real-time, and generate regular reports (e.g., Gantt charts, milestone reports) thru dashboards for stakeholders and leadership.
  • Support decision-making by providing consistent, verifiable data for reports
  • Owns and oversees the implementation and use of Generative Scheduling tools across all the construction projects

Texas Instruments will not sponsor job applicants for visas or work authorization for this position.

Minimum requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field
  • 5 years of project scheduling experience with 2 years of construction project management experience
  • Experience managing complex, multi-phase construction projects
  • Experience with workforce planning, resource allocation, and budget integration
  • Experience with Earned Value Management and schedule risk analysis
  • Experience integrating subcontractor and vendor schedules into a master schedule

Preferred requirements

  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6, OPC, Microsoft Project, Acumen or equivalent scheduling software
  • Knowledge of CPM, sequencing, resource allocation, project controls, and construction methodologies
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Semiconductor industry experience
  • Experience with generative scheduling tools such as ALICE
  • PMP, PMI-SP, or equivalent certification
  • Knowledge of Advanced Work Packages and other execution strategies
  • Familiarity with lean construction principles or agile project management

description:
Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, AI/ML & Analytics

Full-time

National Capital Region

Unknown

Negotiable

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.

As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on an end-to-end data analytics and mlops solution composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on workflow, ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. Your team will own a solution from the analytics and machine learning space, and integrate with the solutions from other teams to build the world's best end-to-end data platform. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.

We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.

Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hourse! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.

  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Additional Skills That Would Be Nice To Have

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.

  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

title: Sr. ASIC Design Engineer (Silicon Engineering)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. RTL DESIGN ENGINEER (SILICON ENGINEERING)

At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.

We are seeking a motivated, proactive, and intellectually curious engineer who will work alongside world-class cross-disciplinary teams (systems, firmware, architecture, design, validation, product engineering, ASIC implementation). In this role, you will be developing cutting-edge next-generation ASICs for deployment in space and ground infrastructures around the globe. These chips are enabling connectivity in places it has previously not been available, affordable or reliable. Your efforts will help deliver cutting-edge solutions that will expand the performance and capabilities of the Starlink network.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Evaluate architectural trade-offs based on features, performance requirements and system limitations
  • Define micro-architecture, implement the RTL in Verilog/System Verilog, integrate that in top level and deliver the fully verified, synthesis/timing clean design
  • Work closely with verification team to ensure all aspects of the design are covered and verified
  • Provide timing constraint for those IPs and support the physical implementation team (synthesis, timing closure, formality check)
  • Participate in silicon bring-up and validation

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or computer science
  • 5+ years of experience in RTL implementation

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Ability to solve complex problems including clock domain crossings and power optimization
  • ASIC/SoC system integration experience
  • Experience with embedded CPU subsystems
  • Experience with standard bus protocols (e.g. AXI, AHB, etc.)
  • Experience with high speed and low power design techniques
  • Scripting skills (e.g. Python, etc.)
  • Experience with EDA tools such as HDL simulators and HDL Lint tools
  • Team-player, can-do attitude and ability to work well in a group environment while still contributing on an individual basis
  • Enjoys being challenged and learning new skills

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission critical deadlines
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 3: $175,000.00 - $280,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. title: Software Engineer, Core Systems
description:
The future of defense will be decided by those who field intelligent machines at scale. At Scout AI, we’re developing Fury, the first robotic foundation model for defense, to give U.S. forces overwhelming, adaptable, and autonomous power across every domain. Fury enables human operators to command fleets of robots through natural language, and empowers those machines to sense, decide, and act together as one. This mission will ask everything of us: urgency, precision, and relentless work.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who treats the code itself as the product. You’ll join the core software team at Scout AI and work across the systems Fury runs on: the onboard C++ code and core libraries, the cloud infrastructure that trains and evaluates the model, and the simulation and evals framework that tells us whether any of it works.

A lot of this job is hardening. As our platform rapidly scales, our senior engineers actively drive architectural stewardship - continually refining abstractions, hardening core systems, and evolving our software foundation to support our accelerated growth. We want someone who can take that on: read a large codebase, understand it, spot the anti-patterns, and restructure it well.

The same person should be comfortable building the test and validation systems that let the rest of the team move faster. We aren’t hiring for one narrow specialty. Depending on where you’re strongest, you might spend most of your time onboard C++, in GPU job infrastructure and cloud services, or in simulation and evaluation tooling.
