title: Resident Liaison/Leasing Agent (Spartanburg)
description:
RESIDENT LIAISON / LEASING AGENT · GREENVILLE AND SPARTANBURG, SC · FULL-TIME

Fill homes. Earn more.

$20 to $24 an hour, plus commission on every lease you sign.

The more people you help move in, the more you make. Full-year agents are on pace for about $44K to $64K this year, commission included.

Sounds too good to be true?

Fair question. Here's who you'd be joining. NOAH Property Management has been in Greenville for more than three years and takes care of about 3,000 apartment units across the Upstate. You'd join a team of leasing agents who answer fast and tell people the truth.

Why this role matters at NOAH

You're the first person a new resident meets. Some of them have been turned down somewhere else. NOAH doesn't use credit scores to decide who gets a home, so you get to say "yes" more often than most leasing agents ever do. You help someone find a safe, fair place to live, and you treat them with respect from the first call.

How you'll work

  • People First. Always. Every caller is a person looking for a home, not a lead.
  • One NOAH. One Standard. Every prospect gets the same honest answer at every community.
  • Turn no's into "yes, and." If one home doesn't fit, you find the one that does.
  • Always growing and raising the bar. You learn our communities, our programs and your numbers.
  • Every voice matters. You listen first, then help.
  • Second chances create new possibilities. Someone's past doesn't decide their next home.

From the team

"I felt proud when I helped a Spanish-speaking resident who was overwhelmed during move-in. I walked them through every step in Spanish until they felt at ease. By the end, they were smiling and laughing. NOAH creates safe, welcoming communities where both residents and employees can grow. It's a place where people feel at home and supported."

Marcela Lopez, NOAH team member

Who you are

  • You like people, and people like talking to you.
  • You follow up. Every call, text and email gets an answer.
  • Leasing or sales experience helps. We'll train you on the rest. Speaking Spanish is a plus, so you can help people in the language they prefer.

What you'll do

  • Answer calls, texts and emails fast, and give tours of open homes.
  • Walk people through the application, the lease and move-in.
  • Keep homes ready to show, post listings online and on social media, and keep your records current in Entrata.

What you need

  • High school diploma or equivalent. An associate's or bachelor's degree is a plus.
  • A valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
  • Comfort on a computer and phone all day. Entrata experience is a plus.
  • Leasing or sales experience is strongly preferred.

Benefits

Medical, dental and vision · 401(k) with company match · Paid time off and holidays · Employee assistance program · Professional development

If you want a job where helping people is how you get paid, apply.

Apply at noahpm.com/careers. NOAH Property Management is an equal opportunity employer.

VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL

ENLACE CON RESIDENTES / AGENTE DE ARRENDAMIENTO · GREENVILLE Y SPARTANBURG, SC · TIEMPO COMPLETO

Llena viviendas. Gana más.

$20 a $24 por hora, más comisión por cada contrato de arrendamiento que firmes.

Mientras más personas ayudes a mudarse, más ganas. Los agentes con un año completo van en camino a ganar unos $44K a $64K este año, con la comisión incluida.

¿Suena demasiado bueno para ser verdad?

Es una pregunta justa. Así es el equipo al que te unirías. NOAH Property Management lleva más de tres años en Greenville y cuida cerca de 3,000 apartamentos en la región Upstate. Te unirías a un equipo de agentes de arrendamiento que responden rápido y le dicen la verdad a la gente.

Por qué este puesto importa en NOAH

Eres la primera persona que conoce un nuevo residente. A algunos los han rechazado en otros lugares. NOAH no usa el puntaje de crédito para decidir quién recibe una vivienda, así que puedes decir «sí» más seguido que la mayoría de los agentes de arrendamiento. Ayudas a alguien a encontrar un lugar seguro y justo para vivir, y lo tratas con respeto desde la primera llamada.

Cómo vas a trabajar

  • Las personas primero. Siempre. Cada persona que llama busca un hogar. No es solo un cliente potencial.
  • Un NOAH. Un estándar. Cada posible residente recibe la misma respuesta honesta en todas las comunidades.
  • Convierte los «no» en «sí, y además». Si una vivienda no le queda bien a alguien, encuentras la que sí.
  • Siempre creciendo y subiendo el nivel. Aprendes sobre nuestras comunidades, nuestros programas y tus números.
  • Cada voz importa. Primero escuchas, luego ayudas.
  • Las segundas oportunidades crean nuevas posibilidades. El pasado de una persona no decide cuál será su próximo hogar.

Del equipo

«Me sentí orgullosa cuando ayudé a un residente de habla hispana que estaba abrumado durante su mudanza. Lo acompañé en cada paso en español hasta que se sintió tranquilo. Al final, estaba sonriendo y riéndose. NOAH crea comunidades seguras y acogedoras donde tanto los residentes como los empleados pueden crecer. Es un lugar donde la gente se siente en casa y con apoyo.»

Marcela Lopez, equipo de NOAH (traducido del inglés)

Quién eres

  • Te gusta la gente, y a la gente le gusta hablar contigo.

Qué vas a hacer

Beneficios

Seguro médico, dental y de la vista · 401(k) con aportación de la compañía · Tiempo libre pagado y días feriados · Programa de asistencia al empleado · Desarrollo profesional

Si quieres un trabajo donde te pagan por ayudar a la gente, aplica.

Aplica en noahpm.com/careers. NOAH Property Management es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades.

title: Developer Relations
description:
About Liquid AI

Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across deployment targets, from data center accelerators to on-device hardware, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there.

The Opportunity

Developers do not yet grasp what a fine-tuned small model can do until they see one running on a phone, in a browser, or on a Jetson board. Closing that imagination gap is the job.

You will be Liquid's technical voice where builders already are -- Hugging Face, GitHub, Discord, and the developer events that matter for edge AI -- turning individual troubleshooting sessions on chat templates, quantization, and on-device deployment into cookbooks, reference apps, and content the whole community can use.

This is a hands-on developer relations role focused on building, writing, and engaging publicly. You will ship reference applications and technical resources, communicate regularly with developers across editorial and community channels, and help establish a credible, consistent developer voice for Liquid.

Sitting within Marketing & Communications, you will work closely with our model, platform, and product teams. Technical teams will partner on accuracy, while you will own how the work is explained, presented, and adapted for developer audiences.

What We're Looking For

We need someone who is a:

  • Builder: You would rather ship a working reference app than write a strategy memo, and you measure yourself by what developers actually adopt.

  • Community native: You enjoy answering hard questions in public, you are comfortable being wrong in front of people, and you know the small-model and edge-AI ecosystem well enough to have real opinions.

  • Full-range writer: You move fluidly between a quick answer on Discord, a step-by-step cookbook, and a long-form technical post without losing accuracy or voice.

  • In-person energizer: Hackathons, workshops, hallway-track demos, and the conferences where builders actually show up are where you do your best work.

  • End-to-end owner: You take ownership in ambiguity and turn one-off problems into reusable resources without being asked.

  • Exceptional public technical communicator: You can turn complex technical work into clear, accurate, compelling writing, talks, demos, and tutorials. You communicate with a distinct human voice, benchmark fairly, avoid hype, and know how to earn the trust of a skeptical technical audience.

The Work

  • Be the technical voice in the community. Live where LFM developers already are — Hugging Face, GitHub, Discord, X. Answer hard questions in public, maintain Liquid's presence on the Hub, and amplify the community fine-tunes and edge deployments worth seeing.

  • Show up in person. Host hackathons, build nights, and technical workshops at Liquid offices and partner venues. Represent Liquid at the conferences and developer events that matter for small-model and edge AI — submitting talks, running booths, and demoing in the hallway track. Partner with hackathon organizers to make LFMs the obvious choice for builders who care about latency, on-device, or cost.

  • Build the on-device and adaptation story. Ship reference applications that demonstrate LFMs on real edge hardware (iOS, Android, browser, Jetson, NPUs). Maintain integration recipes for the inference stacks developers use (llama.cpp, MLX, ONNX, executorch, LEAP SDK). Write cookbooks that take a developer from base model to fine-tuned, quantized, deployed in one sitting.

  • Create content that earns trust. Deeply technical blog posts, demos, and honest benchmarks against Qwen, Gemma, Phi, and SmolLM. First-principles, concrete, no LLM slop. Turn the best in-person workshop material into evergreen content so the in-room audience compounds online.

  • Close the loop. Maintain a friction log of developer pain points — chat templates, tokenizers, deployment gotchas — and bring the signal into roadmap conversations with the model and platform teams.

Desired Experience

Must-have:

  • Proven technical expertise: hands-on experience with LLMs, including model fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, full fine-tuning, distillation), tokenizer debugging, and a track record of shipping to production or active community environments

  • Fluency with the modern AI stack: deep familiarity with PyTorch, Hugging Face (Transformers, PEFT, Datasets), and model serving frameworks (llama.cpp, MLX, vLLM, ONNX Runtime, or TGI), alongside an understanding of quantization tradeoffs (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ, INT8/INT4)

  • Efficient model specialization: experience with on-device deployment (iOS, Android, embedded) or specialized work within the efficient-model ecosystem (Phi, Gemma, Qwen, SmolLM, or distilled architectures)

  • Demonstrated experience in developer relations, developer advocacy, or community engineering, including direct responsibility for engaging and supporting developers publicly.

  • A strong portfolio of public technical communication, such as technical articles, tutorials, cookbooks, talks, videos, workshops, or open-source educational content, that demonstrates accuracy, clarity, judgment, and an authentic voice.

  • Strong technical writing and editing skills, with the ability to turn complex model, tooling, and deployment concepts into content that developers can understand and act on.

Nice-to-have:

  • Active open-source contributions, especially to the inference or efficient-model tooling ecosystem (llama.cpp, MLX, ONNX, Hugging Face libraries)

  • Experience organizing or running hackathons, workshops, or developer events

What Success Looks Like (Year One)

  • The LFM quickstart on Hugging Face is the cleanest path to production in the small-model ecosystem, with measurable lift in fine-tunes, downloads, and downstream Spaces.

  • A library of on-device reference apps, at least one each on iOS, Android, and an embedded target, that external developers fork, extend, and ship.

  • A regular cadence of in-person events (LFM hackathons, edge-AI build nights, technical workshops) that the developer community shows up for, with measurable community growth as a result.

  • A working developer-friction feedback loop: pain points are surfaced and fixed, OSS contributions land, talks get accepted, and inbound developer interest grows.

What We Offer

  • Build the function: You are defining how Liquid goes to market technically, with direct influence on product direction and access to the founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive base salary with equity in a unicorn-stage company

  • Health: We pay 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees and dependents

  • Financial: 401(k) matching up to 4% of base pay

  • Time Off: Unlimited PTO plus company-wide Refill Days throughout the year

title: Ford Racing PVT Engineer
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

Racing is where our story began.

In 1901, Henry Ford climbed into a car he built himself—"Sweepstakes"—and beat America's most famous driver. He wasn't a racer, but he had to win. He did. Ford Motor Company was born from that victory.

That fighting spirit lives on in Ford Racing today. We're the engineers, strategists, and competitors who bring Ford's track-tested edge into every vehicle we build. Every track, every stage, every proving ground—that's where we prove ourselves.

The result: one of the world's most iconic brands, legendary nameplates, and a team unmatched in the industry.

Our mantra: Race to win, engineer to lead.

If you're a competitor, innovator, or performance obsessive, Ford Racing is where you belong. Help us write the next chapter.

In this position...

  • Manage the quality of the F-150 Raptor to meet the customer requirements with cross-functional team of Dearborn Truck Plant team members, Ford Racing Engineers and the Supplier Partners.
  • You will use data driving methods to problem solve issues as they arise to deliver a high-quality F-150 Raptor and Raptor R.

What you'll do...

  • Lead daily claims report for both Ford Racing and vehicle assembly plant (PVT)
  • Lead weekly Quality PAT forums along with managing R/1000 and CPU reports for a specific vehicle(s)
  • Support daily assembly plant PIC room / Whiteboard / FCPA reviews
  • Support daily GQRS and warranty claims binning, which may require interfacing with dealership technicians
  • Lead Analytical Warranty System (AWS) and Early Claims Binning (ECB) claims analysis
  • Manage IRIS/SIMPSN tickets and update system status regularly
  • Support VRT/VFG meetings on weekly basis and quality reviews (Rapid Hub, QPST, FQR, VQR, PDQR, etc)
  • Assist troubleshooting vehicles that fail in-plant testing
  • Support STA / Assembly Plant Incoming Quality with resolving plant and supplier quality issues
  • Liaison for Program Management Team (PMT) with Product Specialist /plant personnel
  • Review and drive closure of Fresh Eyes (Campaign Prevention) issues
  • Drive issue resolution with Design/Supplier/Manufacturing issues and support working level meetings/report out - JIRA
  • Manage WERS system with Concerns / Alerts and lead/support assembly trials for change verification
  • Work with Plant Quality Team and PVT to prioritize critical path changes for a vehicle program
  • Interface with Plant Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, and Manufacturing Engineering (VOME) teams to clarify and resolve manufacturing vs design issues
  • Review and manage daily audits post Mod Center Inspection

You'll have...

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • 3-5 years combined experience in Program Management, VO/Launch, PVT, Quality
  • Strong leadership skills with ability to drive a team to resolution with work plans and accountability
  • High degree of self-motivation and willingness to commit extra effort to "get the job done"
  • Candidate must be comfortable in speaking and working with Chief / Director level management
  • Candidate must be comfortable in speaking and working with Plant Line Operators through Area Managers in understanding and resolving of issues
  • Previous rotations in Ford assembly plants with the ability to thrive in fast paced environments
  • Experience in vehicle evaluation, program management, product launch or quality roles
  • Passion for Raptor and Ford Racing products
  • This position will also work at Dearborn Truck Plant (DTP)

Even better, you may have...

  • Masters Degree

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

  • Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
  • Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more

title: Backstage Captain, Hillsdale - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Selling and Support Captain, you are an advocate for the customer and a role model for your colleagues. As an elevated hourly colleague, you are an expert in customer satisfaction , merchandising, and building brand loyalty. You will drive results through promotional and Omni selling initiatives. Under the supervision of a People Leader, you will play a key role in communicating expectations and priorities to our colleagues. Advancement opportunities include Personal Stylist or Sales and Customer Experience Manager.

Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice
  • Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

What You Will Do

  • Based upon your Captain assignment you could be fulfilling customer orders, merchandising, processing new products, or supervising the selling floor in delivering exceptional customer service.
  • Lead colleagues in the execution and completion of assigned tasks.
  • As an advocate for the customer, you will role model and provide fast feedback on how to make every customer experience outstanding.
  • Ensure high-level of customer service through problem-solving and customer-focused resolutions.
  • Enhance the in-store customer experience by promoting our Macy's mobile app.
  • Meet with People Leaders throughout the day to plan and monitor total store activities.
  • Provide People Leaders continuous feedback that drives a positive customer experience and improves our processes.
  • Perform store opening and closing procedures, including accessing alarm system and settling the registers.
  • Lead and participate in the adherence to our best in class merchandise standards.
  • Educate colleagues on point of sale technology, radio frequency equipment, and applications to assist in selling and fulfillment of customer orders.
  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Proficient in communicating effectively with customers and providing clear direction to colleagues
  • Self-starter in adapting quickly to changing customer expectations and needs
  • Resourceful and able to adapt quickly to changing priorities and deadlines
  • 1-2 years of direct retail experience preferred
  • High school diploma or equivalent

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Involves standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 50lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders.
  • Reaching, including above eye level, crouching, kneeling, stooping and color vision.

title: Software Engineer
description:
As Virtuagym keeps on growing, we are now looking for a new face to complement our Development team. As aSoftware Engineer, you will be joining the team responsible for our Blue domain, which focuses on billing & payments. Will you join us in our quest to create a healthier and happier world?

Join a high performing team and make an impact!

We're a passionate, driven team with a strong focus on growth and delivering outstanding results. At Virtuagym, we cultivate a high-performance culture built on dedication, ownership and driving excellence. If you're a self-starter who embraces challenges, thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and keeps going where others might stop, this could be the perfect role for you! In return, you’ll join a team where you can grow, develop, and truly unlock your full potential.

We have a beautiful office in the center of Amsterdam and while we foster getting together to exchange ideas and energy, we are a remote-friendly company. This means that you have the freedom to work from home whenever you want, provided you keep delivering great results! At the same time we love bringing our teams together by organizing team events and company parties to brainstorm about the future of our industry and build friendships, while having fun along the way.

What this role looks like

As Software Engineer, you have a direct impact on improving the experience of more than 35+ million end-users. As a Software Engineer on Blue Domain, you'll be responsible for developing and maintaining features across our billing and payments platform. This includes refining product requirements and being one of the main contributors to the design, implementation, and testing of technical solutions that meet the needs of our customers. A successful software engineer here has a passion for technology, a strong work ethic, and confidence to work independently as well as part of a team. You'll also develop and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end testing suites for our software.

Responsibilities

  • Designing solutions that are simple, scalable, and actually make sense, not just technically correct
  • Building on our existing architecture and levelling it up with current best practices
  • Shipping features end-to-end, from technical design through to something real customers use
  • Keeping an eye on the production systems your team owns, so issues get caught early, not from a customer complaint
  • Writing docs and diagrams your teammates will genuinely reach for later
  • Speaking up early: sharing progress, asking questions before you're stuck, and asking for feedback rather than waiting for it
  • Giving code reviews that are honest, kind, and actually useful - the kind you'd want to receive yourself
  • Having a real voice in what we build next, through Sprint and Product Backlog planning
  • Pairing or mobbing with teammates when two (or more) heads genuinely beat one
  • Being someone people can tap on the shoulder for advice, and enjoying that part of the job
  • Bringing your own take on how we work, within the agile/DevOps rhythm the team has chosen

Our tech stack

  • PHP, Python, Vue.js, NodeJS
  • Kafka, ksqlDB, Kafka Connect
  • Kotlin, Swift, Objective-C
  • MariaDB, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, Redis
  • AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Vault, GitLab

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience
  • At least 2-3 years of professional experience in software development; Experience building, testing, and maintaining software systems while adhering to engineering principles such as testability, maintainability, observability, and reliability
  • Solid, hands-on production experience with PHP - this is a hard requirement for this role, experience with Python is a strong plus
  • A love for delivering high-quality, well-tested software
  • A track record of contributing to improvements in the Development Lifecycle
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with Product Management to create actionable product specifications
  • A team player who actively participates in daily rituals and contributes to the team's success, sharing knowledge with others and learning from the team in turn
  • Relevant experience with an RDBMS and Entity Relationship Diagrams
  • Experience with version control and various git workflows
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, our company language
  • Knowledge of the agile philosophy and how to implement it, like Scrum and DevOps lifecycles (plan, code, build, test, release, deploy, operate, monitor)

Bonus points if you’ll bring:

  • Experience with distributed services and event-driven applications
  • Experience working with Vue.js
  • A well-curated portfolio
  • An obsession with customer satisfaction

Important note: please do apply if you meet 80%+ of the criteria. At Virtuagym we hire great people, not just resumes. If you can't check off a few requirements but are a fast learner, we'd love to hear from you. If you have read everything carefully, please add a in the "anything you would like to add" section.

The hiring process

The hiring process for this role consists of:

  • Screening call with Recruitment
  • 1st interview with two Software Engineers in which you will show a project you’ve built and are proud of and explain why you decided to build it the way you did. Make sure to show us the parts that you’re most proud of or were hardest to get right.
  • 2nd interview with our CTO and CIO

Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. title: Supply Chain Program Manager: Inbound
description:
About the Role

Hinge Health is seeking a highly skilled Supply Chain Program Manager to join the company's Logistics team. As the Supply Chain Program Manager, Inbound, you will own the end-to-end inbound process for international products, partnering with vendors, our customs broker, logistics, and cross-functional hardware teams to keep inbound operations running smoothly.

This role is ideal for an experienced supply chain or operations program manager who enjoys solving practical problems, improving established processes, and seeing the direct impact of their work. You will manage vendor-facing programs, customs and duty workflows, commercial documentation, and invoice validation while helping Hinge Health deliver products to members on time.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Take ownership of the existing inbound process and establish clear operating rhythms, responsibilities, and escalation paths.

  • Build strong working relationships with international vendors, the customs broker, logistics partners, and Hardware Operations stakeholders.

  • Review inbound product flows, customs and duty requirements, HS-code usage, commercial documentation, and invoice-validation practices.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Factory: Code Security
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Security team, you help developers find and fix security issues. Those issues live in the code they write and in the open source components they depend on.

Your work spans complementary parts of a complete security analysis. On the dependency analysis side, you teach the analysis engine what a project depends on. You parse dependency manifests, lockfiles, and SBOMs so the engine knows which libraries and frameworks are in play and how the code uses them. You also extend the service that turns security advisories into automated merge requests that update vulnerable dependencies. On the vulnerability detection side, you grow GitLab's security analysis engine with hybrid analyzers that blend rule-based detection and AI reasoning. You build and apply the tooling that develops, evaluates, and ships those analyzers, and you measure how well they find real problems. That work also expands coverage of the libraries, frameworks, and AI agent tooling that real-world applications are built on.

These threads reinforce each other. What a project depends on, and how its code uses those dependencies, are parts of one picture, and this team works across all of it. We make thoughtful use of AI-assisted development tools in our daily work. We expect you to use them effectively and with good judgment.

What you do

  • Act as the directly responsible individual (DRI) for team initiatives from design through delivery, shipping with minimal guidance in partnership with the technical lead
  • Bring systems built by one engineer to team ownership through documentation, tests, and shared review
  • Design and ship analyzers that pair deterministic analysis capabilities with AI-driven analysis, and build the evaluation harnesses that measure their false positives and missed findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, raising the bar for what counts as a trustworthy result. That includes detection rules mapped to CWE and the test fixtures that prove they work.
  • Package those analyzers for every place GitLab runs them, including CI jobs, AI agent workflows, and command-line tools, with findings reported in GitLab's standard security report formats
  • Design and ship the manifest, lockfile, and SBOM parsing that tells the static analysis engine what a project depends on, and extend it to new ecosystems and formats
  • Ship features across the automated remediation service that turns security advisories into dependency update merge requests, from sandboxed updates to merge request creation
  • Solve technical problems of high scope and complexity, actively seek out difficult impediments affecting the whole team, and advocate for improvements to quality, security, and performance with Product Management, Engineering stakeholders such as Frontend and UX, and partner teams such as Code Scanning and Composition Analysis
  • Mentor Intermediate engineers through code review and pairing, and maintain our internal standards for style, maintainability, and best practices through review
  • Participate in on-call rotations to assist troubleshooting product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues

What you bring

  • Experience building your own LLM tooling, such as a harness, an agent pipeline, or evaluations, with the judgment to know when output is trustworthy and when it isn't
  • Substantial professional experience writing and testing production code in a systems language, particularly Go and/or Rust, with depth in at least one. We use both, plus Ruby on the remediation side and Python for some analyzers, and value willingness to work across them.
  • Familiarity with package managers and dependency management in one or more language ecosystems, such as npm, Maven, pip, Bundler, or Cargo. Experience building tooling around them is better still.
  • Demonstrated application security experience, such as vulnerability research, secure code review, or writing detection rules, and fluency with vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10, CWE) and the software supply chain
  • A track record of taking ownership of ambiguous problems and shipping with minimal guidance, with the self-motivation and organizational skills suited to a remote, largely asynchronous environment
  • Demonstrated capacity to communicate clearly and concisely about technical problems, and to write design proposals that bring a team to a decision

Helpful experience

  • Experience evaluating AI-driven detection against labeled data, including measuring false positives and missed findings
  • Experience with performance optimization at scale
  • Hands-on program analysis experience, such as parsing, ASTs, or data-flow analysis
  • Familiarity with popular web or mobile application frameworks and how they handle input, data, and configuration
  • Experience with containerized workflows and CI/CD (we use Docker heavily)

About the team

The Security Factory: Code Security team builds GitLab's code-level security scanning capabilities, spanning static application security testing and dependency scanning. We help developers find and fix security issues in both the code they write and the open source components they depend on, as early as possible.

We work closely with the Static Analysis team on GitLab's SAST engines, with Composition Analysis on the broader software supply chain, and with other groups across the Sec Section. We rely heavily on asynchronous work across time zones.

Remote-Global

title: Tier 2 Service Desk Technician (On-Site)
description:
Oneida Professional Services is seeking a Systems Administrator to support the Defense Information School (DINFOS) Technology & Logistics Support Services contract at Fort Meade, Maryland. This position is responsible for administering, maintaining, and securing enterprise server environments and supporting the reliable operation of DINFOS information systems.

The successful candidate will provide support for Windows and Linux/UNIX systems, perform system maintenance and patch management activities, support backup and recovery operations, and assist with infrastructure modernization efforts. This role requires strong technical troubleshooting skills and the ability to maintain secure, stable, and highly available systems in a mission-critical environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Handle Complex or Long-Running Support Issues - Troubleshoot problems involving workstations, printers, network-connected devices, and end-user applications that require deeper investigation. Act as an initial point of escalation for the Service Desk before issues are referred to other technical teams.
  • Perform Vulnerability Remediation - Review systems that have failed automated patching or remediation procedures, identify the cause of the failure, and complete remediation. Ensure affected systems are returned to DoW compliance in a timely manner.
  • Maintain Technical Procedures and Documentation - Create and update SOPs, troubleshooting procedures, configuration templates, and other technical documentation used by the Service Desk for day-to-day operations.
  • Support Device Security Requirements - Develop and maintain security configurations, including applicable STIG requirements, for devices that are not centrally managed, such as printers, scanners, conference-room equipment, and IoT devices.
  • Coordinate Advanced IT Support - Act as the IT point of contact for high-profile visits, special events, VIP requirements, and Command Staff activities that require additional planning, testing, or technical support.
  • Investigate Recurring Technical Problems - Review repeated incidents affecting users, systems, devices, or applications to identify common causes and determine whether a permanent corrective action can be implemented.
  • Review and Improve Service Desk Troubleshooting - Identify gaps in existing troubleshooting procedures and develop additional guidance, tools, or processes that allow Service Desk personnel to resolve issues more consistently.
  • Prepare Technical Escalations - Perform initial investigation and gather relevant logs, error information, troubleshooting results, and system details before referring issues to Systems, Network, Cybersecurity, or other technical teams.
  • Review Aging and Unresolved Tickets - Periodically review tickets that have remained open for extended periods, determine what is preventing resolution, and assist with moving those issues toward closure or appropriate escalation.
  • Provide Back-of-House Technical Support - Operate primarily as an internal technical resource rather than a primary client-facing Service Desk technician. Focus on escalated issues, technical investigation, remediation, documentation, and Service Desk support, while interacting directly with users when necessary to troubleshoot or resolve an assigned issue.

title: Asset Protection Detective, Roosevelt - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an Asset Protection Detective, you will help protect company assets, reduce shortage, and support a safe, customer-focused shopping environment. Using surveillance, investigative tools, and strong partnerships with store teams and law enforcement, you will identify and respond to theft, recover merchandise, and help protect our customers, colleagues, and business.

Why This Role Matters

Asset Protection Detectives play an important role in reducing loss while maintaining a safe and welcoming store environment. Through training, observation, investigation, and de-escalation, this role helps protect company assets, support colleagues, and ensure customers can shop with confidence.

How Our Asset Protection Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They greet teammates with a warm hello. Before they get started, they review updates and department information so they're fully informed and ready to engage with confidence.

  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.

  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What To Expect

  • Use surveillance techniques, investigative tools, and reporting systems to help identify theft, dishonest activity, and shortage trends.

  • Partner with Asset Protection leaders, store teams, and law enforcement to support investigations and protect company assets.

  • Apply de-escalation tools and sound judgment to help maintain a safe environment for customers and colleagues.

  • Prepare clear documentation, statements, and evidence to support investigations, audits, and legal proceedings.

  • Support team readiness by training colleagues on protocols that help protect company assets.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Help protect customers, colleagues, and company assets by identifying, investigating, and responding to theft and dishonest activity.

  • Use surveillance techniques to support the apprehension of shoplifters and dishonest employees, while following company policies and legal requirements.

  • Recover stolen merchandise and provide statements, evidence, and documentation to support investigations.

  • Prepare timely and accurate reports related to theft incidents, investigations, audits, and assigned activities.

  • Build strong partnerships with store colleagues, Asset Protection leaders, and law enforcement to support investigations and shortage reduction.

  • Maintain compliance with company policies and legal standards related to apprehensions, searches, and evidence preservation.

  • Testify in court for criminal and civil cases, as needed.

  • Respond to alarm calls, support special assignments, and facilitate first aid for customers and colleagues when needed.

  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills That Matter

Must Have

  • Ability to observe, identify, and respond to suspicious activity in a retail environment.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with customers, colleagues, leaders, and law enforcement.

  • Ability to use sound judgment, de-escalation tools, and company procedures to support a safe environment.

  • Ability to handle proprietary, sensitive, and confidential information with discretion and integrity.

  • For jobs in New York, a current New York State Security Guard License is required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, customer service, asset protection, security, investigations, or law enforcement.

  • Ability to prepare accurate reports, statements, and documentation related to incidents and investigations.

  • Experience using surveillance systems, reporting tools, or investigative technology.

  • Ability to train or coach colleagues on asset protection protocols, shortage reduction, or safety practices.

Physical Activities You Will Perform

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

  • Position requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around store or department.

  • May occasionally involve reaching above eye level, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.

  • Must be able to apprehend shoplifters.

  • Ability to sustain long periods of time enclosed in surveillance areas.

  • Frequently lift/move up to 30lbs.

  • Requires close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

Manufacturing powers the global economy at $50T a year and it relies heavily on human dexterity and skill to produce the goods we rely on every day. Yet manufacturers have little visibility when issues arise at manual assembly stations, impacting productivity and quality.

Assembler AI is changing that.

We use computer vision and artificial intelligence to help manufacturers improve quality, reduce waste, increase throughput, and enable frontline employees to perform at their best.

Backed by Diagram Ventures, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of AI, manufacturing, and operational excellence.

The role

As a Senior Backend Software Developer, you'll architect, design, build, deploy, operate and scale the backend platform that turns thousands of real-time video feeds into insights operators and engineers can act on immediately. You'll work closely with our Head of Engineering as well as our AI R&D team to architect the Operator Vision SaaS platform, harden the services, APIs and infrastructure. You take pride in building and delivering high quality and highly scalable code with high velocity? This is for you!

What you'll do

  • Participate in the platform's architecture definition, working closely with the Head of Engineering, and taking into consideration the tradeoffs that let us scale from pilot to full production.
  • Design and implement the cloud-based backend platform — services, APIs and data pipelines — including auto-scaling and failover recovery capabilities that keep the platform available for live production lines.
  • Contribute to building the infrastructure that ingests and processes thousands of real-time video streams, working closely with the AI R&D team.
  • Contribute to defining and putting in place development conventions — code standards, testing practices, and how the team uses agentic coding tools to move faster without cutting corners.
  • Contribute to building the CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices enabling the team to ship fast, safely and often.
  • Contribute to operating the service — instrumenting logging, metrics and alerting, and taking part in incident response when things don't work as expected.
  • Partner with product and AI R&D to translate customer needs into technical solutions.

What we're looking for

  • Seasoned backend engineer with deep, demonstrated expertise in Python or another high-level backend language such as Go or Rust, and you're comfortable working across multiple languages and stacks as the problem demands.
  • 7+ years of professional backend software development experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing and shipping highly scalable, resilient and cost-effective cloud-based backend solutions in production, not just in theory.
  • Strong experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and modern continuous deployment practices.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing REST APIs. GraphQL APIs is a nice to have.
  • Experience with the stack we leverage in our platform, or equivalent:
    • Python
    • FastAPI, Strawberry
    • SQLAlchemy
    • Alembic
    • Postgres
  • Demonstrated experience working as part of a startup, owning outcomes end-to-end, moving fast with limited resources, and building scale before scale is guaranteed.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to meaningfully accelerate development velocity.
  • Strong instincts for data modeling and building systems that stay reliable under real-world production load.
  • Experience implementing and evolving infrastructure as code, e.g. with Terraform.
  • Experience with high-volume data ingestion pipelines, such as video, audio or streaming data (nice to have).
  • Experience with Test driven development methodology (nice to have).

Why join

  • The chance to build the platform that carries thousands of real-time video streams, serving live production lines at a real manufacturing scale.
  • Direct collaboration with our Head of Engineering and founders.
  • Real influence over the architecture, engineering standards, tooling, and how we use AI in our own development process.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Competitive health benefits
  • Health and wellness spending account, from $500 to $1,000 annually
  • Latest MacBook and modern tooling
  • Opportunity to grow as the company scales


L'occasion

Le secteur manufacturier fait rouler l'économie mondiale, avec 50 000 milliards de dollars par année, et il repose largement sur la dextérité et le savoir-faire des gens pour produire les biens dont nous dépendons tous les jours. Pourtant, les manufacturiers ont peu de visibilité quand un problème survient aux postes d'assemblage manuel, ce qui nuit à la productivité et à la qualité.

Assembler AI change la donne.

Nous utilisons la vision par ordinateur et l'intelligence artificielle pour aider les manufacturiers à améliorer la qualité, à réduire le gaspillage, à augmenter la cadence de production et à permettre aux employés de plancher de donner leur pleine mesure.

Appuyés par Diagram Ventures, nous bâtissons une entreprise qui définit sa catégorie, à la croisée de l'IA, de la fabrication et de l'excellence opérationnelle.

Le poste

À titre de développeur logiciel backend senior, vous architecturerez, concevrez, construirez, déploierez, opérerez et ferez évoluer la plateforme backend qui transforme des milliers de flux vidéo en temps réel en informations exploitables immédiatement par les opérateurs et les ingénieurs. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec notre chef de l'ingénierie ainsi qu'avec notre équipe d'IA R&D afin d'architecturer la plateforme SaaS Operator Vision, de renforcer les services, les API et l'infrastructure. Vous êtes fier de bâtir et de livrer du code de grande qualité, hautement évolutif, à grande vélocité ? Ce poste est pour vous!

Ce que vous ferez

  • Participer à la définition de l'architecture de la plateforme, en travaillant étroitement avec le chef de l'ingénierie et en tenant compte des compromis qui nous permettront de passer du projet pilote à la production complète.
  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre la plateforme backend infonuagique — services, API et pipelines de données — y compris les capacités d'auto-mise à l'échelle et de reprise après défaillance qui maintiennent la plateforme disponible pour les lignes de production en direct.
  • Contribuer à bâtir l'infrastructure qui ingère et traite des milliers de flux vidéo en temps réel, en travaillant étroitement avec l'équipe d'IA R&D.
  • Contribuer à définir et à mettre en place les conventions de développement — normes de code, pratiques de test et façon dont l'équipe utilise les outils de codage agentique pour aller plus vite sans couper les coins ronds.
  • Contribuer à bâtir les pipelines CI/CD et les pratiques de déploiement permettant à l'équipe de livrer rapidement, de manière sécuritaire et fréquemment.
  • Contribuer à l'exploitation du service — instrumentation des journaux, des métriques et des alertes, et participation à la réponse aux incidents lorsque les choses ne fonctionnent pas comme prévu.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes produit et IA R&D pour traduire les besoins des clients en solutions techniques.

Ce que nous recherchons

  • Ingénieur backend chevronné possédant une expertise approfondie et démontrée en Python ou dans un autre langage backend de haut niveau comme Go ou Rust, et à l'aise de travailler avec plusieurs langages et piles technologiques selon les besoins du problème.
  • Plus de 7 ans d'expérience professionnelle en développement logiciel backend.
  • Expertise démontrée dans la conception et la livraison de solutions backend infonuagiques hautement évolutives, résilientes et rentables en production, pas seulement en théorie.
  • Solide expérience avec l'infrastructure infonuagique AWS, la conteneurisation (Docker/Kubernetes) et les pratiques modernes de déploiement continu.
  • Expérience démontrée dans la conception et la mise en œuvre d'API REST. Les API GraphQL sont un atout.
  • Expérience avec la pile technologique que nous utilisons dans notre plateforme, ou l'équivalent :
    • Python
    • FastAPI, Strawberry
    • SQLAlchemy
    • Alembic
    • Postgres
  • Expérience démontrée dans un environnement de startup, avec la capacité de prendre en charge des résultats de bout en bout, d'avancer rapidement avec des ressources limitées et de bâtir pour l'échelle avant que l'échelle ne soit garantie.
  • Expérience démontrée dans l'utilisation d'outils de codage agentique comme Claude Code, Cursor ou GitHub Copilot afin d'accélérer significativement la vélocité de développement.
  • Excellents réflexes en modélisation de données et en conception de systèmes qui demeurent fiables sous une charge de production réelle.
  • Expérience dans la mise en œuvre et l'évolution de l'infrastructure comme code, p. ex. avec Terraform.
  • Expérience avec des pipelines d'ingestion de données à haut volume, comme la vidéo, l'audio ou les données en continu (un atout).
  • Expérience avec la méthodologie de développement piloté par les tests (un atout).

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous

  • La chance de bâtir la plateforme sur laquelle roulent des milliers de flux vidéo en temps réel, au service de lignes de production actives à l'échelle manufacturière réelle.
  • Une collaboration directe avec notre chef de l'ingénierie et les fondateurs.
  • Une influence réelle sur l'architecture, les normes d'ingénierie, l'outillage et la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans notre propre processus de développement.

Rémunération et avantages sociaux

  • Salaire concurrentiel et options d'achat d'actions
  • Assurance collective concurrentielle
  • Compte de dépenses santé et mieux-être, de 500 $ à 1 000 $ par année
  • MacBook récent et outils de travail modernes
  • Occasion de grandir avec l'entreprise

title: Software engineer - new grad

title: Power Platform Developer
description:
Mission Bridge Partners is seeking an experienced Power Platform Developer to support a federal healthcare technology modernization program. This is a hands-on development opportunity – not simply administering or configuring existing applications – focused on designing, building, enhancing, and maintaining enterprise applications, automated workflows, and reporting solutions using Microsoft's Power Platform.

The ideal candidate brings advanced expertise in Microsoft Power Apps development, along with strong experience integrating Power Automate, Power BI, Azure DevOps, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365. Must be a U.S. citizen.

This individual will work across multiple program teams to translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions that improve operational efficiency, portfolio visibility, and program performance.

Key Responsibilities

Power Apps Development
  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain complex enterprise applications using Microsoft Power Apps.
  • Independently translate business requirements into functional, scalable, and user-friendly applications.
  • Build solutions supporting project management, portfolio tracking, documentation, business processes, and operational workflows.
  • Integrate Power Apps with Power Automate, Power BI, Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps, and other enterprise data sources.
  • Troubleshoot application performance, usability, security, data access, and integration issues.
  • Implement development best practices supporting application security, permissions, maintainability, and lifecycle management.
  • Manage application development backlogs and deliver enhancements based on evolving business priorities.

Power Automate & Workflow Integration
  • Design, develop, and maintain Power Automate workflows supporting enterprise business processes.
  • Automate manual and repetitive tasks to improve efficiency and data consistency.
  • Integrate automated workflows with Power Apps, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and other approved systems.
  • Troubleshoot workflow failures and optimize existing automations for reliability and performance.

Power BI Development & Reporting
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions using multiple enterprise data sources.
  • Integrate Power BI with Azure DevOps and other business systems to support portfolio management, project execution, and performance reporting.
  • Perform data transformation, modeling, and validation to ensure accurate and reliable reporting.
  • Develop intuitive visualizations that provide leadership with actionable operational insights.

Azure DevOps & Enterprise Integration
  • Integrate Azure DevOps data with Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.
  • Leverage Azure DevOps work items, backlogs, and reporting capabilities to support project and portfolio management.
  • Develop solutions that improve visibility into delivery progress, resource capacity, dependencies, and performance metrics.
  • Support integration between Microsoft Power Platform applications and enterprise collaboration tools.

Collaboration & Solution Delivery
  • Partner with technical teams, product owners, analysts, and program leadership to gather and refine requirements.
  • Independently recommend appropriate technical approaches based on business needs.
  • Manage competing development priorities across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrate completed solutions, incorporate user feedback, and deliver iterative enhancements.
  • Maintain technical documentation and provide guidance to support adoption and long-term application maintenance.
  • Apply Agile and Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) concepts when developing portfolio and execution management solutions.

Required Qualifications
  • 6–8 years of hands-on experience developing Microsoft Power Platform solutions within complex enterprise environments.
  • Advanced experience designing, developing, and maintaining Microsoft Power Apps applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently deliver complex business applications from requirements gathering through implementation.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Power Automate and enterprise workflow automation.
  • Experience developing Power BI dashboards and integrating multiple data sources.
  • Experience integrating Power Platform solutions with Microsoft Azure DevOps.
  • Strong familiarity with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and enterprise data integration.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and optimize application performance, functionality, and maintainability.
  • Working knowledge of Agile and SAFe methodologies, particularly portfolio management and execution tracking.
  • Experience managing multiple development priorities and supporting stakeholders across different teams or programs.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting federal government or large-scale enterprise technology modernization programs.
  • Familiarity with healthcare IT environments and complex program operations.
  • Experience developing Power Platform solutions supporting portfolio management, operational reporting, or program performance.
  • Microsoft Power Platform Developer Associate certification.
  • Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification.
  • SAFe certification.

title: Chaplain (Part-Time) - Altoona, PA
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Please Note: While assigned hours are generally consistent from week to week, there are no guaranteed minimal hours and positional needs will vary depending on Chaplain availability and Client requirements.

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.


Part-Time, Altoona, PA


Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.


Ministry

  • Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.
  • Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.
  • May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.
  • May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.
  • May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.
  • Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.
  • May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.
  • May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.
  • Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.
  • Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).
  • Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.
  • With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.

Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

8. Must have active state driver’s license and state minimum auto insurance (state(s) where servicing clients).


Conditions of Employment
Must pass a pre-employment background check.


Work Environment
This is a remote position in the field, and the work environment is dependent upon the clients’ worksite. Work environments can include manufacturing, hospitals, office buildings, and funeral homes with differing levels of temperature, noise, and light exposure.
